title_en: Build and Deploy Conversation AI Bots With Ask AI
source_md:
Ask AI can build a Conversation AI bot that reflects how your business communicates across calls, emails, SMS, social messages, and Live Chat. After creating the bot, Ask AI automatically selects the correct deployment method based on whether Conversations AI Channel Management is enabled for the sub-account. This creates an on-brand bot and places it on eligible channels without requiring users to configure every assignment manually.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Ask AI Conversation AI Bot Creation?](#What-is-Ask-AI-Conversation-AI-Bot-Creation?)
- [Key Benefits of Ask AI Conversation AI Bot Creation](#Key-Benefits-of-Ask-AI-Conversation-AI-Bot-Creation)
- [How Ask AI Builds the Bot’s Voice](#How-Ask-AI-Builds-the-Bot%E2%80%99s-Voice)
- [Bot Voice Compared With Bot Training](#Bot-Voice-Compared-With-Bot-Training)
- [Before You Begin](#Before-You-Begin)
- [How To Set Up an Ask AI Conversation AI Bot](#How-To-Set-Up-an-Ask-AI-Conversation-AI-Bot)
- [Step 1: Open Ask AI](#Step-1%3A-Open-Ask-AI)
- [Step 2: Describe the Bot You Want to Create](#Step-2%3A-Describe-the-Bot-You-Want-to-Create)
- [Step 3: Complete Any Guided Questions](#Step-3%3A-Complete-Any-Guided-Questions)
- [Step 4: Review the Proposed Configuration](#Step-4%3A-Review-the-Proposed-Configuration)
- [Step 5: Allow Ask AI to Create the Bot](#Step-5%3A-Allow-Ask-AI-to-Create-the-Bot)
- [Step 6: Review the Deployment Confirmation](#Step-6%3A-Review-the-Deployment-Confirmation)
- [Step 7: Open the New Bot](#Step-7%3A-Open-the-New-Bot)
- [Step 8: Review the Bot’s Voice and Instructions](#Step-8%3A-Review-the-Bot%E2%80%99s-Voice-and-Instructions)
- [Step 9: Review Training and Knowledge Sources](#Step-9%3A-Review-Training-and-Knowledge-Sources)
- [Step 10: Verify Channel or Path Assignments](#Step-10%3A-Verify-Channel-or-Path-Assignments)
- [Step 11: Test the Bot](#Step-11%3A-Test-the-Bot)
- [Step 12: Monitor Live Conversations](#Step-12%3A-Monitor-Live-Conversations)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is Ask AI Conversation AI Bot Creation?**

Ask AI Conversation AI bot creation is a guided workflow that turns a natural-language request into a configured Conversation AI bot. Ask AI reviews available conversation history to understand how the business communicates, then uses those patterns to shape the bot’s tone, style, and questions.

Ask AI can review communication across multiple sources, including:

- Voice call transcripts
- Full email threads
- SMS conversations
- Social conversations
- Live Chat conversations

Using multiple conversation sources helps the new bot communicate more consistently across the channels where customers interact with the business. After creating the bot, Ask AI deploys it according to the sub-account’s Conversations AI Channel Management configuration.

---

## **Key Benefits of Ask AI Conversation AI Bot Creation**

Ask AI reduces the work required to create an effective bot by combining conversation analysis, bot configuration, and deployment in one workflow. The resulting bot starts with communication patterns grounded in how the business already speaks with leads and customers.

- **More Consistent Brand Communication:**The bot’s tone and style are based on real conversations across available communication sources.
- **Broader Conversation Analysis:** Ask AI can learn from calls and email threads in addition to SMS, social messages, and Live Chat.
- **Faster Bot Creation:** A natural-language request can initiate the bot-building process without requiring every setting to be entered manually.
- **Automatic Deployment:**Ask AI detects whether Channel Management is enabled and uses the correct deployment method.
- **Protection for Existing Bot Assignments:**When Channel Management is enabled, the new bot does not take over paths already handled by another bot.
- **Clear Deployment Results:**The completion message identifies where the bot was deployed and explains why any selected channels were skipped.
- **Less Post Creation Cleanup:**The bot is created and assigned through one guided request, reducing manual configuration after setup.

---

## **How Ask AI Builds the Bot’s Voice**

A bot’s voice affects how naturally and consistently it communicates with leads and customers. Ask AI studies available historical conversations to identify patterns in the business’s wording, tone, style, and common questions.

Ask AI may use conversation history from:

- Voice call transcripts
- Email conversations and complete threads
- SMS messages
- Social messaging channels
- Live Chat conversations

This broader analysis helps the bot reflect how the business communicates in different situations instead of relying only on text chats or SMS messages.

For example, conversation history may help Ask AI identify whether the business commonly uses:

- A friendly or professional tone
- Brief or detailed replies
- Specific greetings or closing language
- Consultative questions
- Qualification questions
- Appointment-focused language
- Formal or conversational phrasing

The generated voice should be reviewed after creation to confirm that it matches the business’s current communication standards. Conversation AI prompts and instructions can be adjusted to refine tone, behavior, question style, and response expectations. 

```
Important: A bot’s voice is different from its factual knowledge. Conversation history helps Ask AI shape how the bot communicates, while Bot Training and connected Knowledge Bases help the bot answer business-specific questions accurately.
```

---

## **Bot Voice Compared With Bot Training**

Communication style and factual knowledge serve different purposes. Understanding this distinction helps users review the correct settings after Ask AI creates the bot.

- Bot voice controls how the bot communicates, including its tone, wording, personality, and question style.
- Bot Training supplies information the bot can use to answer customer questions, such as services, pricing, policies, and instructions.
- Bot Goals define what the bot should accomplish, such as collecting contact information, booking appointments, or triggering workflows.

Conversation AI Bot Training can use sources such as website content and Custom Bot Responses to improve answer accuracy. Bot Goals can define the agent’s personality, intent, supporting instructions, and available actions.

---

## **Before You Begin**

Successful bot creation depends on having useful conversation history, connected communication channels, and access to the required HighLevel features. Reviewing the sub-account first helps Ask AI build and deploy the bot with fewer skipped assignments.

Before starting:

- Confirm that you have access to Ask AI.
- Confirm that you can create and manage Conversation AI bots.
- Review the sub-account’s existing conversation history.
- Confirm that voice call transcripts are available if calls should influence the bot’s voice.
- Confirm that the required phone numbers, pages, accounts, or Live Chats are connected.
- Review existing bot assignments.
- Check whether Conversations AI Channel Management is enabled.
- Decide which channels the new bot should use.
- Prepare a clear description of the bot’s purpose.
- Plan to review and test the generated bot after creation.

Ask AI is a built-in HighLevel workspace that can answer questions, create content, generate assets, and complete supported actions without requiring users to leave the platform.

---

## **How To Set Up an Ask AI Conversation AI Bot**

A clear request and a complete post-creation review help ensure the bot is configured for the correct business purpose and deployed to the intended channels. Testing is especially important before allowing the bot to manage live customer conversations.

#### **Step 1: Open Ask AI**

1. Log in to the appropriate HighLevel sub-account.
2. Open Ask AI from the navigation menu.
3. Start a new Ask AI conversation.

#### **Step 2: Describe the Bot You Want to Create**

Enter a prompt explaining:

- The bot’s purpose
- The types of customers it will communicate with
- The desired outcome
- The channels where it should be deployed

```
Example: 

Create a Conversation AI bot for new leads. Use our past calls, emails, SMS messages, social conversations, and Live Chat history to match our communication style. The bot should answer initial questions, qualify leads, and deploy on SMS, Facebook, and Live Chat.
```

#### **Step 3: Complete Any Guided Questions**

Ask AI may request additional information needed to complete the bot configuration. Review each question and provide accurate details about the business, bot purpose, expected behavior, or selected channels.

Do not include customer-sensitive information unless it is required and appropriate for the workflow.

#### **Step 4: Review the Proposed Configuration**

Review any summary or configuration details presented by Ask AI before the action is completed.

Confirm that:

- The bot’s purpose is correct.
- The intended communication style is represented.
- The correct channels are selected.
- The expected deployment behavior matches the sub-account’s Channel Management status.

#### **Step 5: Allow Ask AI to Create the Bot**

Complete any required confirmation so Ask AI can create the bot.

Ask AI uses available historical conversations to shape the bot’s communication style and creates the required 

Conversation AI configuration.  
  
![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155076706766/original/Bh20SlB7vu0R4OiMcbCC7831a3pnPaXadQ.png?1784817430)

#### **Step 6: Review the Deployment Confirmation**

After creation, review the confirmation carefully.

When Channel Management is enabled, the confirmation should identify:

- The paths where the bot was deployed
- Any channels that were skipped
- The reason each channel was skipped

When Channel Management is disabled, confirm that the bot was set as the Primary Conversation AI bot for the requested channels.

#### **Step 7: Open the New Bot**

1. Go to AI Agents.
2. Select Conversation AI.
3. Open the bot created by Ask AI.
4. Review the bot’s settings.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155076717689/original/X9GneLqJYlpz8xuRwXL_bLoF0FzWo1thTA.png?1784822821)

#### **Step 8: Review the Bot’s Voice and Instructions**

Review the bot’s:

- Personality
- Tone
- Goal or intent
- Qualification questions
- Supporting instructions
- Response behavior

Edit any language that does not accurately reflect the business.

Bot Goals and prompts influence how the agent communicates and what it attempts to accomplish during a conversation.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155076718526/original/-SE-2DYTDC6faZOM108YOqhbinDzwQBEmQ.gif?1784823305)

#### **Step 9: Review Training and Knowledge Sources**

Confirm that the bot has access to the information it needs to answer customer questions.

Add or update:

- Website training
- FAQs
- Custom Bot Responses
- Connected Knowledge Bases
- Policies
- Service details
- Pricing information
- Appointment information

Ask AI can also create and attach Knowledge Bases to Conversation AI through a guided workflow.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155076718701/original/q9jGEXUON7yy56sPrmB9SaqvTVOhU6Dl4g.png?1784823411)

#### **Step 10: Verify Channel or Path Assignments**

Confirm that the bot is assigned to the expected locations.

When Channel Management is enabled:

- Review each assigned path.
- Confirm that existing bot assignments were preserved.
- Manually adjust assignments when the bot should use only a specific path.

When Channel Management is disabled:

- Confirm that the bot is the intended Primary Bot.
- Review the channels assigned to it.

#### **Step 11: Test the Bot**

Use the available testing tools to verify:

- Tone and wording
- Answers to common questions
- Qualification questions
- Appointment-booking behavior
- Workflow actions
- Escalation or human handoff behavior
- Responses across relevant channels

The standard Conversation AI setup process includes configuring goals, testing responses, and launching with the appropriate bot status.

#### **Step 12: Monitor Live Conversations**

After the bot begins handling conversations:

- Review its responses regularly.
- Check whether the tone remains consistent.
- Look for unanswered or inaccurate questions.
- Update training content when information is missing.
- Refine prompts and instructions when responses do not match the business’s expectations.
- Confirm that the bot remains assigned to the correct channels or paths.

Ongoing review helps the bot stay aligned with business processes and customer needs.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Does Ask AI use only SMS and chat messages to build the bot’s voice?**

A. No. Ask AI can use broader conversation history, including voice call transcripts and full email threads, in addition to SMS, social messages, and Live Chat.

**Q: Does conversation history become the bot’s factual training data?**

A. Not necessarily. Historical conversations help Ask AI shape the bot’s tone, style, and questions. Bot Training and Knowledge Bases should still be reviewed to confirm the bot has accurate business information.

**Q: What happens when some paths are already assigned to another bot?**

A. When Channel Management is enabled, Ask AI leaves those assignments unchanged and deploys the new bot only to available paths within the requested channels.

**Q: What happens when every path in a selected channel is already assigned?**

A. Ask AI skips that channel and explains in the completion message that no available path was found.

**Q: What happens when a selected channel has no connected account, page, number, or Live Chat?**

A. Ask AI does not deploy the bot to that channel. The completion message identifies the skipped channel and explains that no connected path is available.

**Q: Can I ask Ask AI to deploy the bot to one specific phone number or Facebook page?**

A. No. Specific path targeting is not currently supported in the Ask AI request. When Channel Management is enabled, the bot is deployed to all available paths for the selected channel. You can adjust the path assignments manually after the bot is created.

**Q: Will a new bot replace an existing bot?**

A. When Channel Management is enabled, the new bot does not replace bots already assigned to paths. When Channel Management is disabled, the newly created bot is set as the Primary Conversation AI bot for the selected channels, so the existing Primary Bot configuration should be reviewed.

**Q: Should I test the bot even though Ask AI creates it automatically?**

A. Yes. Test the generated bot before relying on it for live customer conversations. Review its tone, factual accuracy, questions, actions, appointment behavior, and handoff logic.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Overview of Ask AI Assistant](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005327)
- [How to Set Up a Conversation AI Bot](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000004401)
- [Conversation AI Bot Explained](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000001335)
- [Conversation AI - Primary vs Non-Primary Bots](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000004414)
- [Training Your Conversation AI Bot](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000004416)
- [Bot Goals Overview in Conversation AI](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000004417)

title_en: Smart Lists in Opportunities
source_md:
Opportunity Smart Lists help teams save and reuse customized views in the Opportunities area of HighLevel. Instead of rebuilding the same filters, sorting, and visible fields each time, users can save a configured view and return to it whenever they need to review pipeline data. Smart Lists can be created for both List view and Board view, making it easier to standardize deal reviews, manage pipeline workflows, and collaborate across teams.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What are Opportunity Smart Lists?](#What-are-Opportunity-Smart-Lists?)
- [Key Benefits of Opportunity Smart Lists](#Key-Benefits-of-Opportunity-Smart-Lists)
- [List and Board Smart Lists in Opportunities](#List-and-Board-Smart-Lists-in-Opportunities)
- [Managing Opportunity Smart Lists](#Managing-Opportunity-Smart-Lists)
  - [Editing an existing Smart List](#Editing-an-existing-Smart-List)
  - [Duplicating a Smart List](#Duplicating-a-Smart-List)
  - [Exporting a Smart List](#Exporting-a-Smart-List)
  - [Sharing a Smart List and Copying a Link](#Sharing-a-Smart-List-and-Copying-a-Link)
- [How To Setup Opportunity Smart Lists](#How-To-Setup-Opportunity-Smart-Lists)
- [Managing all Smart Lists](#Managing-all-Smart-Lists)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What are Opportunity Smart Lists?**

Opportunity Smart Lists are saved opportunity views that help users quickly return to the exact pipeline layout they need. They are useful when teams regularly review the same types of deals, such as stale opportunities, high-value deals, recently updated opportunities, or pipeline-specific working views.

---

## **Key Benefits of Opportunity Smart Lists**

Opportunity Smart Lists reduce repetitive setup and help teams work from consistent pipeline views. By saving the way opportunities should appear, admins and users can create reliable views for daily reviews, follow-up tracking, reporting, and team collaboration.

- **Reusable opportunity views:** Save filters, sorting, and visible fields in a named view so users do not need to rebuild the same setup repeatedly.
- **Organized List and Board views:** Create Smart Lists for either table-style review or visual pipeline management.
- **Pipeline-specific visibility:** Choose whether a Smart List appears across all pipelines or only in selected pipelines.
- **Default pipeline views:** Set a Smart List as the default view for one or more pipelines so users land on the right view first.
- **Improved collaboration:** Share useful Smart Lists with all users or selected users in the sub-account.
- **Controlled editing access:** Assign view or edit access depending on whether users should only open the Smart List or modify its configuration.
- **Faster reporting:** Export the opportunity records returned by a Smart List when a CSV file is needed.

---

## **List and Board Smart Lists in Opportunities**

Opportunity Smart Lists can be created from either List view or Board view. Both types appear together in the Smart List area, so users can quickly switch between saved List and Board views from the same place. Since List and Board Smart Lists appear together, the icon beside the Smart List name helps users identify which type of saved view they are opening.

**Board Smart Lists**  
Board Smart Lists display opportunities in a stage-based board layout. They are helpful when users need to visually manage deal movement, review pipeline stages, or work from a Kanban-style pipeline view. Board Smart Lists can be identified by the board-style icon beside the Smart List name.

**List Smart Lists**  
List Smart Lists display opportunities in a table-style layout. They are helpful when users need to review many opportunity details at once, sort records, compare fields, or work from a structured list. List Smart Lists can be identified by the list-style icon beside the Smart List name.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155070557161/original/GBRL41TQuRBoHcVJAmz7uW7_c0l6W6O2kA.png?1777936855)

---

## **Managing Opportunity Smart Lists**

Managing Smart Lists from one place helps admins and teams keep saved views organized, accurate, and easy to maintain. These tools are especially useful when multiple users rely on the same pipeline views.

### **Editing an existing Smart List**

You can update an existing Smart List when the saved filters, sorting, visible fields, pipeline visibility, or default settings need to change. Editing a Smart List updates the saved view, so review changes carefully before saving, especially if the Smart List is shared with other users or set as a default view.

To edit a Smart List:

1. Open the Smart List.
2. Click on **Customize list.**
3. Change the filters, sorting, visible fields, or other Smart List settings.
4. When **Unsaved Changes** appears, choose how you want to handle the update.

Use **Save** only when you want to update the existing Smart List. If you want to create a variation without changing the original, duplicate the Smart List first, then make edits to the duplicated version.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155070557173/original/TpaDG009Y9hHEl_kL81cQwu4SruH0v-FeQ.png?1777936940)

### **Duplicating a Smart List**

Duplicating a Smart List helps users create a similar view without rebuilding the setup manually. This is the best option when you want to create a variation of an existing Smart List while keeping the original view unchanged.

To duplicate a Smart List:

1. Open the Smart List.
2. Click **Customize list**.
3. Select **Duplicate**.
4. Enter a name for the duplicated Smart List.
5. Save it.

This is useful when creating similar views for different teams, pipelines, or review processes.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155070557209/original/QLsvvfBZC9UF2qo82Qp85LPSti4e9Ec_ZA.gif?1777937092)

### **Exporting a Smart List**

Export allows users to download the opportunity records returned by the Smart List’s current setup as a CSV file.

To export a Smart List:

1. Open the Smart List.
2. Click **on Menu**(Three Dotson Top-right beside **+ Add Opportunity**)
3. Select **Export**.

The exported file contains the opportunities returned by that Smart List’s current setup.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155070557238/original/7VL7LV0aI1UIItoPK4mAdjpJkKkP8ZLkBA.png?1777937235)

### **Sharing a Smart List and Copying a Link**

Smart Lists can be shared from the same Sharing & Permissions area where users can copy a direct link. This helps teams work from the same saved Opportunity view while controlling who can access or edit the Smart List.

To share a Smart List or copy its link:

1. Open the Smart List.
2. Click **Customize list**.
3. Select **Sharing & Permissions**.
4. Choose how you want to share the Smart List:
   - **Copy link:** Copy a direct link to the Smart List and share it with teammates.
   - **All users:** Share the Smart List with all users in the sub-account.
   - **Selected users:** Share the Smart List with specific users only.
5. If sharing with users, assign the access level.
6. Save the sharing settings.

Permission types include:

- **Can view:** Users can open and use the Smart List.
- **Can edit:** Users can modify the Smart List configuration.

Be careful when granting edit access, since users with edit permissions can change the Smart List setup.

```
Note: Sharing a Smart List controls access to the saved view. A user’s broader sub-account role, permissions, and assigned data settings may still affect what they can access or manage.
```

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155070557269/original/0yjGy-qaza_9ZH6m8jMvNo2M1FBdM9F3xg.png?1777937443)**

---

## **How To Setup Opportunity Smart Lists**

Setting up Opportunity Smart Lists correctly helps teams create reusable views that are easy to find, share, and maintain. A clear setup process also reduces duplicate views and ensures filters, sorting, visible fields, pipeline visibility, and default views are configured intentionally.

1. Go to **Opportunities**andOpen the pipeline you want to work in.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155070557299/original/712xj08r6cnwsw90baVwTRwPGykgKKeHXg.png?1777937655)
2. Click on **+ List** to create a Smart List and Choose from either **List view** or **Board view**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155070557319/original/E2oOAUydQ1HKYD8wSE4DarFO3xmfkQENTA.png?1777937760)
3. Apply the filters you want to save using **Advanced Filters**.  
     
   Use filters to narrow the opportunities shown in the Smart List. Example filters may include owner, pipeline, stage, value, or activity-based conditions, depending on available filter options.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155070557340/original/-t105IKK9ZrWbpOaQ93WXCRV2uBKlv8W5w.gif?1777937899)
4. Choose the preferred **Sort**order.  
     
   Sorting helps control how opportunities appear when the Smart List is opened. For example, users may sort by recently updated opportunities, opportunity value, or other available fields.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155070557353/original/Kz8J9pj9dXw3xyUap-Yv6zWsLof4tRKbqQ.png?1777937965)
5. Use **Manage Fields**to choose the visible fields for the saved view.  
     
   Visible fields help users focus on the details that matter most for that Smart List. For List views, this controls the fields shown in the table-style layout. For Board views, this helps preserve the selected view setup for that board-style Smart List.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155070557438/original/5RNHOcMrO1CsMf3dWkdRumlx0WUAMVf_yQ.gif?1777938326)

7. Click on **Show In** to choose where the Smart List should appear:  
     
   **All pipelines:** Use this when the Smart List applies across the Opportunities area. OR  
   **Selected pipelines:** Use this when the Smart List only applies to specific workflows, teams, or pipeline types.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155070557445/original/_A-KcWPTFMu7P7SwG6SWlA1JG0e_Ey1ptw.gif?1777938374)
8. Enter a clear name for the Smart List and **Save** the Smart List.  
     
   Use descriptive names that explain the purpose of the view. Examples: **High-Value Open Deals**, **Stale Opportunities**, **Today’s Follow-Ups**, or **New Leads This Week**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155070557471/original/lxnqnpC7-C30zfk6cZQMvKC5zAq2JjlmbA.png?1777938530)
9. Open **Customize list** to configure additional Smart List options.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155070557486/original/ECJATLxPCtiGFVjVqt2BBZ2k8Nw0jmhPVA.png?1777938596)
10. To set the Smart List as a default view, select **Default view**.  
      
    Choose whether the Smart List should be the default for:  
    **All pipelines**or**Selected pipelines**  
      
    ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155070557581/original/jF0fx4-drWxUbWpT0Z2jelpRvEfOb4-uhw.gif?1777938804)
11. Use **Customize list** to manage additional options, such as:

- **Duplicate:** Create a similar Smart List without rebuilding the setup.
- **Export:** Download the opportunity records returned by the Smart List’s current setup as a CSV file.
- **Sharing & Permissions:** Share the Smart List with all users or selected users, assign view or edit access, or copy a direct link.
- **Delete List:** Remove the saved Smart List view without deleting the underlying opportunities.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155070557588/original/Ujt-Js-R5ti7Jh_nT3Un2T8syoICMZk1qg.png?1777938833)

---

## **Managing all Smart Lists**

The **Manage Smart Lists** or **Manage Views** page gives users a centralized place to review saved Opportunity Smart Lists. This page is useful for cleaning up duplicate views, reviewing defaults, and managing pipeline visibility.

To access it:

1. Go to **Opportunities**.
2. Click **on Menu**(Three Dotson Top-right beside **+ Add Opportunity**)
3. Select **Manage Smart Lists**.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155070557701/original/mk8ph9CTD5zBG4Te57b4CwBwkZJgy4pYaw.png?1777939123)

From this page, users can view details such as:

- Smart List name
- Type
- Pipeline visibility
- Default view usage
- Creator
- Last updated time

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155070557676/original/9JwKA26uYUGj8UUx1eGgb0rkLFj9iO_bUQ.png?1777939002)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Can I create Smart Lists for both Board and List views?**  
Yes. Opportunity Smart Lists support both Board view and List view.

**Q: How can I tell whether a Smart List is a List view or Board view?**  
List and Board Smart Lists appear together in the Smart List area. You can identify the view type by the icon beside the Smart List name. Board Smart Lists use a board-style icon, while List Smart Lists use a list-style icon.

**Q: What settings are saved in a Smart List?**  
A Smart List saves filters, sort settings, and visible field configuration for the view type used.

**Q: Can a Smart List appear in only certain pipelines?**  
Yes. You can choose whether a Smart List appears in all pipelines or only selected pipelines.

**Q: Can I set a Smart List as the default view?**  
Yes. A Smart List can be set as the default view for one or more pipelines.

**Q: Does the default view apply only to me?**  
No. The default view is tied to the pipeline setup and affects users in the sub-account for that pipeline.

**Q: What is the difference between Can view and Can edit?**  
Can view allows users to open and use the Smart List. Can edit allows users to modify the Smart List configuration.

**Q: Can I duplicate a Smart List instead of building it again?**  
Yes. Use the Duplicate option from **Customize list** to create a similar Smart List from an existing setup.

**Q: Can I delete a Smart List without deleting opportunities?**  
Yes. Deleting a Smart List removes the saved view, not the underlying opportunity records.

**Q: Can I copy Smart Lists to other sub-accounts?**  
Yes. Opportunity Smart Lists can be included in Account Snapshots and copied to other sub-accounts, along with the pipelines they belong to. See [How to Add Opportunity Smart Lists and Smart Tags to Snapshots.](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000008825-how-to-add-opportunity-smart-lists-and-smart-tags-to-snapshots)

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Use List View in Opportunities](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000002432)

- [Create and Manage Pipelines](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000001985)
- [Manage Opportunity Fields](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000003910)
