title_en: Listings for Food & HealthCare Add-Ons
source_md:
Elevate your online presence with HighLevel’s Listings for Food & HealthCare Add‑ons. These industry‑specific upgrades unlock specialized fields, exclusive publisher distribution (like OpenTable, MenuPix, WebMD, and Vitals), and dynamic management tools. Use this guide to understand eligibility, benefits, and setup so your restaurant or healthcare business reaches more customers and patients.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Listings for Food & HealthCare Add‑Ons](#What-is-Listings-for-Food-&-HealthCare-Add%E2%80%91Ons?)?
- [Key Benefits of Listings for Food & HealthCare Add‑ons](#Key-Benefits-of-Listings-for-Food-&-HealthCare-Add%E2%80%91ons)
- [Menu Management for Food Listings](#Menu-Management-for-Food-Listings)
- [New Fields for Food Entities](#New-Fields-for-Food-Entities)
- [Extended Schema for HealthCare Entities](#Extended-Schema-for-HealthCare-Entities)
- [General‑Purpose Fields for All Entities](#General%E2%80%91Purpose-Fields-for-All-Entities)
- [How To Setup Listings for Food & HealthCare Add‑ons](#How-To-Setup-Listings-for-Food-&-HealthCare-Add%E2%80%91ons)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is Listings for Food & HealthCare Add‑Ons?**

Listings for Food & HealthCare Add‑ons are enhancements to HighLevel’s core Listings feature that transform a standard listing into an industry‑aware profile. Once enabled for a qualifying business, the entity type updates to Food or HealthCare (Facility or Professional), revealing tailored fields, menu or provider tooling, and distribution to publishers that prioritize your industry.

**What it does:**

- Converts a standard listing into a Food or HealthCare entity when eligible.
- Exposes industry‑specific fields (e.g., menus, NPI, insurance) and controls.

- Distributes enhanced data to relevant publisher networks for greater visibility.

```
Note: The entity transformation is intentional and structured around industry needs. Confirm the correct category before upgrading.
```

---

## **Key Benefits of Listings for Food & HealthCare Add‑ons**

Understanding the practical gains helps you decide when to upgrade. The benefits below highlight visibility, relevance, and operational control—key drivers for discovery and conversion in restaurant and healthcare searches.

- **Exclusive Publisher Reach:**Access industry networks like MenuPix, OpenTable, WebMD, Vitals, and more for targeted visibility.
- **Industry‑Specific Fields:** Unlock rich attributes (e.g., Attire, Meals Served, NPI, Insurance Accepted) that increase listing relevance.
- **Menu Management (Food):**Create multiple menus, organize sections, and add rich details per item.
- **Enhanced Provider Profiles (HealthCare):**Add credentials, conditions treated, insurance, and education for patient decision‑making.
- **General‑Purpose Enhancements:** Payment Options and Featured Message available to all entities.
- **Streamlined Upgrade Flow:**Eligible businesses are prompted to upgrade with a controlled, guided experience.
- **Improved Performance Potential:**Richer data and industry distribution can lead to better discovery and engagement.

---

## **Menu Management for Food Listings**

Restaurant discovery hinges on current, scannable menus. Use menu tools to build structured, media‑rich menus that publishers can index, helping diners evaluate options quickly.

**Capabilities**

- Add multiple menus per location (e.g., Lunch, Dinner, Happy Hour, Seasonal Specials).
- Organize menu items into sections (e.g., Appetizers, Mains, Desserts, Beverages).
- Each item can include name, price, description, calories, allergens, spice level, and an item photo.

**Recommended practices**

- Keep pricing and availability current; archive seasonal menus when out of date.
- Use concise descriptions and standardize allergen and spice notations.
- Include high‑quality images with consistent aspect ratios.

---

## **New Fields for Food Entities**

Adding contextual fields helps diners qualify your venue faster and improves how publishers categorize and display your listing.

- **Attire:**Choose typical dress expectations (e.g., casual, business casual, formal).
- **Accepts Reservations:**Indicate if reservations are accepted (Yes/No). If supported, connect or reference reservation platforms.
- **Meals Served:**Select applicable services (e.g., Breakfast, Brunch, Lunch, Dinner, Late Night).
- **Payment Options (general‑purpose):**Specify accepted methods (e.g., major cards, mobile pay).
- **Featured Message (general‑purpose):**Promote limited‑time offers, events, or service notes.

---

## **Extended Schema for HealthCare Entities**

Healthcare discovery depends on trustworthy details. Adding provider credentials and facility attributes helps patients evaluate fit, insurance coverage, and availability.

**Provider fields (HealthCare Professional)**

- NPI, First/Last Name, Office/Practice Name
- Headshot and Provider Bio
- Accepting New Patients, Insurance Accepted
- Education & Training, Degrees, Conditions Treated
- Admitting Hospitals (where applicable)

**Facility fields (HealthCare Facility)**

- Facility Name, Departments/Services, Accepting New Patients
- Insurance Accepted, Operating Hours, Contact & Location

```
Note: Field availability differs for Facilities vs Professionals. Complete as many fields as possible to improve match quality on healthcare publishers.
```

---

## **General‑Purpose Fields for All Entities**

Some enhancements benefit every business category. Use these fields to communicate key logistical and promotional details regardless of industry.

- **Payment Options:**List accepted payment methods to reduce checkout friction.
- **Featured Message:** Surface timely info—promotions, closings, seasonal notices, or accessibility notes.

---

## **How To Setup Listings for Food & HealthCare Add‑ons**

**Before You Start (Prerequisites & Roles)**

- **Access:**You must be able to create/edit Listings for the sub‑account.
- **Data prep (Recommended):**
  - **Food:** Current menus (names, sections, items), prices, calories, allergens, spice level, and 1–3 photos per popular item.
  - **HealthCare:**Provider/facility details (NPI for professionals in the U.S.), insurance accepted, accepting‑new‑patients status, education & training, conditions treated, headshots.
  - **All:**Payment Options and a short Featured Message (promo/notice).
- **Images:**Use clear, well‑lit images. Prefer consistent aspect ratios; avoid text‑heavy graphics.

### **Step 1 — Create or Edit a Listing**

1. Open your sub‑account and go to Reputation from the sidebar.
2. Click Listings to create one, or select an existing listing and click Edit.
3. Ensure the business category reflects either Food (restaurants/dining) or HealthCare (facility/professional).
4. The category determines eligibility for the add‑on prompt.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155059398008/original/QMAJ1BeoRG3OoEqvcdkyAb8rldyp-jL9zQ.jpeg?1764259260)

### 

### **Step 2 — Confirm Eligibility**

1. After saving the basic profile/category, look for the Upgrade prompt indicating Food Add‑on or HealthCare Add‑on availability.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155065174371/original/iF72C4HBQuhb7ts-TsFPJzP8SuBa2uNItw.png?1771416990)
2. If you don’t see the prompt:  
   - Re‑check the category selection.
   - Ensure the listing includes a valid address and phone.
   - Save and refresh the page.

### **Step 3 — Upgrade the Listing (Entity Transformation)**

1. Click Upgrade and review the summary of changes.
2. Confirm the transformation to one of the following entity types:  
     
   - Food (restaurant/food service)
   - HealthCare Facility
   - HealthCare Professional
3. The profile reloads with new, industry‑specific fields and controls.

```
Important: This change is not reversible. If you chose the wrong type, archive this listing and create a new one with the correct category.
```

### **Step 4 — Configure Industry‑Specific Fields**

**A) Food (Restaurants)**

1. Open the Food Details panel:
   - **Attire:** Select from list (e.g., casual, business casual, formal).
   - **Accepts Reservations:** Toggle Yes/No; add reservation link if applicable.
   - **Meals Served:**Select all that apply (Breakfast, Brunch, Lunch, Dinner, Late Night).
2. Build Your Menus:  
     

   ### 

   - Click Add Menu → name it (e.g., Lunch, Dinner, Happy Hour).
   - Within a menu, click Add Section (e.g., Appetizers, Mains, Desserts, Beverages).
   - For each Item, add: Name, Price, Description, Calories, Allergens, Spice Level, and an Item Photo.
   - Reorder sections/items via drag‑and‑drop if available.
3. Add Payment Options (cards, mobile pay) and a concise Featured Message (e.g., seasonal menu, holiday hours).

**B) HealthCare (Facilities & Professionals)**

1. Choose Facility vs Professional fields panel, then complete:  
     
   - **Professionals:** NPI, First/Last Name, Office/Practice Name, Headshot, Provider Bio, Accepting New Patients, Insurance Accepted, Education & Training, Degrees, Conditions Treated, Admitting Hospitals (if applicable).
   - **Facilities:** Facility Name, Departments/Services, Accepting New Patients, Insurance Accepted, Operating Hours, Contact & Location.
2. Ensure names/credentials match official records. For U.S. providers, validate NPI formatting before saving.
3. Add Payment Options and a Featured Message (avoid medical advice; use for access/notice info).

**Healthcare QA Tips:**

- Use professional headshots on neutral backgrounds.
- Keep bios concise and factual; avoid PHI or case details.
- List insurance networks using official names.

### **Step 5 — Publish and Distribute**

1. Click Save/Publish to commit your updates.
2. Distribution to publishers begins automatically where supported (e.g., MenuPix/OpenTable for Food, WebMD/Vitals for HealthCare; availability varies by country/publisher).
3. Expect standard sync windows; some publishers may take longer to reflect changes.

### **Step 6 — Quality Check & Ongoing Management**

1. Preview the listing and verify key details (menus, provider attributes, hours, contact info).
2. Revisit Analytics to monitor impressions and actions after changes propagate.
3. Review Suggestions from publishers; accept/reject with care, especially for menus and provider info.
4. Use Audit History to track who changed critical fields (menus, NPI, insurance).

---

## ****Frequently Asked Questions****

**Q: How do I know if my business qualifies for a Food or HealthCare Add‑on?**A: When you create or edit a listing in a supported category, HighLevel automatically prompts you to upgrade.

**Q: Can I switch between Food and HealthCare after upgrading?**A: No. After transformation, switching types isn’t supported. Create a new listing if the business category changes.

**Q: Are there additional costs for using these add‑ons?**A: Pricing may vary by account. Contact your HighLevel representative for add‑on pricing and billing details.

**Q: Can I customize which fields appear on my listing?**A: Fields are determined by entity type and add‑on. Complete the fields that apply to your business; optional fields can be left blank.

**Q: What happens if I don’t upgrade my listing?**A: Your listing remains standard without industry‑specific fields or distribution to Food/HealthCare‑exclusive publishers.

**Q: How do I manage menus or provider profiles over time?**A: Use the listing’s dashboard controls to add, edit, or remove menu items and provider details as your offerings change.

**Q: The upgrade prompt didn’t appear—what should I do?**   
A: Confirm the listing category is correctly set to a supported Food or HealthCare category, then recheck. If the prompt still doesn’t appear, contact Support.

**Q: What if I upgraded by mistake?**A: Because transformation isn’t reversible, archive the listing and recreate it with the correct category.

---

## ****Related Articles****

- [**Getting Started with Listings**](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48001216623)
- **[Online Listings: Supported Countries & Coverage](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000004145)**
- **[Online Listings Analytics Dashboard](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005667)**
- **[How to Use the Listings Suggestions Feature](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005425)**
- **[Multi-Location Management Within a Single Sub-Account](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005763)**
- [**How to Use Entity History in Listings with HighLevel Audit Logs**](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005639)

source_md:
Customize your HighLevel Store Checkout to control field visibility, manage checkout information, and require customers to accept your Terms and Conditions or Privacy Policy before completing payment.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Checkout Page Customization?](#What-is-Checkout-Page-Customization?)
- [Key Benefits of Checkout Page Customization](#Key-Benefits-of-Checkout-Page-Customization)

# **What is Checkout Page Customization?**

Checkout Page Customization lets you control which fields appear on your store’s checkout, add an optional notes field, manage country selection behavior, and enable address auto-complete. Using these options streamlines the purchase experience and ensures you collect only the information needed to fulfill orders.

---

## **Key Benefits of Checkout Page Customization**

- **Reduced friction:** Show only the fields customers must complete for a faster checkout.
- **Higher data quality:** Use address auto-complete to minimize typos and incomplete addresses.
- **Flexible country handling:** Let customers pick their country or restrict checkout to specific countries.
- **Extra context collection:** Capture order-specific instructions with an Additional Notes field.
- **Required policy consent:** Require customers to accept your policy text before they complete payment.

---

## **How to Customize the Checkout Page**

1. Login to your Sub-account.
2. Go to **Sites** → **Stores.**  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/EYwgplptOxKpWQM70lD3+/Screen+Shot+2025-12-30+at+7.22.45+PM.png)
3. Create a **new****store** or **edit** an **existing** store.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/hEPBTJsRQRF0IH7CH9Ig+/Screen+Shot+2025-12-30+at+7.25.54+PM.png)
4. Open the **Checkout****page** editor and select the **Checkout****element.**  
     
   **![](https://jumpshare.com/share/JHDi2iOkZ9QrObvlDOGd+/GIF+Recording+2025-12-30+at+8.45.36+PM.gif)**
5. Customize **Typography.**
   - **Headline font**
   - **Card summary font**
   - **Headline font size**
   - **Card summary font size**
   - **Headline font weight**
   - **Card summary font weight**  
       
     ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/odTNgGaGIi25ujApONxK+/Screen+Shot+2025-12-30+at+8.48.48+PM.png)
6. Configure **Contact****options.**  
     
   - **Sticky contact** (On/Off)
   - **New contact on every purchase** (On/Off)
   - **Validate disposable email** (On/Off)  
       
     ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/cIyt4A8Mujfu9kLALiHb+/Screen+Shot+2025-12-30+at+8.53.09+PM.png)
7. Set **Button** **actions** (Sale actions), choose what happens after the action:

   - **Go to website URL**
   - **Go to page**
   - **Default** (leave as-is)  
       
     ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/JQO5Jmd6uuhRhyJZw9Vm+/GIF+Recording+2025-12-30+at+9.03.53+PM.gif)
8. Use **Text actions** to customize the text shown across checkout sections.  
     
   - **Contact****details** section text, edit text like:  
       
     1. The **headline**
     2. Labels for **email**
   - **Shipping****details** section text: customize headlines/labels such as:  
       
     1. **Name**
     2. **Phone number**
     3. **Search box**
     4. **Full address**
     5. **Country**
     6. **Any other shipping-related headings you want to rename**
   - **Billing****details** section text  
       
     1. **Billing details headline**
     2. **Checkbox text (and related checkbox labeling)**
   - **Payment****section** text  
       
     1. **Payment label/name**
     2. **Checkout button name**
     3. **Footer text (example: “100 secure and save payments” or similar)**
   - **Cart summary**section text  
       
     1. **Cart headline**
     2. **Quantity text**
     3. **Coupon headline text**
     4. **Mobile view coupon code placeholder**
     5. **Apply coupon button text**
     6. **Sub total amount text**
     7. **Discount text**
     8. **Remove coupon button text**
     9. **Shipping heading text**
     10. **Total amount text**  
         ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/r91noIG0QS0uhPzv4Aod+/GIF+Recording+2025-12-30+at+9.19.08+PM.gif)
9. Configure **Form options**  
     
   - **Full name validation** (On/Off)
   - **Enable billing address** or **Disable billing address**
   - **Shipping**: choose whether to **show shipping** or **hide shipping**  
       
     **![](https://jumpshare.com/share/sZaPeNus6t50bgHf77cg+/Screen+Shot+2025-12-30+at+9.35.06+PM.png)**
   - Enable/disable **Auto complete****address** (Google-powered)  
       
     1. **What it does:**  
          
        1. Provides **real-time, Google-powered address suggestions**
        2. Helps create a **smoother, more error-free checkout experience**
        3. Also enables agencies to set **custom pricing** and **repeating/rebuilds of accounts**, creating potential **new revenue streams**
     2. **Supported address fields:**  
          
        1. **Address**
        2. **City**
        3. **Country**
        4. **State**
        5. **Postal code**
     3. **Pricing Details**  
        - **$0.002972** per **search****request** (triggered when customers start typing).
        - **$0.00525** per **API****call** (retrieves full address details).  
            
          ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/hOHMYarhp03EdK3vTEPp+/Screen+Shot+2025-12-30+at+9.36.23+PM.png)
   - Enable/Disable **Postal****Code** & **Country** (gateway-specific)
   - Enable/disable **Notes** at **checkout**  
       
     1. **On** = customers can add **additional notes**
     2. **Off** = notes option is removed  
          
        When notes are enabled and a customer adds notes during checkout, those notes appear in the Order Notes section on the **packing slip**. If the customer does not add notes, the Order Notes section is hidden.  
          
        ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/iap297BGhmZDvdQWg3eY+/Screen+Shot+2025-12-30+at+9.39.45+PM.png)
   - Control which fields are **Mandatory / Optional / Hidden**  
       
     1. **Phone number**
     2. **Address**

     4. **State**
     5. **City**
     6. **Zip / Postal code**  
          
        **![](https://jumpshare.com/share/0ZEb27zcQYVmwQRihDQg+/Screen+Shot+2025-12-30+at+9.53.22+PM.png)**
   - **Country****Selection**at Checkout  
       
     This section walks you through the new **Country Selection at Checkout** feature, which enables store owners to manage shipping locations and default customer locations during the checkout process.  
     - **Shipping Locations**  
         
       Store owners can control which countries are available for shipping at checkout:  
         
       - **Ship to all locations**: Allows shipping to any country, providing global shipping options for customers.
       - **Ship to specific countries**: Store owners can select specific countries for shipping. Only those selected countries will be available during checkout.  
           
         ![image](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155061623420/original/1wLZubq7RqHAWElbX2B8yTFq4GmdR9NAJQ.jpeg?1767112508)
     - **Default Customer Location**  
         
       Store owners can customize how the customer's location is handled at checkout:  
         
       - **No default location**: No preselected country. The customer must choose their location.
       - **Geolocate**: The customer’s location will be detected automatically based on their IP address.
       - **Show all countries**: Displays all available countries for the customer to choose from.
       - If **Ship to specific countries** is enabled, only those countries will be shown as options.
       - The **geolocate** feature provides a seamless experience by automatically redirecting the customer’s location based on their **IP address**.  
           
         ![image](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155061623485/original/JDHs2wYKVTqCOW4P3BoH8SZxO_ryfiINSg.jpeg?1767112571)
   - ### **Configure Terms and Conditions Consent**

     Use the Terms and Conditions setting to require customer acceptance before payment.

     1. Select the **Checkout** element.
     2. In the right panel, scroll to **Terms and Conditions**.
     3. Turn on **Enable Terms and Conditions**.
     4. Customize the checkbox text.
     5. Add links to your Terms and Conditions or Privacy Policy as needed.
     6. Save and publish the store.
   - When enabled:

     - The consent checkbox appears before the payment button.
     - The checkbox remains unchecked by default.
     - Customers must select the checkbox before completing checkout.
     - An inline validation message appears when a customer attempts to continue without accepting the terms.
     - The checkbox appears on desktop and mobile checkout pages.

       ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155076280211/original/6rv4M514mLPisWC8d1RD2VxxQPHCTvJ8AQ.png?1784313080)
   - **Enable** or **Disable** coupon codes.  
       
     ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/IiQmi9cPhI5MCOQB2fyO+/Screen+Shot+2025-12-30+at+10.14.02+PM.png)
   - Set **Color o****ptions** (brand styling)  
       
     1. **Headline text color**
     2. **Card summary text color**
     3. **Background color**
     4. **Payment button color**
     5. **Payment button text color**
     6. **Subscription field text color**
     7. **Subscription field background color**  
          
        **![](https://jumpshare.com/share/zgcrwrFQN3ynUVHoEu6W+/Screen+Shot+2025-12-30+at+10.15.16+PM.png)**

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Why don’t I see Country Selection on checkout?**

If **Country** (or required related fields like State/Province/Region) is hidden in **Shipping Details**, the Country Selection option will not appear.

**Q: How can I add Additional or Processing Fees to E-commerce checkouts?**

**Checkout this article for a detailed guide** - [Adding Processing Charges or Additional Fees to Customer Payments](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005519)

**Q: Can I limit checkout to specific countries only?**

Yes. In **Checkout settings → Country Selection**, choose to restrict checkout to a specific list of countries and save.

**Q: What happens if I don’t select any countries under “Ship to specific countries”?**

If no countries are selected in that list, all countries will be available at checkout.

**Q: What does the Geolocate feature do on checkout?**

Geolocate detects the customer’s approximate location based on their IP address to provide a seamless country selection experience.

**Q: Which fields affect shipping rate calculations?**

Some carriers calculate rates using details like **Address**, **City**, and **ZIP/Postal Code**. Keep these set to **Mandatory** if you need accurate shipping rates.

**Q: Do live shipping rates (e.g., via Shippo) require all address fields?**

Yes. When using multi-carrier platforms like **Shippo**, customers need to complete all required address fields to retrieve live rates at checkout.

**Q: Will reducing required fields make checkout faster?**

Reducing the number of mandatory fields can streamline the process and encourage higher conversion rates.

**Q: What happens if a customer does not accept the Terms and Conditions?**

The customer cannot complete payment. An inline validation message appears until the customer selects the consent checkbox.

**Q: Why might a customer see a verification challenge during checkout?**  
Supported store checkout submissions are automatically protected by Cloudflare Turnstile. Verification normally happens in the background, but a visible challenge may appear when additional verification is required. Customers can complete the challenge and continue their checkout without re-entering the information they already provided.

---

### **Related Articles**

- [How to Set Up an E-Commerce Online Store (Websites)](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000001157)
- [How to Configure Shipping & Delivery Rates In Ecommerce Stores](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000002428)
- [Text Customization in Ecommerce Stores](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000004647)
- [Customer Login for Ecommerce Stores](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005125)

title_en: What is Ask AI Memory?
source_md:
Ask AI Memory helps HighLevel provide more personalized and relevant AI responses by remembering useful details about you, your business, and your preferences across conversations. Memory Settings gives you visibility and control over saved memories, including tools to search, delete, clear, and import information from another AI assistant. In the HighLevel mobile app, you can manage these details directly from Ask AI instead of repeatedly providing the same context in new conversations.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Ask AI Memory?](#What-is-Ask-AI-Memory?)
- [Key Benefits of Ask AI Memory](#Key-Benefits-of-Ask-AI-Memory)
- [Viewing and Searching Saved Memories](#Viewing-and-Searching-Saved-Memories)
- [Deleting Saved Memories](#Deleting-Saved-Memories)
- [Importing Memories From Another AI Assistant](#Importing-Memories-From-Another-AI-Assistant)
- [Memory Scope and Sub-Accounts](#Memory-Scope-and-Sub-Accounts)
- [Ask AI Memory vs. Chat History](#Ask-AI-Memory-vs.-Chat-History)
- [Ask AI Memory vs. Skills](#Ask-AI-Memory-vs.-Skills)
- [How To Set Up and Manage Ask AI Memory on Mobile](#How-To-Set-Up-and-Manage-Ask-AI-Memory-on-Mobile)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)

---

# **What is Ask AI Memory?**

Ask AI Memory stores useful context learned or saved from your interactions with Ask AI so that relevant information can be reused in future conversations. Unlike Chat History, which preserves previous conversations for reference, saved memories provide reusable context that Ask AI can apply when responding to new requests.

For example, saved memories might include details about your business, your role, preferences, or recurring instructions. Keeping these memories accurate helps Ask AI provide responses that better reflect the context in which you work.

---

## **Key Benefits of Ask AI Memory**

Managing saved memories gives you greater control over the context Ask AI can use in future conversations. Accurate memories can reduce repetitive prompting while helping keep important business and preference information available when you need it.

- **Less repetitive prompting:** Ask AI can reuse relevant saved context instead of requiring you to explain the same business details or preferences in every conversation.
- **Greater control over saved context:** Review what Ask AI remembers and remove individual details that are incorrect, outdated, or no longer useful.
- **Faster AI migration:** Import memories from another AI assistant to bring existing context into Ask AI instead of rebuilding it gradually through new conversations.
- **Easier memory management:** Search saved memories to quickly locate specific information and clear memories that you no longer want to retain.
- **Context separation:** Memory context is kept appropriately scoped so information associated with one working context does not unintentionally become context for another.

---

## **Viewing and Searching Saved Memories**

The Saved Memories screen provides a centralized view of the information Ask AI has retained. Reviewing this list periodically can help you keep stored context relevant and identify information that should be updated or removed.

The header displays the number of saved memories currently available. Each memory is displayed in full, allowing longer entries to wrap across multiple lines rather than being cut off.

To find a specific memory:

1. Open the **Saved Memories** screen.
2. Tap the **Search** field.
3. Enter a word or phrase related to the memory you want to find.
4. Review the results as the list filters while you type.
5. Clear the search field to return to the complete list.

You can also use the available sort control to change the order in which memories appear.

---

## **Deleting Saved Memories**

Removing outdated or incorrect memories helps keep the context available to Ask AI accurate. You can remove one memory without clearing the rest of your saved information, or clear all saved memories when you want to start over.

### **Delete an Individual Memory**

Deleting an individual memory is useful when a particular detail is incorrect, outdated, or no longer relevant while the rest of your saved context remains useful.

1. Find the memory you want to remove.
2. Tap the **trash** icon on that memory's row.
3. The memory is removed, and a confirmation message appears.

You can continue deleting additional memories without waiting for each confirmation message to disappear.

### **Clear All Memories**

Clearing all memories removes the saved context associated with the current memory scope. Use this option when you want to remove the entire saved-memory set rather than deleting entries individually.

1. Open **Saved Memories**.
2. Tap the **trash** icon in the header.
3. Review the confirmation dialog.
4. Confirm that you want to clear the saved memories.
5. HighLevel removes the memories and confirms how many entries were deleted.

Deleting saved memories manages Ask AI's reusable memory context. Chat History is a separate feature used to access previous Ask AI conversations.

---

## **Importing Memories From Another AI Assistant**

Importing memories lets you bring useful context from another AI assistant into Ask AI. This can be especially helpful when another assistant already has substantial information about your business, role, preferences, clients, or working style.

The importer uses a two-step workflow: first, HighLevel provides a prompt for collecting the information from the other AI assistant; then you paste the resulting response back into Ask AI.

Ask AI Memory supports importing up to **100 memories at once**.

### 

### **Step 1: Export Context From Your Other AI Assistant**

1. Open **Saved Memories**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155081825146/original/JJtV4JszDMtqCM4Bs6f6rOhno-6jZIpASA.png?1790319797)
2. Tap **Import memories**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155081825557/original/zULrvh4vmFxudE516m43r_J8cj0DXXUEdg.png?1790320052)
3. Review the provided export prompt.
4. Tap **Copy** to copy the prompt. You can also select **Show more** to read the full prompt.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155081825606/original/FTBNHcs9DlvcxU_iJ3I20iWDIiST-zW1Fw.png?1790320076)
5. Open the AI assistant that already has the information you want to transfer, such as ChatGPT or Claude.
6. Paste and run the copied prompt.
7. Copy the assistant's complete response.

### **Step 2: Import the Response Into Ask AI**

1. Return to the **Import memories** workflow in the HighLevel mobile app.
2. Paste the complete response from the other AI assistant into the provided field.
3. Tap **Add to memory**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155081825647/original/IuZz6BoGFuPS8fsvBtJpkz76RtEl7gnMJA.png?1790320124)

Ask AI processes the pasted response and converts the relevant entries into saved memories. The importer removes common export formatting, such as dates, bullets, and headers, before saving individual memory entries.

---

## **Memory Scope and Sub-Accounts**

Understanding memory scope helps prevent context from different working environments from being mixed together. When working across sub-accounts, HighLevel loads the memories applicable to the current context rather than treating every sub-account as one shared memory environment.

When you switch sub-accounts, the Saved Memories screen reloads the memories for the applicable scope. This helps keep client and business context separated when you work across multiple sub-accounts.

Review the current sub-account before deleting, clearing, or importing memories so that you manage the intended memory set.

---

## **Ask AI Memory vs. Chat History**

Memory and Chat History serve different purposes in Ask AI. Understanding the difference makes it easier to decide whether you need to manage reusable context or simply return to an earlier conversation.

- **Saved Memories** contain reusable information that can provide context for future Ask AI conversations.
- **Chat History** lets you return to previous Ask AI conversations and review earlier messages.

Removing a saved memory is therefore different from managing an existing conversation in Chat History.

---

## **Ask AI Memory vs. Skills**

Memories and Skills can both make Ask AI more useful, but they serve different purposes. Memories provide reusable context about you and your work, while Skills provide reusable instructions or workflows for completing particular types of tasks.

Use **Memory** for information Ask AI may need to know across conversations, such as business context, preferences, or recurring details.

Use **Skills** when you want Ask AI to follow defined instructions or a repeatable workflow for a particular task.

For more information, see **[Ask AI Skills and Connectors](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000008434-ask-ai-skills-and-connectors)**.

---

## **How To Set Up and Manage Ask AI Memory on Mobile**

Properly reviewing and managing saved memories keeps the context available to Ask AI relevant to your current work. The HighLevel mobile app provides direct access to Memory Settings from Ask AI, where you can review existing information before deciding whether to search, delete, clear, or import memories.

1. Open the **HighLevel mobile app**.
2. Tap **Ask AI**.
3. Open **Chat History**.
4. Tap the **memory icon** in the header. The icon appears before **New chat**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155081825989/original/-XfA7ZS20jfUliW4x982GqZkrYPqk45o9A.png?1790320436)
5. Review the memories currently saved.
6. Use **Search** or the sort control to locate information when needed.
7. To remove one memory, tap its **trash** icon.
8. To remove all memories in the applicable scope, tap the **trash** icon in the header and confirm the action.
9. To transfer context from another AI assistant, tap **Import memories**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155081826061/original/9XWCAcu8vziTTdkwwgnie52QO442sqxMeQ.png?1790320473)
10. Copy the provided prompt and run it in the other AI assistant.
11. Copy the assistant's response and return to HighLevel.
12. Paste the complete response into the importer.
13. Tap **Add to memory**.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Does deleting a saved memory delete my Ask AI conversation?**  
No. Saved Memory and Chat History serve different purposes. Removing a saved memory removes that reusable memory entry rather than functioning as a Chat History deletion control.

**Q: Can I import information from ChatGPT or Claude?**  
Yes. The import workflow provides a prompt that you can run in another AI assistant. Copy that assistant's response and paste it back into HighLevel to convert the relevant information into Ask AI memories.

**Q: How many memories can I import at once?**  
Ask AI Memory supports importing up to 100 memories at once.

**Q: Do I need to manually remove bullets and dates from an imported response?**  
The mobile importer is designed to parse the export and remove common formatting such as dates, bullets, and headers before saving individual memory entries.

**Q: What happens to my memories when I switch sub-accounts?**  
The Saved Memories screen reloads the memories applicable to the selected sub-account context, helping keep separate working contexts from being mixed together.

**Q: Should I use a Memory or a Skill for reusable instructions?**  
Use Memory when Ask AI needs reusable context about you or your work. Use Skills when you want Ask AI to follow defined instructions or workflows for particular tasks.

**Q: Does Ask AI use every saved memory for every response?**  
No. The existing Memory V1 implementation uses the 20 most recent memories in AI requests. Saved information therefore should remain relevant and useful rather than being treated as an unlimited prompt containing every memory.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Ask AI Assistant](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005327/)
- [HighLevel Mobile App Experience](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000008398-highlevel-mobile-app-experience)
- [Ask AI Skills and Connectors](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000008434-ask-ai-skills-and-connectors)
- [The Revamped Mobile App Experience – Mobile v4.0.0](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000006707)

title_en: Set Up Your MarketplacApp Pricing
source_md:
Monetizing your app on the Highlevel developer app marketplace presents various avenues. This guide walks you through the options and tells you how to set them up.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [Where can I configure my app's pricing?](#Where-can-I-configure-my-app's-pricing?)
- [Select payment collection preference (Within the Highlevel platform, recommended)](#Select-payment-collection-preference-(Within-the-Highlevel-platform,-recommended))
- [External payment page (Not recommended)](#External-payment-page-(Not-recommended)%C2%A0)
- [What pricing models can I offer?](#What-pricing-models-can-I-offer?)
- [How to use it as a Developer?](#How-to-use-it-as-a-Developer?)
- [How to Use it as an Agency](#How-to-Use-it-as-an-Agency)
- [Reselling & markup behavior (agencies)](#Reselling-&-markup-behavior-(agencies))
- [Distribution Types and Pricing Models](#Distribution-Types-and-Pricing-Models)
- [Offering Free-trial](#Offering-Free-trial)
- [Key Points to Remember](#Key-Points-to-Remember)
- [Usage-based pricing](#Usage-based-pricing%C2%A0)
- [How your earnings are calculated](#How-your-earnings-are-calculated)
- [Earnings Dashboard](#Earnings-Dashboard)
- [Payout](#Payout)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)

---

## **Where can I configure my app's pricing?**

Log in to your [Marketplace - Developer account](https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/), click on your app and select the 'Pricing' option from the left menu.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155034622435/original/xppr0jO6LqPc7JuWCYBN4KN_bAw8tnB5Ng.png?1728892235)**

---

## **Payment Failure Recovery for Paid Apps**

Paid Marketplace apps now use a recovery flow when a charge fails. Instead of pausing the app immediately, HighLevel provides a 30-day grace period and attempts automatic retries during that time.

This helps reduce involuntary churn and gives users time to resolve billing issues before access is interrupted.

---

## **Select payment collection preference (Within the Highlevel platform, recommended)**

This method permits customers (both agencies and sub-accounts) to pay for the app within the HighLevel platform. We handle the payment processing and ensure timely payouts to developers.

1. Enable agencies to re-sell these apps to their end sub-accounts, enhancing wider adoption and engagement for your app
2. Use granular pricing modules offered by HighLevel Marketplace platform such as free-trials, etc.
3. Streamlined collection and reconciliation of payments.

---

## **External payment page (Not recommended)**

If you'd rather manage your app's pricing on your platform, choose this option and provide the redirect URL for your external payment page. Customers will get redirected to your payment page during the installation process and upon successful payment the app will be installed in their account.

Add the redirect URL for the payment page.

**Note:**

- Initially selecting an external payment page allows for later changes to the Highlevel platform. But, once live with internal payment collection, you cannot switch to an external page. Such a change necessitates deleting and recreating the app.
- Agencies cannot resell apps with external payment preference, which reduces your app's adoption chances.

---

## **What pricing models can I offer?**

Your app can have one of three pricing models, all of which are configurable using Pricing Plans:

1. Free
2. Paid - Subscription
3. Paid - One-time
4. Freemium - Combination of Free and Paid plans

You can optionally offer Free-trials on any of the above pricing models.

---

## **How to use it as a Developer?**

**A) Configure your billing meter**

- Go to App → Pricing → Billing Meters and create (or edit) a meter with Module Type = Custom Event (API).
- Set Price Type: Dynamic
- Enter Minimum and Maximum price, add a Pricing Page URL (recommended for transparency), and set a Default Price per Unit.
- Save changes.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155059526643/original/nmVf0EJvUoU0PbD-X8eIrV5hPcXzjBtr2Q.png?1764452995)

B) Charge the wallet via API

- Use the existing[Create Wallet Charge API](https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/marketplace/charge). Include the new, optional price field when you want to apply a dynamic per-unit price for that charge.
- If price is omitted, the meter’s Default Price per Unit is applied.

---

## **How to Use it as an Agency**

- In your app’s Pricing section, end users see the price range for dynamic meters and a link to the Pricing Page URL.
- **Visibility note**: The Pricing Page URL is visible to agency admins only, not to sub-accounts.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155059526677/original/9gvj0eyVVzq4GNTd2fNZb-C20RIZyxma6g.png?1764453310)

---

## **Reselling & markup behavior (agencies)**

- Agencies can configure a flat per-unit markup when reselling apps' service (app reselling).
- Because markups change effective end pricing, the Pricing Page URL is hidden from sub-accounts to avoid confusion.
- Example: If an SMS base price is $1.00 (UK) and $1.50 (France), an agency can add a $0.50 markup so sub-accounts pay $1.50 (UK) and $2.00 (France).

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155059526690/original/aqMQVwqhOu3K2FAyWm_D72UFuNyeitDvzg.png?1764453401)**

---

## **Distribution Types and Pricing Models**

To understand distribution types, [**please refer to this article**](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000002141-marketplace-app-distribution-type#Summary).

In this section, let's understand how you may customise your distribution type based on who you want to charge.

Let's assume that the agency in the following example has set a flat 5% markup on all Marketplace Apps.

|  |  |  |  |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Distribution Model** | **App Pricing Model (with example)** | **Agency pays** | **Sub-account Pays to agency** | **Developer Makes** |
| **Target User: Agency** | Monthly: $50/month | $50/month | - | $50/month |
| One-time: $50 | $50 One-time | - | $50 One-time |
| **Target User: Sub-account |** **Who can install? : Agency & Sub-account** | Monthly: $10/month | $10/month | $10.5/month | $10/month |
| One-time: $10 | $10 One-time | $10.5 One-time | $10 One-time |
| **Target User: Sub-account | Who can install? : Agency Only** | Monthly: $50/month | $50/month | **-** | $50/month |
| One-time: $50 | $50 One-time | - | $50 One-time |
| **Differential pricing enabled** ***(Monthly)***  Agency Price:$50/month  Sub-account Price: $10/month | $50/month + $10/month per sub-account | $10.5/month | **$50/month + $10/month per sub-account** |
| **Differential pricing enabled** ***(One-Time)***  Agency Price:$50  Sub-account Price: $10 | $50 One-time + $10 One-time per sub-account | $10.5 One-time | $50 One-time + $10 One-time per sub-account |

## 

Here's how you setup differential pricing for apps with **Target User: Sub-account |****Who can install? : Agency Only:**

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155034686628/original/mS_pY98lXhO1D7j7bF6F8mqCrHdO73QlDQ.jpeg?1728959419)**

---

## **Offering Free-trial**

**[동영상](https://www.youtube.com/embed/9NJ-lZvoRac?&wmode=opaque)**

Drive adoption of your app by offering free-trial - full-experience of the app for a limited duration of time.

You can offer anywhere between 1 - 90 days of free-trial to your users.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155030099991/original/hIs1ghkZosk4Ne8nnEWigzGTJZ-RgcSo_g.png?1722327989)**

The subscription will initiate automatically after the trial period ends.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155030100131/original/mqhcRPfmMCy3Mc65safT30BwLlJ67uS2OA.png?1722328082)**

---

## **Key Points to Remember**

1. Free trial config is at the app-level, and applies to all pricing plans in your app.
2. A user can avail free trial only once per app within a period of 90 days.
3. Your users will receive a notification a 24 hours before the trial period ends giving them a heads-up about the upcoming charges.
4. In case of payment failures after free-trial, GHL will notify the users and try to charge them again for 3 consecutive days. After 3 consecutive days of payment-failure, the app will be uninstalled from the user's account.
5. You can track free-trial period through [AppInstall webhook](https://highlevel.stoplight.io/docs/integrations/889f37581bd0e-o-auth-2-0) and [Get Installed Locations API](https://highlevel.stoplight.io/docs/integrations/aeed19d08490e-get-location-where-app-is-installed).

---

## **Usage-based pricing**

Here's a loom demonstrating the steps to configure Usage-based pricing on your marketplace apps.

[동영상](https://www.loom.com/embed/97028fefbf4f47a18fcf0d33e21480f8?sid=6ed8b513-6bae-4fde-aa12-dadc4776135c)

If your app has service whose price may vary, you can opt for dynamic pricing option.

[동영상](https://www.loom.com/embed/c2e0da536c1841ef97acd5d3399270a7?sid=092a8340-8f08-4f97-b759-164ac8a21b43)

```
IMPORTANT: Here's the link to API Docs for Usage-based Pricing.
```

---

## **How your earnings are calculated**

Your revenue stems from app installations on the Highlevel platform. We currently do not deduct any commission. You receive the entire payment from our customers. However, agencies can markup the price when reselling to sub-accounts. For instance:

Say, a Sub-account app is priced as follows:

- Developer Pricing: $10/month
- Agency Resale Price: $12/month

Here's how the resultant transactions when a sub-account installs the app:

- Sub-account Charge: $12/month
- Agency Charge: $10/month
- Developer Earnings: $10/month

---

## **Earnings Dashboard**

Track your revenue in the 'Earnings Dashboard'. For a live, paid app:

- Total Earnings: Cumulative earnings till date.
- Total Installs: Number of app installations.
- Active Accounts: Current active/installed accounts.
- Use the table below for detailed insights and apply filters as needed.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155010503781/original/5iwskODmD8lq09A6MWsLX3qzs2iJB7TQIQ.png?1697694564)**

---

## **Payout**

We've partnered with Tipalti to facilitate developer payouts, ensuring you have a smooth and efficient transaction process.

### **How Does the Payout Process Work?**

- Developer partners who are eligible for a payout will receive an email invitation to register with Tipalti. This 3-step registration process guides you through everything necessary to ensure compliance and to receive payouts from us.
- After your account is set up and ready, you will begin receiving payouts from Highlevel. The billing cycle is monthly, with payments sent on the 15th of each month for all earnings accrued in the previous month.

If you've already set up Tipalti and your payment status is marked as "submitted," then your payout is in process. Depending on your chosen payout method, you should expect to see the payment within 1-3 days.

To know more about how this works, click here - [Tipalti Payout Process](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001208136-affiliate-payouts-where-how-when-can-i-get-paid-)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: What is the purpose of the new “price” parameter in the API?**

It enables developers to set a dynamic per-unit charge during a billing event, allowing pricing to reflect current, variable service costs.

**Q: What happens if the “price” parameter is omitted from the API call?**

The system defaults to the Default Price per Unit previously configured for the billing meter.

**Q: How do agencies benefit from dynamic pricing?**

Agencies can use dynamic pricing to display a clear price range and configure flat markups on services, ensuring transparent and competitive pricing for sub-accounts.

**Q: Who can view the Pricing Page URL?**

The Pricing Page URL is visible solely to agency administrators, keeping pricing details clear and preventing confusion among sub-accounts.

**Q: Can dynamic pricing be applied to services beyond SMS?**

Yes, dynamic pricing is ideal for any service with variable costs, including telephony and other geo-based APIs.

**Q: What steps are involved in setting up a dynamic billing meter?**

You must configure the meter in HighLevel by selecting Dynamic as the Price Type, entering pricing limits and a Pricing Page URL, and integrating the updated API with the optional “price” parameter.

title_en: Jotform - Workflow Triggers and Actions
source_md:
Workflows • Integrations • Jotform

Jotform - Workflow Triggers and Actions

Connect Jotform with HighLevel Workflows to automate processes when form submissions or signed documents arrive. Jotform activity can start workflows in HighLevel, while the Create Submission action can write workflow data into a Jotform form. This guide explains how to connect Jotform, configure its triggers and action, map supported fields, and understand current limitations.

What You'll Learn

Learn how to connect Jotform to a sub-account, configure New Submission and New Signed Document triggers, create Jotform submissions from workflows, test trigger metadata, map supported fields, and avoid unsupported-field issues.

# What Is the Jotform Integration in Workflows?

The Jotform integration connects Jotform with HighLevel Workflows so activity can move between the two platforms without manually exporting or copying submission data.

Jotform activity can start a HighLevel workflow when a new form response is submitted or when a document containing an e-signature field is completed and signed.

HighLevel workflows can also use **Create Submission** to write supported workflow values into a selected Jotform form.

## Key Benefits of the Jotform Integration

The Jotform workflow integration helps automate follow-up and data movement while keeping the surrounding CRM automation inside HighLevel.

- **Respond to New Submissions Automatically:** Start a workflow when a new Jotform response is submitted.
- **Automate Signed-Document Follow-Up:** Start workflow processes after a Jotform document containing an e-signature is completed and signed.
- **Create Jotform Submissions From HighLevel:** Write workflow data into a selected form with the Create Submission action.
- **Reduce Manual Data Entry:** Map workflow values instead of copying information between platforms.
- **Support Internal or Offline Records:** Create Jotform submissions for information collected through another process.
- **Use Submission Data Later in the Workflow:** Test Jotform triggers to retrieve metadata that can be referenced by downstream workflow steps.

## Prerequisites and Limitations

Understanding the connection method, trigger timing, testing requirements, and supported field types helps prevent unexpected workflow behavior before you publish an automation.

- A Jotform account must be connected to the applicable HighLevel sub-account before its triggers or actions can run.
- Jotform connects through the integration flow using a Jotform API key.
- **New Submission** is webhook-based and starts when Jotform sends a new submission event.
- **New Signed Document** uses polling. HighLevel checks Jotform approximately every five minutes, so a short delay is expected.
- Run **Test Trigger** during trigger setup so HighLevel can retrieve metadata for use in later workflow steps.
- **Create Submission** supports 15 standard Jotform input types.
- Unsupported fields do not appear in the Create Submission mapping list.
- Unsupported fields are saved empty, including unsupported fields marked required in Jotform.
- A blank unsupported required field does not cause the workflow to raise an error; Jotform can still create and mark the submission active.
- Create Submission does not create or attach payment, amount, product, signature, or booked appointment information.
- Appointment fields do not reserve an appointment slot.
- **Assign Form** and **Assign Prefilled Form** are not included in this release.

## How To Set Up Jotform in Workflows

Connect the correct Jotform account before configuring a trigger or action so Workflow Builder can load the forms and fields available to that connection.

### Connect Jotform From Workflow Builder

Connecting from Workflow Builder is the most direct option when you are already creating the automation and need to configure a Jotform step.

1. From the **Sub-Account view**, go to **Automation → Workflows**.
2. Create a new workflow or open an existing workflow.
3. For a trigger, click **Add New Trigger**.
4. For an action, click the **+** button at the point where the action should run.
5. Search for **Jotform**.
6. Select the Jotform trigger or action you want to configure.

![Workflow Builder showing Jotform triggers and actions in search results](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155081328327/original/WfaUjnpefH9-AEg_J48DPfmRqFKIz45oVA.png?1789749957)

7. If Jotform is not already connected, click **Connect your account**.
8. Follow the connection instructions and provide the required Jotform API key.
9. Complete the connection.
10. Return to the workflow step and configure the required fields.

![Jotform connection flow showing the account connection and API key setup](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155081378691/original/Zj0a0qxbrtzpQu_bfPLfnhE44ErwMNzlKA.png?1789890869)

### Connect Jotform From Settings

Connecting through Integrations is useful when you want the Jotform account ready before you begin building the workflow.

1. From the **Sub-Account view**, open **Settings**.
2. Select **Integrations**.
3. Locate **Jotform**.
4. Start the connection process.
5. Provide the required Jotform API key and complete the connection.
6. Return to **Automation → Workflows** and add the required Jotform trigger or action.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155081931247/original/_Cxj0IUA9z_twa9v_kaWA5Zu7i5DqAB2ng.png?1790471272)

## Jotform Triggers

Jotform triggers allow activity in Jotform to start a HighLevel workflow. The two available triggers use different delivery methods, so their expected timing is different.

### New Submission

New Submission uses a webhook so Jotform can notify HighLevel when a new response is submitted to the selected form.

1. Go to **Automation → Workflows** and create or open a workflow.
2. Click **Add New Trigger**.
3. Search for **Jotform** and select **New Submission**.
4. Connect the Jotform account if required.
5. Give the trigger a name and complete the required configuration.
6. Select the applicable Jotform form.
7. Click **Test Trigger** and review the test data returned from Jotform.
8. Click **Save trigger**.
9. Add the downstream workflow actions and publish the workflow when it is ready.

![Jotform workflow trigger configuration showing the selected form and Test Trigger control](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155081380011/original/jOC7nSGrMQtc21d9ceWh7vWMLtBUVE663w.png?1789895443)

**Why testing matters:** Test Trigger retrieves Jotform metadata so supported submission values can become available for use in later workflow steps.

### New Signed Document

New Signed Document starts a workflow after a Jotform document containing an e-signature field is completed and signed. This trigger uses polling rather than the webhook delivery used by New Submission.

1. Go to **Automation → Workflows** and create or open a workflow.
2. Click **Add New Trigger**.
3. Search for **Jotform** and select **New Signed Document**.
4. Connect the Jotform account if required.
5. Give the trigger a name and complete its required configuration.
6. Select the applicable Jotform form or document context presented by the trigger.
7. Click **Test Trigger** to retrieve available metadata.
8. Click **Save trigger**.
9. Add the workflow actions and publish the workflow when it is ready.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155081931183/original/4I9qqwkCHW4fuKWFCeQAYtqWHlDStrAHlA.png?1790471052)

**Timing:** HighLevel checks Jotform approximately every five minutes for newly signed documents, so a short delay between signing and workflow enrollment is expected.

## Create Submission Action

Create Submission lets a HighLevel workflow write a new submission directly into a selected Jotform form. This is useful when information begins in HighLevel but should also be recorded in Jotform.

1. Go to **Automation → Workflows** and create or open the workflow.
2. Add or configure the trigger that should start the workflow.
3. Click the **+** button where the Jotform action should run.
4. Search for **Jotform**.
5. Select **Create Submission**.
6. Connect the Jotform account if it is not already connected.
7. Select the Jotform form that should receive the submission.
8. Allow HighLevel to load the supported fields from the selected form.
9. Map each available field using static text or an applicable workflow custom value.
10. Use **YYYY-MM-DD** for Date Picker values.
11. Use **HH:MM** for Time values.
12. Review the mappings and save the action.
13. Publish the workflow when the complete automation is ready.

![Jotform Create Submission action showing supported form fields available for workflow mapping](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155081380087/original/IE-tfHEF3FvI-qNujTF5ZlC-lHXRpmMfJg.png?1789895791)

## Supported Fields in Create Submission

Create Submission only displays Jotform field types that HighLevel can populate. Reviewing field support before choosing a form helps prevent unexpected blank values in the resulting submission.

| Supported Field | Mapping Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| Full Name | Maps first and last name separately |
| Email | Supported |
| Address | Maps address line, city, state, postal code, and country separately |
| Phone | Supported |
| Short Text | Supported |
| Long Text | Supported |
| Number | Supported |
| Dropdown | Supported |
| Single Choice | Supported |
| Multiple Choice | Supported |
| Yes / No | Appears as a dropdown in the action |
| Star Rating | Appears as a dropdown in the action |
| Scale Rating | Appears as a dropdown in the action |
| Date Picker | Use YYYY-MM-DD |
| Time | Use HH:MM |

Supported fields can be populated with static text or applicable workflow custom values.

### Unsupported Fields

Unsupported field types do not appear in the Create Submission mapping list. If the selected form contains one of these fields, Create Submission leaves that field empty.

- File Upload
- Signature
- Appointment
- Payment
- Product List
- Input Table
- Fill in the Blanks
- Spinner
- Emoji Slider
- Image Choice
- Captcha
- Widgets, including Terms and Conditions, Checklist, Configurable List, Multi Text List, Dynamic Text Box, and Calculation

If an unsupported field is marked required in Jotform, the submission can still be created and marked active with that field blank. The workflow does not raise an error because the unsupported required field was left empty.

**Important:** Create Submission does not process a payment, attach a payment amount or product, generate a signature, or reserve an appointment slot. If you use Create Submission with a form that normally collects payment, do not treat the resulting submission as proof of payment unless payment was confirmed separately.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Why is there a delay after a Jotform document is signed?

New Signed Document uses polling. HighLevel checks Jotform approximately every five minutes, so a short delay is expected.

Q: Why should I use Test Trigger during setup?

Testing retrieves metadata from Jotform so supported submission values can be referenced in later workflow steps.

Q: Why is a field from my Jotform form missing from Create Submission?

Unsupported field types do not appear in the mapping list and cannot be populated by Create Submission.

Q: What happens if an unsupported field is required in Jotform?

Create Submission leaves the unsupported field empty. Jotform can still accept and mark the submission active, so the workflow does not fail because that required unsupported field is blank.

Q: Why can New Signed Document work with signatures when Create Submission cannot fill a signature field?

The trigger detects a document that a person has already signed in Jotform. Create Submission writes data into a form and cannot generate a person's signature, so Signature fields remain unsupported.

Q: Can Create Submission process a Jotform payment?

No. It does not create payment, amount, or product information. A submission created in a payment form should not be treated as proof that payment occurred.

Q: Can Create Submission send a Jotform form to someone to complete?

No. Create Submission writes a submission directly into Jotform. It does not send a form to another person for completion.

Q: What formats should I use for Date Picker and Time fields?

Use **YYYY-MM-DD** for Date Picker values and **HH:MM** for Time values.

title_en: Agent Logs Metrics
source_md:
Agent Logs Metrics is a dashboard inside Agent Logs that helps you measure AI agent activity using widgets, filters, and saved layouts. Instead of reviewing one conversation at a time, it gives you a broader view of performance, efficiency, and activity across your AI operations. This makes it easier to spot trends, monitor workload, and identify areas that may need optimization.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Agent Logs Metrics?](#What-is-Agent-Logs-Metrics?)
- [Key Benefits of Agent Logs Metrics](#Key-Benefits-of-Agent-Logs-Metrics)
- [Dashboard Layouts and Widgets](#Dashboard-Layouts-and-Widgets)
  - [Default Layouts](#Default-Layouts%E2%80%8B)
  - [Templates and Custom Layouts](#Templates-and-Custom-Layouts)
  - [Pre-built and Custom Widgets](#Pre-built-and-Custom-Widgets)
- [Key Metrics and Operational Insights](#Key-Metrics-and-Operational-Insights)
- [How To Setup Agent Logs Metrics](#How-To-Setup-Agent-Logs-Metrics)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is Agent Logs Metrics?**

Agent Logs Metrics helps you track how your AI agents are performing over time with a flexible dashboard inside HighLevel. You can monitor conversation volume, message activity, response speed, and operational trends without reviewing each interaction individually. With customizable widgets, filters, and auto-refresh, it becomes easier to understand agent performance and make informed improvements.

Agent Logs Metrics is useful when you need a higher-level view than session or execution logs can provide. While detailed logs help you review individual interactions and execution steps, Metrics helps you track overall performance across agents, channels, and AI activity from one dashboard.

---

## **Key Benefits of Agent Logs Metrics**

Agent Logs Metrics helps teams move from reviewing individual logs to monitoring performance at scale. This gives you a faster way to identify trends, compare activity, and focus your optimization efforts where they matter most.

- **Centralized visibility:** Track AI activity from one dashboard instead of reviewing conversations one by one.
- **Custom monitoring views:** Build layouts around the metrics that matter most to your team or workflow.
- **Faster issue detection:** Use performance and activity widgets to spot unusual trends, latency concerns, or heavy tool usage more quickly.
- **Better optimization decisions:** Compare trends over time and use detailed logs when a metric needs deeper investigation.
- **Real-time awareness:** Use auto-refresh intervals to keep the dashboard current during active monitoring.

---

## **Dashboard Layouts and Widgets**

The Agent Logs Metrics page includes default layouts and customizable layouts for tracking AI agent activity. You can view preconfigured metrics or create layouts that focus on the information you want to monitor.

### **Default Layouts**

### 

Three default layouts are available in the layout dropdown:

- Conversation AI: View chat volume, human handovers, follow-ups, and busiest hours.
- Voice AI: Monitor call volume, call outcomes, sentiment, and reasons calls end.
- Managed Agents: Review conversations handled, contacts reached, and agent response times.

These layouts display a Default label. You can view them, but you cannot edit or delete them.

To customize your dashboard, create a separate layout using a template or an empty canvas.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083770046/original/rv3zEsrOwxngP-ID1zMmHXbOgDITbCstPg.gif?1792504001)

### **Templates and Custom Layouts**

Custom layouts let you organize widgets around specific reporting needs. Unlike default layouts, you can edit, rename, rearrange, and delete layouts you create.

When creating a layout, choose one of these options:

- Start with a template: Begin with a predefined collection of widgets. You can remove widgets, rearrange them, and add more before saving.
- Start from scratch: Begin with an empty canvas and add only the widgets you need.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083771568/original/PcnorL3ZVOn9SRo38zu8prUcqHWq07XDFg.gif?1792504553)

### **Pre-built and Custom Widgets**

Use Add Widget to add widgets to a custom layout.

Pre-built widgets provide existing metrics and visualizations. Browse the available categories, search for a widget, or filter by widget type, including numbers, charts, and tables.

Custom metrics let you define your own visualization using the metrics available in Agent Logs.

With custom metrics, you can:

- Give a metric a title.
- Choose a line, bar, pie, donut, heatmap, or table visualization.
- Select the metric you want to track.
- Filter data by agent, channel, AI product, or tool.
- Configure supported chart breakdowns and time intervals.
- Preview the visualization before adding it to your layout.

After adding widgets to a custom layout, you can rearrange them and save your changes.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083771673/original/w2I7HbpXTZHohABo3DtHAkZe0_zHWpQTlA.gif?1792504609)

---

## **Key Metrics and Operational Insights**

The Metrics tab includes widgets that help you understand both activity levels and operational performance. These widgets make it easier to identify patterns, compare trends, and decide where to focus your attention.

These widgets are designed to help you monitor trends quickly. When you need deeper analysis, you can use detailed logs and debugging tools to investigate individual conversations, actions, or execution paths.

| Metric | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Conversations Handled | The total number of AI conversations processed during the selected time range. |
| AI Messages | The total number of messages generated by AI agents. |
| Average Messages per Conversation | The average number of messages exchanged within each conversation. |
| Avg Response Time | The average time an AI agent takes to respond. |
| Top Agents | A view of the agents with the highest activity in the selected range. |
| Top Actions | A summary of the most frequently used actions and their average execution latency. |
| Busiest Hours | A breakdown of the times of day when conversation activity is highest. |
| Channel Activity | A view of how activity changes across supported communication channels over time. |

## 

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155069689627/original/fCe7-G56GyFy-pKI7VtYgOesUop2Dsuc6A.gif?1776854053)

---

## **How To Setup Agent Logs Metrics**

Proper setup helps ensure your dashboard reflects the right data, metrics, and monitoring priorities for your team. Once your layout and filters are configured, you can reuse them to support daily reporting, live monitoring, and optimization work.

1. **Open Agent Logs and select the Metrics tab**  
   Open **AI Agents > Agent Logs** in your HighLevel account, then choose the **Metrics** tab to access the dashboard.

   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155069687895/original/VEaubx_1ycm2WazNhf2PZ8geNsjEFTFt4Q.png?1776852944)
2. **Choose your filter scope**  
   Set the **filters** for the data you want to analyze. You can narrow the dashboard by **Time Range, Agents, AI Products, Channels,**and**Contacts.**  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155069687947/original/eutltFnMtBl-wfVzBGq__v1UZMRVsAKG4Q.gif?1776852979)
3. **Create or select a custom layout**  
   Open the layout dropdown and select **Add Layout** to create a layout.  
   Choose a template to begin with preconfigured widgets, or select **Start from scratch** to begin with an empty canvas.  
   The three default layouts: Conversation AI, Voice AI, and Managed Agents—are read-only. Create a custom layout to make changes.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083772464/original/hjWV3Tyv6-HOmPYIfV6jbeG4qBjIW3Ef7g.gif?1792504970)
4. **Customise and Save your layout**  
   Use Edit Layout to customise a layout you created.  
     
   Select Add Widget add pre-built widgets or **custom metrics.**  
   Remove widgets you don't need  
   Drag and drop widgets to rearrange them  
   Resize widgets to organise your dashboard  
     
   Select save changes when you finish customising your layout  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083774344/original/f9SJr7zSMVywPHvsF6o_0EWU-sIBeuJ_Xg.gif?1792505570)
5. **Set auto-refresh when monitoring live activity**  
   Choose an auto-refresh interval of **30 seconds, 1 minute, 5 minutes, or 15 minutes**depending on how actively you need to watch the dashboard or click the refresh icon to update instantly.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155069688481/original/oQMRlaiu2cthbnnIOUg_BE8kxV6-TbGCoA.png?1776853359)
6. **Use Sessions for deeper investigation**When a dashboard trend needs closer review, open **Agent Logs > Sessions** to examine the conversation behind the metric. This gives you more context into what the AI agent handled, how the interaction progressed, and where you may want to investigate further. For more information, refer to [Agent Logs Overview](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000007657-agent-logs-overview)  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155069689467/original/5esSGh6SmqTPbdOqTqXITFxcFvxvotmWmg.png?1776853967)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: What is the difference between Agent Logs Metrics and Agent Logs Sessions?**  
Agent Logs Metrics gives you an aggregated dashboard view of performance and activity, while session and execution logs are used to inspect individual interactions or execution steps in more detail.

**Q: Which filters are available in Agent Logs Metrics?**  
You can filter by Time Range, Agents, AI Products, Channels, and Contacts.

**Q: Can I customize the dashboard layout?**

Yes. You can create custom layouts from templates or from scratch. Use Edit Layout to add, remove, rearrange, and resize widgets in layouts you create. The three default layouts are read-only.

**Q: Can I save different dashboard views?**

Yes. You can save multiple custom layouts and switch between them using the layout dropdown. You can also rename and delete layouts you created.

**Q: Can I edit or delete the default Conversation AI, Voice AI, and Managed Agents layouts?**

No. These three layouts are included by default and cannot be edited or deleted. To customize your Metrics dashboard, create a separate layout.

**Q: Can I create a chart using metrics that are not available as pre-built widgets?**

Yes. Select Add Widget, then Create new metric under Custom metrics. Choose an available measurement, select a chart type, configure the supported filters and breakdowns, and preview the result before adding it to your layout.

**Q: Does Agent Logs Metrics refresh automatically?**  
Yes. Auto-refresh options include 30 seconds, 1 minute, 5 minutes, and 15 minutes.

**Q: What should I do if I notice a performance issue in Metrics?**  
Use the dashboard to identify the trend first, then open the relevant logs or debugging tools for more detailed analysis.

**Q: Can I create metrics that are not available as pre-built widgets?**

Yes. Use Custom metrics in Add Widget to create visualizations using available measurements, chart types, filters, and breakdowns.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Agent Logs Overview](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000007657-agent-logs-overview?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- [Conversation AI Agents Dashboard](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005427-conversation-ai-agents-dashboard?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- [Voice AI Agents Dashboard for HighLevel](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000004693-voice-ai-agents-dashboard?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- [How to Test and Debug AI Conversations in Agent Studio](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000007425-how-to-test-and-debug-ai-conversations-in-agent-studio?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- [AI Action Logging & Filtering in Conversations](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005004-ai-action-logging-filtering-in-conversations?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

title_en: View Appointments in Your Preferred Timezone on the Mobile App
source_md:
Appointment timezone preferences let you control how appointment times appear across the HighLevel mobile app. You can view appointments in your user timezone, the business timezone, or a custom timezone without changing booking availability or how clients schedule with you. This helps teams working across regions reduce timezone confusion and manage appointments more confidently from mobile.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is View Appointments in Your Preferred Timezone on the Mobile App?](#What-is-View-Appointments-in-Your-Preferred-Timezone-on-the-Mobile-App?)
- [Key Benefits of View Appointments in Your Preferred Timezone](#Key-Benefits-of-View-Appointments-in-Your-Preferred-Timezone)
- [Where the Timezone Preference Applies in the Mobile App](#Where-the-Timezone-Preference-Applies-in-the-Mobile-App)
- [Important Timezone Behavior to Know](#Important-Timezone-Behavior-to-Know)
- [How To Setup View Appointments in Your Preferred Timezone](#How-To-Setup-View-Appointments-in-Your-Preferred-Timezone)
- [Mobile App Availability](#Mobile-App-Availability)
- [Backward Compatibility from the Previous Labs Toggle](#Backward-Compatibility-from-the-Previous-Labs-Toggle)
- [Troubleshooting Timezone Display Issues](#Troubleshooting-Timezone-Display-Issues)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

# **What is View Appointments in Your Preferred Timezone on the Mobile App?**

View Appointments in Your Preferred Timezone is a user-level calendar preference that controls how appointment times display across supported appointment areas in the HighLevel mobile app. This setting helps each user view appointments in the timezone that makes the most sense for their workflow while keeping booking rules, availability, and client scheduling behavior unchanged.

With this preference, appointment times can display using one of the following options:

- **User Timezone:** Displays appointments in your personal account timezone.
- **Business Timezone:** Displays appointments in the timezone configured for the sub-account.
- **Custom Timezone:** Displays appointments in any timezone you select.

This preference applies to the logged-in user only. Other team members can choose their own timezone view independently.

1. Open the mobile Calendar

Open the HighLevel mobile app and tap Calendar in the bottom navigation.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077112534/original/tR8XAfFni8KrHtn5yxn-JiHzIXwuIvmqIA.png?1785316962)

2.Review appointments in Calendar view

Your appointments will now display in the selected timezone. The timezone abbreviation appears beside each appointment time.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077108429/original/uMEwQAmTSnnu3ZIyHk7kKg3v5DzUfCGAJA.png?1785315053)**

## **Key Benefits of View Appointments in Your Preferred Timezone**

Timezone preferences make appointment management easier for users who work with clients, teams, or calendars across multiple regions. Instead of manually converting appointment times, each user can choose the timezone view that matches how they plan their day.

- **Flexible timezone viewing:** View appointments in your user timezone, business timezone, or a custom timezone.
- **Reduced scheduling confusion:** Avoid manually converting appointment times when working across regions.
- **User-specific control:** Each team member can choose their own preferred appointment viewing timezone.
- **Consistent mobile experience:** Appointment times display according to your preference across supported mobile appointment screens.
