### 

### **FAQs**

**Question:** What is the Neo Group View Template, and how does it improve group management?

**Answer:** The Neo Group View Template is our more advanced version of the Calendar widget designed to make group management easier. It offers a more polished and visually appealing group view, simplifying the user experience for both administrators and end users.

**Question:** How can I access the Neo Group View Template in my calendar settings?

**Answer:** To access the Neo Group View Template, go to your Calendar Settings and select the "Templates" dropdown. Here, you can choose between the "Classic" and "Neo" templates for your groups.

**Question:** What are the key features of the Neo Group View Template?

**Answer:** The Neo Group View Template offers several key features, including staff selection for services, a sophisticated design, calendar-specific images, and a streamlined flow of information. These features aim to improve the overall group experience.

**Question:** How do I create a group using the Neo Group View Template?

**Answer:** To create a group with the Neo Template, follow these steps: Access Calendar Settings, select Groups, click on "Create Group," choose the "Neo" template, fill in group details, and click "Create."

**Question:** Can I switch between the "Classic" and "Neo" templates after creating a group?

**Answer:** Yes, you can switch between templates even after creating a group. Simply access the group's settings and choose your preferred template.

**Question:** How do I upload a cover image for a calendar using the Neo Template?

**Answer:** To upload a calendar cover image, access Calendar Settings, click on "Edit Calendar" (for an existing calendar) or proceed to "Advanced Settings" when creating a new calendar. In the "Customization" tab, you'll find an option to upload a calendar cover image.

**Question:**Why is it recommended to add a calendar cover image when using the Neo Template?

**Answer:** Adding a calendar cover image enhances the visual appeal and professionalism of your calendar, making it more engaging for users. This visual enhancement aligns well with the Neo Template's modern and polished design.

title_en: Two-Way Campaign Sync in Ad Manager (Meta Ads)
source_md:
Meta Ads two-way sync lets you import existing supported Meta campaigns into HighLevel Ad Manager and keep eligible changes updated across both platforms. Manage campaign settings, monitor performance, and choose which campaigns to sync without rebuilding them. Learn how to enable synchronization, adjust preferences, and manage imported campaigns.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Meta Ads Two-Way Sync?](#%E2%80%8B%E2%80%8BWhat-is-Meta-Ads-Two-Way-Sync?)
- [Campaign Synchronization Options](#Campaign-Synchronization-Options)
- [Campaign Origin and Visibility in Ad Manager](#Campaign-Origin-and-Visibility-in-Ad-Manager)
- [Synchronization Timing and Manual Refresh](#Synchronization-Timing-and-Manual-Refresh)
- [How to Enable Sync for a New Meta Ad Account](#How-to-Enable-Sync-for-a-New-Meta-Ad-Account)
- [How to Enable Sync for an Already Connected Meta Ad Account](#How-to-Enable-Sync-for-an-Already-Connected-Meta-Ad-Account)
- [How to Refresh Synced Campaigns](#How-to-Refresh-Synced-Campaigns)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

## **What is Meta Ads Two-Way Sync?**

[동영상](https://jumpshare.com/embed/j6WwEKqB5UeY6VK5vFID)

Meta Ads Two-Way Sync connects HighLevel Ad Manager with Meta Ads Manager, allowing supported campaign information to stay synchronized across both platforms. This gives advertisers the flexibility to create or manage campaigns in either platform while maintaining a centralized view of their advertising activity in HighLevel.

When you connect a Meta ad account and configure synchronization preferences, HighLevel automatically imports eligible existing Meta campaigns, including their supported ad sets and ads.

After synchronization is enabled:

- Campaigns created in Meta Ads Manager can appear in HighLevel Ad Manager.
- Changes to supported campaign fields made in HighLevel or Meta Ads Manager synchronize in both directions.
- Imported campaigns can be opened in HighLevel's existing campaign builder for supported editing operations.
- Campaigns created in HighLevel and campaigns imported from Meta can be viewed and monitored together.
- Synchronization runs automatically in the background, with manual refresh available when needed.

```
Important: Two-way synchronization applies only to campaign objectives, configurations, and fields supported by HighLevel Ad Manager. Advanced Meta-only settings remain managed in Meta Ads Manager and are not overwritten by synchronization.
```

---

## **Campaign Synchronization Options**

Selecting the appropriate synchronization preferences helps you control which existing Meta campaigns are brought into HighLevel. You can import all supported campaigns, focus on recently updated campaigns, or define specific statuses and time ranges that align with your advertising workflow.

HighLevel offers three campaign synchronization options:

| Option | Description | Configuration |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **All Existing Campaigns** | Syncs all eligible Meta campaigns. | No filters required. |
| **Last X Days Only** | Syncs eligible campaigns updated within the selected period. | Enter the number of days (e.g., 14). |
| **Custom** | Syncs campaigns matching selected filters. | Choose statuses (Published, Paused, In review, With issues, Rejected) and a time range (Any time or Last X days). |

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083699200/original/FC0h8obclApoRGNtVFF0BjOF81FRh58Knw.png?1792437853)

### **Campaign Selection Count**

The synchronization window displays an estimated number of campaigns matching your selection. This helps you review the expected import scope before starting synchronization.   
  
Unsupported campaign objectives are excluded from synchronization, even when they match your selected status and date filters.

---

## **Campaign Origin and Visibility in Ad Manager**

Campaign origin indicators help you distinguish campaigns originally created in HighLevel from those imported from Meta Ads Manager. This is especially useful when multiple team members manage campaigns across both platforms and need to understand where each campaign was initially created.

HighLevel organizes campaigns into the following views:

- All Campaigns: Displays campaigns created in HighLevel and eligible campaigns synchronized from Meta.
- Created in HighLevel: Displays campaigns originally created using HighLevel Ad Manager.
- Synced from Meta: Displays campaigns originally created in Meta Ads Manager and imported into HighLevel.

Campaigns also display an origin indicator in the campaign listing. The Created in column identifies the campaign's original platform. For campaigns imported from Meta, hovering over the Meta indicator displays additional information about their origin.  
  
![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083698606/original/dSHFEW9Af5seBtKLV7aBu66rzdoBQfY8eQ.png?1792436759)

```
Note: A campaign's origin badge remains unchanged, regardless of whether the campaign is later edited in HighLevel or Meta Ads Manager.
```

---

## **Synchronization Timing and Manual Refresh**

Automatic synchronization keeps supported campaign information updated without requiring users to manually import campaigns after every change. Because synchronization operates in the background, understanding refresh behavior helps you distinguish normal processing delays from issues that require attention.

| Method | How It Works | Action |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Automatic Sync** | Syncs supported changes near real-time, with automatic retries for failures. | No action required. |
| **Manual Refresh** | Pulls the latest Meta campaign updates on demand. | Ad Manager → Campaigns → Refresh. |
| **Edit Sync Preferences** | Syncs using updated filters while retaining previously imported campaigns. | Settings → Meta → Ad account → Edit sync settings → Save and sync. |

---

## **How to Enable Sync for a New Meta Ad Account**

1. Go to Marketing > Ad Manager in your HighLevel sub-account.
2. Follow the setup prompts to connect your Facebook profile and select your Meta ad account.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083698872/original/S0DOdgWhYDJl2zuCWNkMxLGkL_u78lTo4g.png?1792437270)
3. Enable Choose which campaigns to sync.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083698907/original/eEjLAbooIFTRL9bX813X9M6K4i0jNwyLMQ.png?1792437285)
4. Select which campaigns to import:  
     
   - All existing campaigns: Sync all supported campaigns, regardless of status.
   - Last X days only: Sync campaigns updated within your selected number of days.
   - Custom: Choose specific campaign statuses and a time range.
5. Connect your Facebook Page and complete the account setup.

Your selected campaigns will begin syncing automatically in the background.

---

## **How to Enable Sync for an Already Connected Meta Ad Account**

If your Meta ad account is already connected, you can enable campaign sync from Ad Manager settings.

1. Go to Marketing > Ad Manager > Settings > Platform settings > Meta > Ad account.
2. Find your connected Meta ad account and enable the Sync campaigns toggle. Click on Edit Sync settings.
3. Choose which campaigns you want to sync.
4. Click Save and sync.

HighLevel will begin importing the selected campaigns while you continue using Ad Manager.  
  
![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083699019/original/sJQoevgklgHabDydxIcOm9k73Jsv85O2Hw.png?1792437418)

---

## **How to Refresh Synced Campaigns**

1. Go to Marketing > Ad Manager > Campaigns.
2. Click the Refresh icon above the campaign list to pull the latest changes from Meta.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083699013/original/VfziDEx0FYEnu-nvsQaSFhkA9S5s8BhOkg.png?1792437404)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Why isn't one of my existing Meta campaigns appearing in HighLevel after synchronization?**

Confirm that the correct Meta ad account is connected and that the campaign matches your selected status and date filters. Campaigns with unsupported objectives are not imported. If the campaign is eligible, allow the background sync to complete and use Refresh to check for updates.

**Q: Can I view performance statistics for campaigns synced from Meta?**

Yes. Meta-synced campaigns appear in HighLevel Ad Manager Statistics alongside campaigns created in HighLevel, allowing you to monitor their performance in one place.

**Q: Why are some fields unavailable when I edit an imported Meta campaign?**

The campaign may contain advanced Meta configurations or settings that HighLevel does not support for editing. Some fields are also restricted after publication. Manage unsupported settings directly in Meta Ads Manager.

**Q: Does two-way campaign synchronization also support Google Ads?**

No. This release provides two-way campaign synchronization for Meta Ads Manager. Google Ads two-way synchronization is planned separately and is not included in this release.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Connecting Facebook Business Account to Ad Manager](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000002434-connecting-facebook-business-account-to-ad-manager)
- [How to Get Started with Meta Campaigns in Ad Manager](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000003044-connect-facebook-with-ad-manager)
- [Ad Manager - Create New Facebook Ad Campaigns](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000002435-create-new-ad-campaign-in-ad-manager)
- [Editing a Published or In-Review Meta Ad Campaigns](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000004436)
- [Ad Manager - Statistics of Ad Campaigns](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000003631-ad-manager-statistics-of-ad-campaigns)

title_en: Create and Use Voice AI Voice Cloning
source_md:
Create natural, on-brand Voice AI Agents by cloning a real human voice directly inside HighLevel. Voice AI voice cloning lets you upload or record a short audio sample, choose a target voice provider, and save the cloned voice inside My Voices. Once the clone is ready, you can assign it to a Voice AI Agent from the same Voice Selection experience used for other custom voices.

```
IMPORTANT: Voice AI - Clone Voice is currently available in Labs. If you don’t see it, ask an admin to enable it at Agency Settings > Labs. For more, refer to Labs Features - Complete Overview.
```

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Voice AI Voice Cloning?](#%E2%80%8B%E2%80%8BWhat-is-Voice-AI-Voice-Cloning?)
- [Key Benefits of Voice AI Voice Cloning](#Key-Benefits-of-Voice-AI-Voice-Cloning)
- [My Voices and the Cloned Voices Library](#My-Voices-and-the-Cloned-Voices-Library)
- [Audio Sample Requirements](#Audio-Sample-Requirements)
- [Processing, Previewing, and Failed Clones](#Processing,-Previewing,-and-Failed-Clones)
- [How To Setup Voice AI Voice Cloning](#How-To-Setup-Voice-AI-Voice-Cloning)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

## **What is Voice AI Voice Cloning?**

Voice AI voice cloning helps your agents sound more aligned with your brand by turning a real speaker’s audio sample into a reusable custom voice. This makes it easier to create a consistent calling experience without relying only on stock catalog voices or managing cloning tools outside HighLevel.

Voice AI voice cloning lets you create a cloned voice for Voice AI Agents directly from the My Voices area in Voice Selection. Instead of only importing an existing custom voice, you can now use **Add Custom Voice → Clone** to upload or record a sample, name the voice, choose a target provider, and submit the clone for processing.

---

## **Key Benefits of Voice AI Voice Cloning**

- **Branded, recognizable agents:** Create a cloned voice that reflects your company, team, spokesperson, or preferred customer-facing tone.
- **Organized custom voice library:** View cloned voices in their own collapsible Cloned Voices section alongside Imported Voices.
- **Clear processing status:** Submitted clones appear right away with a visible processing state, so you can track when the voice is being created.
- **Recoverable failures:** If a clone fails, the failed entry remains visible with a retry path, helping you correct the sample and try again.
- **Reusable agent voice option:** Once the cloned voice is ready, assign it to a Voice AI Agent from the same Voice Selection flow used for other voices.

---

## **My Voices and the Cloned Voices Library**

My Voices is the custom voice library used in the Voice Selection experience for Voice AI Agents. With voice cloning enabled, cloned voices and imported voices are organized in the same area so users can manage custom voice options from one place.

Inside **Voice Selection → My Voices**, custom voices are organized into collapsible sections:

- **Imported Voices:** Custom voices imported into HighLevel from supported import flows.
- **Cloned Voices:** Voices created from an uploaded or recorded audio sample using the Clone flow.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155071702930/original/XzjV-HRdYq_suPnB-EdB3M3rFnEdvY48bg.png?1779202214)

Imported and cloned voices share the same custom voice library experience. Imported and cloned voices also share a combined limit of **10 voices per company**, so plan your cloned voices carefully before submitting new samples.

---

## **Audio Sample Requirements**

The quality of the cloned voice depends heavily on the quality of the source audio. A clean recording with one speaker gives the cloning process the best chance of creating a usable, natural-sounding voice.

Supported audio formats:

- `.mp3`
- `.wav`
- `.m4a`
- `.ogg`
- `.webm`
- `.mp4`

Maximum file size:

- **10 MB or smaller**

---

## **Processing, Previewing, and Failed Clones**

Cloned voices are not instantly ready after submission. HighLevel adds the new voice to the Cloned Voices section with a processing state so users can confirm the request was submitted and monitor its progress.

After you click **Save**, the cloned voice appears under **My Voices → Cloned Voices**. While the voice is being created, it shows a processing state.

Once the voice is ready, you can select it from the Cloned Voices section and assign it to a Voice AI Agent. If the clone fails, it remains visible in the list with a retry path so you can adjust the source sample and try again.

Common reasons a clone may fail or produce poor results include:

- Background noise
- Multiple speakers
- Very low recording volume
- Echo or poor microphone quality
- Unsupported file format
- File size above 10 MB

---

## **How To Setup Voice AI Voice Cloning**

A complete setup includes enabling creating the cloned voice, waiting for processing, and assigning the finished voice to an agent. Following the full workflow helps ensure the cloned voice is available in the right place before testing live call behavior.

1. Open the target sub-account. Go to **AI Agents → Voice AI → Agent List**. Open or create a Voice AI Agent.  
     
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155071701629/original/JegQQIWvIbbH-Khy1eNGjQzyMEiTkjeVmQ.png?1779201707)
2. Click the agent’s current voice to open **Voice Selection**.  
     
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155071701740/original/COGkXkf2FdgQqs6YUCi3yK1GEV3v0o6Lxg.png?1779201727)
3. Go to the **My Voices** tab. Click **Add Custom Voice**. Select **Clone**from the dropdown.  
     
   **Import** uses the existing custom voice import flow.  
     
   **Clone** opens the Clone Voice modal to create a new voice from an audio sample.  
     
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155071701809/original/2TKpF8gsZXLlpRpUvAHaP2DDKUEs4XMPgg.png?1779201748)
4. In the **Clone Voice** modal  
     
   1. Enter a clear **Voice Name**, such as “Front Desk - Emma” or “Founder Voice.”  
     
   2. Select a **Target Voice Provider**:  
     
   **ElevenLabs**  
     
   **Cartesia**  
     
   3. Add a **Source Audio Sample**using one of the following methods:  
     
   **Upload an audio file:** Upload a supported file type that is 10 MB or smaller.  
     
   **Record in your browser:** Select your microphone, click **Record**, use **Pause** and **Resume** if needed, and play back the recording before submitting.  
     
   4. Check the **Rights and Consent Confirmation** box to confirm you have permission to clone and use the speaker’s voice.  
     
   Click **Save**.  
     
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155071701848/original/F5y3rtN3dx2TBbWaYhsv6Jbfr4jJt1FNjA.png?1779201766)
5. Wait for the cloned voice to appear under **My Voices → Cloned Voices** in a processing state. Once the cloned voice is ready, click **Play** to preview the original uploaded or recorded sample.  
     
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155071701940/original/itcbLta-AMdTajgs1dnT_xvv-mtegdnfqg.gif?1779201815)
6. Select the cloned voice from the **Cloned Voices** section. Save the voice selection.  
     
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155071701985/original/8ehjSwHBhK0qg6XOu6x1qpWKza0ptcNLtQ.png?1779201858)
7. Save the Voice AI Agent.
8. Use the **Test Your Agent** panel to confirm the agent sounds correct during a test call.  
     
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155071702071/original/aiARJ5k6E3gcAovigXA24V3VqS4j8qP5hg.png?1779201903)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: What providers can I use for cloned voices?**  
You can choose **ElevenLabs** or **Cartesia** as the target voice provider when creating a cloned voice.

**Q: What is the maximum upload size?**  
Audio samples must be **10 MB or smaller**.

**Q: Can I record a voice sample directly in HighLevel?**  
Yes. The Clone Voice modal lets you choose a microphone, record in the browser, pause/resume while recording, and play back the sample before submitting it.

**Q: Do imported and cloned voices share the same limit?**  
Yes. Imported and cloned voices share a combined limit of **10 custom voices per company**.

**Q: What happens after I click Save?**  
The cloned voice appears in **My Voices → Cloned Voices** with a processing state. Once it is ready, you can assign it to a Voice AI Agent.

**Q: What should I do if cloning fails?**  
Use a cleaner sample and retry. Make sure the recording has one speaker, minimal background noise, a supported file format, and a file size of 10 MB or smaller.

**Q: Is consent required to clone a voice?**  
Yes. You must confirm that you have the rights and consent to clone and use the speaker’s voice every time you create a cloned voice.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [How to Edit a Voice AI Agents Voice](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005874-how-to-edit-a-voice-ai-agents-voice?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- [How to Create Voice AI Agents](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000004107-how-to-create-voice-ai-agents?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- [Testing Voice AI Agents](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000004108-testing-voice-ai-agents?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- [Voice AI: Multi-Language Support](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000004683-voice-ai-multi-language-support?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- [AI Voice Agents Overview](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000003911-ai-voice-agents-overview?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

title_en: LC Email - Complete Guide to Dedicated IP
source_md:
# Dedicated IP for LC Email

Send from an exclusive IP address — take full control of your email sender reputation and deliverability.

Dedicated IPs offer a distinct advantage by sending your email messages from a unique, exclusive IP address. Email service providers (ESPs) closely monitor the reputation and behaviour of an IP address to determine the deliverability of emails linked to specific domains associated with that IP.

Getting a dedicated IP address provides your organization with exclusive ownership, giving you full control over the management of the email sender reputation and deliverability tied to that IP.

This article will cover what Dedicated IP in LC Email is, pricing, why the feature was built, and several FAQs.

## When should I get a dedicated IP address?

If you're sending a significant volume of emails, in the ballpark of hundreds of thousands to millions per month (especially if exceeding 200,000), it becomes prudent to establish your reputation on a dedicated IP. It's worth noting that obtaining a dedicated IP might be a distinct investment.

Furthermore, when setting up email authentication protocols, including SPF, DMARC, DKIM, and SSL certificates to bolster protection against email spoofing, a dedicated IP becomes vital. **Shared IPs don't offer the same level of security, leaving you vulnerable to the actions of other senders using the same IP.**

Additionally, possessing a dedicated IP shields you from potential domain hijacking risks, ensuring the integrity and security of your email communications.

## What are the benefits of a dedicated IP?

While a dedicated IP might come with higher costs compared to a shared IP, it presents several distinct advantages:

Enhanced Email Delivery

Dedicated IPs often result in faster email delivery. Renowned email service providers like Gmail and Yahoo tend to favour emails from dedicated IPs, ensuring quicker inbox placement. Without sharing bandwidth, your performance isn't influenced by others using the same IP.

Full Control Over Sender and IP Reputation

As the sole user of a dedicated IP, you have total control over your sending habits, IP reputation, and SEO efforts. This allows you to customize your strategies without external interference.

Efficient Problem Resolution

Being the only sender on your dedicated IP simplifies identifying and addressing IP-related issues. Pinpointing problems and implementing solutions becomes more straightforward, improving overall reliability.

Enhanced Cybersecurity

A dedicated IP provides an additional layer of protection against threats like domain hijacking, malware, and hacking attempts, ensuring better security for your online resources.

While dedicated IPs might be more costly, the tangible benefits they offer in performance, control, problem-solving, and security make them a valuable investment for organizations with significant online and email needs.

## What are some tips for sending emails with dedicated IPs?

Within the world of email service providers (ESPs), your reputation is critical. With a dedicated IP, the challenge is to manage email volume and timing adeptly to prevent activating spam filters. Ideally, you should pace your email dispatches, allowing for a gradual increase in volume every 24 hours.

Dedicated IPs are most beneficial when consistently dispatching large volumes of emails. However, sporadic, high-volume sending can be counterproductive, potentially flagging you as a spammer to email filters or even resulting in blocklisting. ESPs are particularly wary of abrupt surges in email dispatches.

If your email traffic is inconsistently high, a shared IP might be more advantageous. This aligns your intermittent high volumes with the steady traffic patterns of other senders on the same IP.

```
Through thorough testing and adjustments, we've perfected and automated the dedicated IP warm-up process, ensuring a robust sender reputation. Users may experience a transitional period where their emails alternate between the dedicated IP and their old shared IP in a 50/50 split until the dedicated IP is fully warmed up.

Note: Users may still be in the warmup phase even after a considerable amount of time has passed since the IP was assigned.
```

## Who can buy a dedicated IP?

```
Dedicated IPs are exclusively available for Agencies on the $297/$2970 and $497/$4970 plans.

We strongly advise sending a minimum of 50,000 messages per week to uphold a robust reputation and reduce throttling issues with mailbox providers. Additionally, we recommend allocating one dedicated IP address for every 1 million messages sent monthly.

Agency: An agency that has been established within the last 14 days is eligible to purchase the IP.

Sub-accounts: Accounts with a total contact count exceeding 10,000 or those that have sent more than 50,000 emails in the last 10 days, and belong to an agency type created within the last 14 days, are eligible to acquire the IP.

Payment setup exists in the sub-account: If payment setup is missing, the purchase flow will not continue.

Dedicated IP purchase is enabled by the agency: If the agency has not enabled Dedicated IP purchase for sub-accounts, the purchase flow will not continue.
```

Both Agencies and sub-accounts can purchase a dedicated IP if they are using LC - Email as the Email provider.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155031452579/original/nlzjB8P9YXIOJgQGAXp8ZzeXxyDqI1GX8w.jpg?1724268138)

```
Note: Non-SaaS locations are eligible to purchase if the Agency grants permission. This setup is detailed on the Agency Sub-accounts page.
```

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155031452608/original/z1j8mntoQrAIeQQqA0PQp1CM1HwZ1vKlLg.jpg?1724268176)

## How to buy a Dedicated IP?

LC Email users can acquire a dedicated IP through the Email service.

Go to Agency Settings

Navigate to the **agency settings** page and click on **Email Services**.

Open Dedicated Domain And IP

Click on **Dedicated Domain And IP** in the LC email provider section.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155031452640/original/BvQDYf4cDhJ52G4FTdvZ60VPhNuh8A6phA.jpg?1724268225)

Click "Buy IP"

On the next page, click on **"Buy IP"**.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155009567725/original/MGcEGrG94lo1h91nalxOHYlcQ2jNRhkEBA.png?1696837840)

Confirm Purchase

A modal will appear with the option to buy a new IP. Click on the **"Buy Now"** button to proceed with the purchase.

✓

Billing

One IP at **$59 per month** will be charged to the agency. The agency can set up rebilling to cover this cost.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155009567791/original/JQF8N0VlbKo9vpFxWz3yw8SaFMVyf1TAMg.png?1696837899)

## How to Manage Your Dedicated IP

If you own a dedicated sending domain, you'll notice a tag indicating whether your domain is associated with a Dedicated or Shared IP.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155009569127/original/jKoAvC0wqCE_gqBohUVKQvjc0_r6EzdScQ.png?1696838511)

```
Note: A Dedicated IP can only be linked to a dedicated sending domain.
```

Additionally, you can assign one or more dedicated IPs to your domains. In this configuration, a single domain can be linked to multiple IPs, and vice versa. If your domain is associated with multiple IPs, emails will be sent through all these IPs in a **round-robin manner**. This method ensures a balanced distribution of email traffic among the IPs linked to your domain.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155085049018/original/-2YisJD1nfqYqdrWOMoRHDFBcp4GuepBGg.png?1793888099)

### **SPF Record Validation Warnings**

When you use LC Email with a purchased dedicated IP, HighLevel displays a domain-specific warning if one or more domains are missing the required SPF record.

The warning identifies the affected domains, making it easier to determine which DNS records need attention.

If you see this warning:

1. Review the domains listed in the warning.
2. Check the SPF record for each affected domain in your DNS provider.
3. Update the SPF records using the required value displayed in the warning.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155085049256/original/oulN5d2tbHT_YR-5ubIFFh81C_-6rktp7g.png?1793888186)

**Note:** Missing or incorrect SPF records can affect email authentication and deliverability. Make sure the required records are configured correctly.

For more information about configuring and verifying DNS records, see [How to Add a Domain and Verify DNS Record](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000002220).

  

## How To Assign a Dedicated IP to a Domain

Open Assign IP

Click the **three dots** next to your domain and select **"Assign IP"**.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155009569526/original/WqxtX26vNHJvgqaSguv9LvipF9-_4XYUDA.png?1696838646)

Select Your IP

The **"IP Assignment"** modal will appear, displaying all the IPs you've purchased. Select the IP you wish to assign to the domain.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155009569766/original/eAwHwlrD_8Lobkk3m3hYtO7mBxgEdctZzw.png?1696838748)

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: How can I bill my clients for usage?

If you're on the Pro-plan, you can rebill your clients, saving you the effort of manual billing.

Q: Will dedicated IP reselling work with ISV?

Absolutely! Agencies on the Pro Plan will maintain the capability to resell.

Q: How do I set up rDNS?

Yes, [follow the instructions in this article](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000001154) and set up the rDNS.

title_en: How to Manage Appointments for Custom Objects and Companies
source_md:
Manage appointments directly from Custom Object and Company records in HighLevel. Review upcoming and past appointments, book a new meeting, or link an existing booking without leaving the record. Keep property viewings, policy renewal meetings, and Company account reviews connected to the records they concern. This guide covers viewing, booking, and linking appointments.

```
Note: This feature is available only to locations enrolled in the private beta.
```

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What Are Appointments for Custom Objects and Companies?](#what-are-record-appointments)
- [Key Benefits of Record-Level Appointments](#key-benefits)
- [Prerequisites and Limitations](#prerequisites)
- [How to Manage Record-Level Appointments](#how-to-use)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#frequently-asked-questions)
- [Related Articles](#related-articles)

---

# **What Are Appointments for Custom Objects and Companies?**

Record-level appointments let you manage meetings associated with a Custom Object or Company. For example, a Property record can show scheduled viewings, while a Company record can show account review meetings.

The **Appointments** tab displays **Upcoming** and **Past** appointments linked to the selected record. You can review bookings, create a new meeting, or connect an appointment scheduled elsewhere in the same location.

---

## **Key Benefits of Record-Level Appointments**

Connecting appointments to CRM records gives your team meeting history and scheduling actions in one place.

- **Centralized history:** Review upcoming and past appointments for each record.
- **In-context booking:** Schedule meetings directly from Custom Object and Company records.
- **Automatic record selection:** Meetings started from a record have that record preselected under **Associated objects**.
- **Existing bookings:** Link an appointment that's already scheduled without creating a duplicate.
- **Quick search:** Narrow the appointment list by calendar name.
- **Flexible associations:** Review and select additional supported records before confirming a meeting.

---

## **Prerequisites and Limitations**

This feature is available only to locations participating in the private beta. You must have access to the relevant Custom Object or Company record.

- The **Appointments** tab must be enabled for your location.
- Meeting bookings require a calendar, date, time, and Contact.
- Existing appointments can be linked from the same HighLevel location.
- The current record is preselected under **Associated objects** when starting a Meeting from that record.
- **Services** is available from the Add menu, but its remaining booking steps may differ from Meetings.

---

## **How to Manage Record-Level Appointments**

Start from the Custom Object or Company record that needs a meeting. Use its Appointments tab to review bookings, create appointments, or link existing meetings.

### **Open Appointments from a Custom Object Record**

Custom Object records can display the appointments associated with them. Use the Upcoming and Past views to review scheduling history.

1. Open the HighLevel **Sub-Account** view.
2. Select the relevant Custom Object type from the left navigation, such as **Properties** or **Insurance Policies**.
3. Open the record you want to review.
4. Select **Appointments** from the record's side panel.
5. Switch between **Upcoming** and **Past** to review linked appointments.
6. Use **Search by Calendar Name** to filter the list.

![Custom Object record showing the Appointments tab in the right-hand side panel](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084173375/original/zvjwA5FCeSThXH_qQ0KVHd3ZZDXzxBx72w.png?1793005205)

```
Note: The Appointments tab shows bookings associated with the selected record. Other appointments in the location may need to be linked before they appear here.
```

### **Open Appointments from a Company Record**

Company records provide the same appointment-management workflow, keeping account reviews and other related meetings connected to the business.

1. Open the HighLevel **Sub-Account** view.
2. Select **Contacts** from the left navigation.
3. Select the **Companies** tab.
4. Locate and open the Company record you want to review.

![Company list showing the record to open](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084258313/original/wqWupyGegqTLZVPb8n7Bv7p3gzVEmtRqAQ.png?1793066597)

5. In the Company's right-hand side panel, locate the vertical tab rail.
6. Select the calendar icon to open **Appointments**.

7. Review the **Upcoming** and **Past** appointments associated with the Company.
8. Use **Search by Calendar Name** to narrow the list if needed.

### **Book a New Meeting**

Starting a Meeting from a record keeps that record selected while you schedule the appointment. You can review additional associations before confirming the booking.

1. From the HighLevel **Sub-Account** view, open the relevant Custom Object record or go to **Contacts** > **Companies** and open a Company record.
2. Select **Appointments** in the side panel.
3. Click **Add**.
4. Choose **Meetings**.

![Appointments Add menu showing the available booking options](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084258414/original/E2sAT7zUnaNoTSIPtw5_vbY9OBmLk9jKGA.png?1793067060)

5. Select the calendar for the meeting.
6. Choose the appointment date and time.
7. Select the **Contact** attending the meeting.
8. Review the appointment title, meeting location, status, and other required details.

![Book appointment form showing the calendar, meeting details, Contact, and Associated objects](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084173379/original/Rtp8O30K6DSkKpqQkWVsZY8S9x8UY_32wQ.png?1793005205)

### **Review Associated Objects and Complete Booking**

The **Associated objects** selector controls which supported CRM records are connected to the meeting. The record you started from is preselected.

9. In the booking form, open **Associated objects**.
10. Confirm that the current Custom Object or Company record is selected.
11. Use the available record-type options and search to select additional supported records, if needed.
12. Review the selected associations.
13. Click **Book appointment** to confirm the booking.

![Associated objects selector showing records connected to the appointment](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084173378/original/3aYdMDD-f5KEf5EcxGuQF7Om5bOsKvaSiQ.png?1793005206)

### **Start a Service Booking**

The same Add menu lets you start a Service booking from a Custom Object or Company record.

1. Open the HighLevel **Sub-Account** view.
2. Open the relevant Custom Object record or go to **Contacts** > **Companies** and open a Company record.
3. Select **Appointments** from the side panel.
4. Click **Add**.
5. Select **Services**.

![Record-level Appointments menu showing the Services booking option](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084258386/original/O17P7IK7LR_Bx3imObC4kyUdh8QObCJYKA.png?1793066970)

### **Link an Existing Appointment**

If a meeting is already scheduled, link that booking to the record instead of creating a duplicate. The search includes appointments in the current HighLevel location.

1. From the HighLevel **Sub-Account** view, open the relevant Custom Object record or go to **Contacts** > **Companies** and open a Company record.
2. Select **Appointments** in the record's side panel.
3. Click **Add**.
4. Select **Link existing appointment**.
5. Search for the appointment in the current location.
6. Locate the correct booking and click **Link**.

![Link existing appointment screen showing appointment search and the Link action](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084258195/original/i7dtfu7O42kKgTTBTnse6RDQ3aRWbBiLcg.png?1793065926)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Why is the Appointments tab empty?**

The tab shows only appointments associated with the current record. Check both Upcoming and Past, and clear any calendar-name search. If a booking exists but is not linked, use Link existing appointment.

**Q: Can I link an appointment booked elsewhere in the location?**

Yes. Use **Add** > **Link existing appointment** to connect a booking from the same location without creating another appointment.

**Q: Is the current record automatically linked when booking a Meeting?**

The current Custom Object or Company record is preselected under **Associated objects**. Review the selection before confirming the booking.

**Q: Can I associate a meeting with multiple record types?**

Yes. The **Associated objects** selector supports Companies, Custom Object records, and other available record types.

**Q: Why can't I see the Appointments tab?**

This feature is in private beta. Confirm that your location has been enrolled and that the feature is enabled.

---

### **Related Articles**

- [Creating and Updating Custom Object Records](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000004023-creating-and-updating-custom-object-records)
- [Getting Started with Companies](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000004430-getting-started-with-companies)
- [Manually Booking Calendar Appointments](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001209829-manually-booking-calendar-appointments)
- [How to Manage Appointments with Appointment List View](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000003447-how-to-manage-appointments-with-appointment-list-view)
- [Associations Between Opportunities, Companies & Custom Objects](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000004033-associations-between-opportunities-companies-custom-objects)

title_en: AI Browser Control Extension
source_md:
Ask AI Integration

# AI Browser Control Extension

Let Ask AI operate your browser to complete tasks hands-free—opening pages, clicking elements, typing text, and filling forms securely in Chrome-based browsers.

What You'll Learn

Discover how the Ask AI Browser Control extension transforms your AI assistant from an advisor into an automation agent that navigates the web, interacts with pages, and completes multi-step workflows on your behalf.

Learn how the extension maintains security with tab isolation, credential protection, and on-demand connections while providing full transparency through live screenshot previews.

## What is AI Browser Control?

AI Browser Control is a browser extension that allows Ask AI to operate your web browser autonomously. Instead of providing instructions for manual steps, Ask AI performs tasks directly—navigating pages, clicking buttons, filling forms, and reading content—all within a secure, isolated environment.

The extension supports Chrome-based browsers including Chrome, Edge, and Brave. It connects seamlessly with your Ask AI assistant in both text and voice conversations, transforming natural language requests into executed browser actions.

All automation runs in a dedicated tab group that remains completely separate from your personal browsing tabs, ensuring your existing sessions and data remain untouched.

## Key Benefits

AI Browser Control transforms how you interact with web-based tasks, providing hands-free automation with built-in transparency and security.

**Hands-Free Task Completion** — Ask AI executes multi-step workflows without manual intervention, from simple page navigation to complex form submissions.

**Visual Interaction** — The AI reads pages through screenshots and interacts using coordinate-based actions with an animated cursor, mimicking human browsing behavior.

**Full Navigation Control** — Opens, navigates, reloads, switches between tabs, and closes pages automatically, with each action returning a fresh screenshot for verification.

**Comprehensive Page Reading** — Captures page text, console logs, and network requests to understand outcomes and adjust actions accordingly.

**Works Everywhere** — Functions identically in text chat conversations and voice interactions, providing consistent automation across input methods.

**Live Activity Preview** — Every step's screenshot appears in a preview panel, allowing you to watch the AI work in real-time.

## How Browser Control Works

The extension operates through a sophisticated coordinate-based interaction system that reads and acts on web pages like a human user.

Visual Page Analysis

Screenshot-Based Understanding

Ask AI takes screenshots of web pages and analyzes them to identify clickable elements, form fields, buttons, and navigation options—understanding the page layout like a human would.

Batched Actions

Coordinated Interactions

The AI executes batched actions including clicking coordinates, typing text, scrolling, dragging elements, and sending keyboard commands. An animated cursor shows exactly where the AI is interacting.

Automated Navigation

Complete Tab Control

The extension handles all browser navigation: opening new pages, using back and forward buttons, reloading pages, switching between tabs, and closing completed tasks. Each navigation action automatically captures a fresh screenshot.

Outcome Verification

Multi-Layer Page Reading

Ask AI reads page text, monitors browser console logs, and tracks network requests to verify that actions completed successfully and determine next steps in complex workflows.

How It's Triggered

Browser Control works identically whether you're typing in text chat or speaking in a voice conversation. Simply describe the task you want completed, and Ask AI determines when browser automation is needed.

## Security & Privacy

The Browser Control extension implements multiple layers of security to protect your data, credentials, and browsing privacy while automating tasks.

Tab Isolation

Hard Separation from Your Browsing

All automation runs in a managed session tab group completely separate from your personal tabs. The AI cannot see, access, or interact with any of your existing browser tabs, windows, or sessions.

Secure Form Fill

Local-Only Credential Handling

When forms require credentials, payment information, or personal data, the extension prompts you locally on your device. Values are filled directly in the browser and never transmitted to the backend or exposed to the AI model.

Authentication Without Re-Login

Seamless Verification

The extension authenticates using your already-logged-in HighLevel session and verifies with the backend before executing any commands—no second login or separate credential management required.

On-Demand Connections

Minimal Network Exposure

The socket connection opens only when a browser task is actively running and closes immediately after completion. If a connection drops mid-task, automatic recovery mechanisms restore the session without data loss.

Privacy First Design

Your browsing data, personal tabs, and sensitive credentials remain on your device. The AI receives only the information necessary to complete the specific task you requested.

Automation Made Simple

Watch Your Tasks Complete Themselves

Live screenshot previews show exactly what Ask AI is doing in your browser

## How to Install and Use Browser Control

Get started with AI Browser Control in minutes by installing the extension and connecting it to your Ask AI assistant.

Step 1

Install the Extension

Visit the Chrome Web Store or your browser's extension marketplace and search for "Ask AI Browser Control." Click **Add to Chrome** (or your browser's equivalent) to install.

[Screenshot: Browser Control extension in Chrome Web Store with "Add to Chrome" button highlighted]

Step 2

Open HighLevel in Your Browser

Navigate to your HighLevel account and ensure you're logged in. The extension uses your active session to authenticate automatically without requiring separate credentials.

Step 3

Connect the Extension

Click the Browser Control extension icon in your browser toolbar. A popup will display the connection status. If you're logged into HighLevel, the status will show **Connected to the page**.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077601282/original/WSA3ukt1zZaWucTG3cY520MtNks1WSz-fQ.png?1785851795)

Step 4

Request Browser Tasks from Ask AI

Open Ask AI in text chat or start a voice conversation. Describe the task you want completed. For example: "Create a new event site for my upcoming webinar" or "Fill out the hosting sign-up form for me."

Ask AI will recognize when browser automation is needed and begin executing steps automatically.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077601372/original/7wIxHwkhtZP_21T4qjcquOEOTez0zHat4g.png?1785851836)

Step 5

Monitor Progress in Real-Time

As Ask AI works, screenshots of each step appear in the chat preview panel. You can watch the AI navigate pages, click elements, and fill forms. The animated cursor shows exactly where the AI is interacting on each page.

Note

The extension only opens connections when actively running a task. Once the task completes, the connection closes automatically to minimize network exposure and browser resource usage.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Which browsers are supported by AI Browser Control?

The Browser Control extension supports all Chromium-based browsers including Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Brave. It does not currently support Firefox or Safari.

Q: Can Ask AI access my personal browsing tabs?

No. Browser Control operates exclusively in a managed session tab group isolated from your personal tabs. The AI cannot see, access, or interact with any tabs outside this dedicated automation environment.

Q: How does the extension handle sensitive data like passwords and payment information?

When Ask AI encounters forms requiring credentials or payment details, the extension displays a secure prompt on your device. You enter the information locally, and it's filled directly into the form without ever being transmitted to the backend or exposed to the AI model. These values remain on your device only.

Q: Does Browser Control work with voice conversations?

Yes. Browser Control functions identically in both text chat and voice conversations with Ask AI. Simply describe your task verbally, and the AI will determine when browser automation is appropriate and execute the steps automatically.

Q: What happens if my internet connection drops during a browser task?

The extension includes automatic recovery mechanisms. If the connection drops mid-task, it will attempt to restore the session and resume from the last completed step. If recovery fails, Ask AI will notify you and you can restart the task from the beginning.

Q: Can I see what Ask AI is doing while it operates the browser?

Yes. Every action generates a screenshot that appears in the chat preview panel. You can watch in real-time as Ask AI navigates pages, clicks elements, and fills forms. An animated cursor shows precisely where the AI is interacting on each page.

Q: Do I need to keep the Browser Control extension icon visible in my toolbar?

The extension works whether the icon is pinned to your toolbar or hidden in the extensions menu. However, keeping it visible makes it easier to quickly check connection status and verify that the extension is active when needed.

Q: Will the extension slow down my browser when I'm not using it?

No. The Browser Control extension only opens connections and consumes resources when actively running a task requested through Ask AI. Once the task completes, the connection closes and the extension returns to an idle state with minimal resource usage.

title_en: Meta Pixel Tracking for Events
source_md:
Meta Pixel tracking in HighLevel Events helps organizers measure how visitors move from viewing an event to completing an RSVP or ticket order. By connecting a Meta Pixel to an individual event, you can map attendee actions to Meta events and measure important conversion points. Ticketed events can also send purchase details such as order value, currency, ticket quantities, and ticket identifiers.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Meta Pixel Tracking for Events?](#%E2%80%8B%E2%80%8BWhat-is-Meta-Pixel-Tracking-for-Events?)
- [Key Benefits of Meta Pixel Tracking for Events](#Key-Benefits-of-Meta-Pixel-Tracking-for-Events)
- [Supported Meta Pixel Tracking Events](#Supported-Meta-Pixel-Tracking-Events)
- [Purchase Data Sent to Meta](#Purchase-Data-Sent-to-Meta)
- [How To Setup Meta Pixel Tracking for Events](#How-To-Setup-Meta-Pixel-Tracking-for-Events)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is Meta Pixel Tracking for Events?**

Meta Pixel Tracking for Events connects attendee activity in a HighLevel event with Meta conversion events. This gives organizers better visibility into registration intent, completed registrations, and ticket purchases generated through their event marketing.

Meta Pixel tracking is configured independently for each event under **Settings → Link & tracking**.

---

## **Key Benefits of Meta Pixel Tracking for Events**

- **Conversion visibility:** Measure attendee activity from the initial event page visit through a completed RSVP or ticket order.
- **Flexible event mapping:** Choose which Meta event should fire for each supported attendee action.
- **Event-level configuration:** Configure Meta Pixel tracking independently for each event.
- **Ticket purchase insights:** Track multiple stages of the ticket checkout journey.
- **Revenue context:** Send supported purchase details with completed ticket orders.
- **Duplicate-event protection:** Session-based deduplication helps reduce repeated conversion signals.

---

## **Supported Meta Pixel Tracking Events**

RSVP and Ticketed events have different attendee journeys, so HighLevel provides tracking actions that correspond to the steps visitors complete for each event type.

| Event type | Supported attendee actions |
| --- | --- |
| **RSVP Events** | Event page viewed, RSVP started, RSVP completed |
| **Ticketed Events** | Event page viewed, Checkout started, Ticket selection completed, Registration form submitted, Payment details submitted, Ticket order completed |

  
  

| Event Type | Attendee Action | When It Fires |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **RSVP** | Event page viewed | When a published event page is loaded |
| **RSVP** | RSVP started | When a visitor opens the RSVP form |
| **RSVP** | RSVP completed | When the RSVP is successfully confirmed |
| **Ticketed** | Event page viewed | When a published event page is loaded |
| **Ticketed** | Checkout started | When the attendee begins checkout |
| **Ticketed** | Ticket selection completed | When ticket selection is completed |
| **Ticketed** | Registration form submitted | When the registration form is submitted |
| **Ticketed** | Payment details submitted | When payment details are submitted |
| **Ticketed** | Ticket order completed | When the ticket order is successfully completed |

Completed ticket orders are tracked for both paid tickets and **$0 orders**.

**Purchase data:** Completed ticket orders can also send order value, currency, ticket quantities, and ticket identifiers to Meta.

**Deduplication:** HighLevel uses session-based deduplication to help prevent the same attendee action from being reported multiple times because of browser back navigation, page refreshes, payment redirects, or repeated completion checks.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155079933950/original/2wr708qTk62B0A5O1VZdWhvpdHEjWn6eiw.png?1788362576)

---

## **Purchase Data Sent to Meta**

A completed ticket order can provide more context than a registration count alone. Commerce details help organizers evaluate the value and composition of ticket purchases generated through their event marketing.

Completed ticket orders can include:

- **Order value:** The value associated with the completed ticket order.
- **Currency:** The currency associated with the order.
- **Ticket quantities:** The number of tickets represented in the order.
- **Ticket identifiers:** Identifiers associated with the tickets included in the transaction.

This additional data is associated with completed ticket orders and can support campaign reporting focused on revenue outcomes rather than registrations alone.

---

## **How To Setup Meta Pixel Tracking for Events**

Using the correct Meta Pixel ID and mapping the attendee actions that matter to your campaign ensures the conversion data represents the event journey you want to measure.

### 1. Locate Your Meta Pixel ID

Locate the Pixel ID for the Meta data source you want to connect to your event.

HighLevel's existing Meta documentation explains how to locate the Dataset ID used as the Pixel ID in Meta Events Manager.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155079934081/original/Qk4kMpRcJ9x7MQmEjdhVOKSFdfdIVwLzRg.png?1788362650)

[**How to set up a Funnel Event Pixel for Facebook Conversion API?**](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001236281?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### 2. Open Link & tracking

1. In your HighLevel sub-account, go to **Memberships → Events**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155079934348/original/wbJEUuNvvYHsDawbdh1YP838tNuPskUXMw.png?1788362841)
2. Select the event you want to track.
3. Open **Settings**andSelect **Link & tracking**.
4. Locate the **Meta Pixel** settings.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155079934419/original/dMdBG7IG1iyv6dQ__wosrkxfGorpxLvH1g.png?1788362895)

### 

### 3. Add the Meta Pixel ID

Enter the **Meta Pixel ID** associated with the Meta data source you want to use for this event.

Meta Pixel tracking is configured independently for each event, so confirm that you are editing the correct event before configuring the mappings.  
  
![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155079934567/original/OUp8f5LCNZIc8mxoFisPGUee1zyQ0oDpQA.png?1788362985)

### 4. Map Attendee Actions to Meta Events

Use the **Event mapping** options to choose which Meta event should fire for each supported attendee action.

For RSVP events, configure mappings for:

1. Event page viewed
2. RSVP started
3. RSVP completed

For Ticketed events, configure mappings for:

1. Event page viewed
2. Checkout started
3. Ticket selection completed
4. Registration form submitted
5. Payment details submitted
6. Ticket order completed

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155079934781/original/cwnhhJHVQf4bqr0na5-4hqBCXbA4N_6CqA.png?1788363055)

### 5. Test the Attendee Journey

Use the published event experience to verify the actions that matter to your tracking plan. The **Event page viewed** action is defined for published event-page loads, so testing against the public experience is the appropriate way to validate that part of the journey.

For an RSVP event, test the page view, opening the RSVP form, and a successful RSVP. For a Ticketed event, test the relevant checkout stages through a completed order, including a $0 ticket order when that is part of your use case.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155079934969/original/oj3FhtZr5neYQkb-b848rkEnTd4b-16Lfg.png?1788363171)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Is Events Meta Pixel tracking the same as an Ad Manager conversion pixel?**  
No. Events Meta Pixel tracking is configured directly within an individual HighLevel event under **Settings → Link & tracking**. Ad Manager conversion tracking uses a separate configuration process.

**Q: Do I need to install Funnel tracking code to use Meta Pixel tracking for Events?**  
The native Events integration is configured directly in the event using the Meta Pixel ID and Event mapping settings. Funnel tracking code belongs to a separate Funnel or Website tracking setup.

**Q: Are $0 ticket orders tracked?**  
Yes. Successfully completed $0 ticket orders are tracked as completed ticket orders.

**Q: Can Meta Pixel tracking report attendee check-ins?**  
Check-in is not listed as a supported Meta Pixel tracking action for this feature. HighLevel provides separate Events workflow triggers for registration and check-in automation.

**Q: Does previewing an unpublished event trigger Event page viewed?**  
The feature defines **Event page viewed** as occurring when a published event page is loaded.

---

## **Related Articles**

- **[How to Create and Manage Events in HighLevel](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000008071-how-to-create-and-manage-events-in-highlevel-private-beta-?utm_source=chatgpt.com)**
