title_en: Unified Client Portal Experience
source_md:
Client Portal

# Unified Client Portal Experience

One login. One navigation. One seamless branded experience that connects Dashboard, Courses, Communities, billing, shared files, and account settings into a single customer home.

What You'll Learn

The unified Client Portal eliminates the fragmented experience of switching between separate tabs for Courses, Communities, billing, and files. Customers can move smoothly between all customer-facing applications within a single, branded environment.

This article explains the key benefits of the unified portal, how it improves customer experience and discoverability, and how to enable it for your business.

Labs Feature

The unified Client Portal is powered by HighLevel Labs. This feature represents a major platform upgrade and may be refined based on user feedback. You can enable it from your Client Portal Dashboard to provide customers with an improved experience.

## What is the Unified Client Portal?

The unified Client Portal brings Dashboard, Courses, Communities, billing, shared files, and account settings into one connected and branded customer environment. Previously, these features existed as separate experiences with different navigation patterns, requiring customers to switch between tabs and re-orient themselves repeatedly.

The unified portal eliminates that fragmentation. Customers now have one login, one navigation system, and one seamless experience for all customer-facing interactions with your business.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077955926/original/J9biLsv67hOcsvrfJn9eMQlYy0O6DUAMUQ.png?1786249103)

This architectural upgrade moves Client Portal, Courses, and Communities from legacy platforms to a shared, modern foundation. The result is a faster, smoother, and more consistent customer journey that feels like a single product rather than disconnected applications.

## Key Benefits

The unified Client Portal delivers tangible improvements for both businesses and their customers by reducing friction, improving performance, and creating a more professional branded experience.

**No more tab maze** — Customers can move naturally between Courses, Communities, Dashboard, billing, and shared files without feeling like they are switching between separate products.

**Faster performance** — The portal delivers faster page loads, smoother transitions, and a more responsive experience across desktop and mobile devices.

**Easier content discovery** — A redesigned dashboard and unified navigation help customers quickly find courses in progress, community activity, billing items, shared files, and account settings.

**One consistent brand experience** — From login through every section of the portal, customers encounter a polished, professional experience that keeps your business brand front and center.

**Modern architecture for future growth** — The shared foundation makes it faster to deliver improvements and unlock new customer-facing capabilities without adding disconnected products.

Customer Experience

One Login. One Navigation. One Journey.

Customers spend less time navigating and more time engaging with your content, services, and community.

## What Customers Will Notice

The unified portal changes how customers interact with your business. These improvements create a smoother, faster, and more intuitive experience.

Improvement 1

Smoother App Switching

Customers can move naturally between Courses, Communities, Dashboard, billing, and shared files without the experience feeling disconnected. Everything feels like part of the same journey rather than separate products stitched together.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077955931/original/ah_aS0idgPCoAVrm2T97PZvNnV1Ovu-auw.png?1786249154)

Improvement 2

Faster Performance

The portal delivers faster page loads, smoother transitions, and a more responsive experience across desktop and mobile. Customers spend less time waiting and more time engaging with content and services.

Improvement 3

Easier Content Discovery

The redesigned dashboard and unified navigation make it easier for customers to find:

- Courses in progress
- Community activity
- Continue Watching content
- Pinned Communities
- Billing items
- Shared files

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077955930/original/KeXJy6KYr8hpRBuyYQUc5gD_bgOKf6esxQ.png?1786249142)

Customers can quickly understand where they are and what to do next.

Improvement 4

One Consistent Brand Experience

The redesigned login and portal experience keep your business brand front and center. From login through Courses, Communities, billing, and files, customers encounter a more consistent, polished, and professional experience.

## SEO and Discoverability

The unified portal expands how businesses can reach customers beyond the portal itself. Eligible public Course and Community pages are now SEO-ready, with search-friendly rendering, crawlable URLs, and page metadata that help search engines understand and discover content.

This gives businesses more opportunities to increase reach, help new audiences discover valuable content, build organic visibility around their expertise, and turn public content into a stronger growth channel.

Important

Private, gated, and customer-only content remains protected. Only public Course and Community pages are eligible for search engine indexing.

## Platform Architecture

The unified Client Portal represents more than a visual refresh. HighLevel has migrated Client Portal, Courses, and Communities from separate legacy experiences to connected applications built on a shared, modern architecture.

This architectural upgrade delivers:

**Faster and smoother navigation** — Improved performance across all customer-facing applications.

**A consistent login and customer journey** — One unified experience from start to finish.

**Better performance across devices** — Optimized for desktop and mobile use.

**Search-engine-friendly public pages** — Expanded discoverability for eligible content.

**A shared foundation across customer-facing products** — Enables faster delivery of future improvements.

**Greater flexibility for branding and customization** — More control over the customer experience.

The result for customers is a simpler, faster experience. The result for businesses is a platform that can continue growing without introducing another disconnected product or tab.

## Coming Soon

The unified portal's modern foundation unlocks additional customer-facing capabilities that will be released in future updates:

- Appointments inside the Client Portal
- Custom navigation links
- Deeper portal customization
- Expanded branding options
- Richer Community and event experiences
- More customer self-service capabilities

## How to Enable the Unified Client Portal

Follow these steps to enable the unified Client Portal experience for your business and customers:

Step 1

Navigate to the Client Portal Dashboard

In the HighLevel app, go to **Client Portal → Dashboard**.

Step 2

Enable the Unified Portal

Locate the button to enable the unified portal experience and click it to activate the feature.

Step 3

Customers Begin Using the Unified Portal

Once enabled, customers can begin using the unified portal experience. There are no changes in routing or other parts of the system.

Success

Customers can now navigate seamlessly between Dashboard, Courses, Communities, billing, shared files, and account settings in one unified experience.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: What changes when I enable the unified Client Portal?

When you enable the unified portal, customers will see a redesigned experience that connects Dashboard, Courses, Communities, billing, shared files, and account settings into one seamless environment. The backend routing and other system parts remain unchanged.

Q: Will my customers need to log in again?

No. Customers use the same login credentials. The unified portal provides a single login experience that works across Dashboard, Courses, Communities, billing, files, and account settings.

Q: Are public Courses and Communities automatically indexed by search engines?

Eligible public Course and Community pages are now SEO-ready with search-friendly rendering, crawlable URLs, and page metadata. Private, gated, and customer-only content remains protected and is not indexed by search engines.

Q: Will the unified portal affect my existing workflows or automations?

No. The unified portal changes the customer-facing experience but does not affect backend routing, workflows, automations, or integrations. Your existing configurations remain unchanged.

Q: Can I customize the unified portal with my business branding?

Yes. The unified portal keeps your business brand front and center throughout the customer experience. Additional branding and customization options are planned for future releases.

Q: Is the unified portal available on mobile devices?

Yes. The unified portal is optimized for both desktop and mobile devices, delivering faster performance and a more responsive experience across all screen sizes.

Q: What upcoming features are planned for the unified portal?

Future updates will include appointments inside the Client Portal, custom navigation links, deeper portal customization, expanded branding options, richer Community and event experiences, and more customer self-service capabilities.

Q: Can I disable the unified portal after enabling it?

The unified portal represents the future of the Client Portal experience and is built on a modern architecture designed for ongoing improvements. If you encounter issues after enabling it, contact HighLevel support for assistance.

title_en: Edit Service Prices for Individual Appointments
source_md:
Service prices may need to change for a specific booking because of negotiated rates, complimentary services, or other one-time pricing scenarios. HighLevel lets you edit a service price directly on an individual Services appointment without changing the service’s standard price. This gives your team more flexibility to charge the correct amount while keeping global and staff-specific pricing intact for other bookings.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Appointment-Specific Service Pricing?](#What-is-Appointment-Specific-Service-Pricing?)
- [Key Benefits of Appointment-Specific Service Pricing](#Key-Benefits-of-Appointment-Specific-Service-Pricing)
- [How Appointment-Specific Pricing Works](#How-Appointment-Specific-Pricing-Works)
- [Custom Price Validation](#Custom-Price-Validation)
- [The Custom Price Tag](#The-Custom-Price-Tag)
- [Staff-Specific Pricing and Custom Appointment Prices](#Staff-Specific-Pricing-and-Custom-Appointment-Prices)
- [Custom Service Pricing on the Mobile App](#Custom-Service-Pricing-on-the-Mobile-App)
- [How To Setup a Custom Service Price for an Appointment](#How-To-Setup-a-Custom-Service-Price-for-an-Appointment)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is Appointment-Specific Service Pricing?**

Appointment-specific service pricing lets you manually change the price of a service for a single Services appointment. The custom amount is saved only to that appointment, allowing you to accommodate one-off pricing needs without modifying how the service is normally priced for future bookings.

You can apply a custom service price when creating a new Services appointment or when editing or duplicating an existing appointment. After the price is changed, HighLevel displays a **Custom** tag next to the amount so your team can easily recognize that the appointment is not using its standard service price.

---

## **Key Benefits of Appointment-Specific Service Pricing**

Appointment-specific pricing gives your team more control over what a customer is charged while protecting your standard service pricing from unintended changes.

- **Flexible pricing:** Apply negotiated, discretionary, or one-time service prices directly to an appointment.
- **No global pricing changes:** Keep the service’s standard configured price unchanged for every other booking.
- **Staff pricing overrides:** Use an appointment-specific price even when the selected staff member has a different service-specific price configured.
- **Complimentary services:** Set the price to $0 when a service should be provided at no charge.
- **Clear identification:** Quickly recognize manually adjusted prices through the **Custom** tag.
- **Immediate totals:** See the appointment total update as soon as you change the service price.
- **Desktop and mobile flexibility:** Manage custom appointment pricing whether your team is working from the web app or the HighLevel mobile app.

---

## **How Appointment-Specific Pricing Works**

Understanding which price HighLevel uses helps prevent unexpected totals when a service has standard pricing, staff-specific pricing, and an appointment-level override.

HighLevel can use different pricing levels depending on how the service and appointment are configured:

1. **Appointment-specific custom price:** If you manually enter a price for the appointment, HighLevel uses that amount for the booking.
2. **Staff-specific service price:** If no appointment-specific price has been entered and the selected staff member has their own price for the service, HighLevel uses the staff-specific price.
3. **Standard service price:** If neither of the above applies, HighLevel uses the price configured for the service.

An appointment-specific price does not modify either the staff-specific price or the standard service price. Those values remain available for other bookings.

---

## **Custom Price Validation**

Price validation helps ensure that manually adjusted appointment prices remain valid while supporting legitimate no-charge scenarios.

- A service price can be set to **$0** for complimentary appointments.
- A service price cannot be set to a negative amount.
- If a negative price is entered, HighLevel displays a validation error and prevents the appointment from being saved until the value is corrected.

---

## **The Custom Price Tag**

The **Custom** tag makes it easier for staff to distinguish an appointment-level price override from the normal service or staff-specific price.

After you manually change a service price within an appointment, HighLevel displays a **Custom** tag beside the adjusted amount. This visual indicator helps staff confirm that the price was intentionally changed for that booking.

---

## **Staff-Specific Pricing and Custom Appointment Prices**

Staff-specific pricing lets businesses charge different amounts depending on which staff member performs a service. An appointment-specific override takes priority when a different amount needs to be charged for one particular booking.

For example, if a service normally costs $100 and the selected staff member has a staff-specific price of $120, HighLevel normally applies the $120 staff price. If you manually change the service price to $90 within the appointment, that appointment uses $90.

The $120 staff-specific price remains unchanged and continues to apply to other applicable bookings.

---

## **Custom Service Pricing on the Mobile App**

Mobile support allows staff to handle one-off pricing changes while working away from a desktop, helping maintain the same pricing flexibility across booking workflows.

Appointment-specific service pricing is also available in the HighLevel mobile app. Staff can adjust a service price while working with a Services appointment, and the custom amount applies only to that booking.

Existing Services mobile functionality supports creating and managing service-based appointments, including staff-specific pricing.

---

## **How To Setup a Custom Service Price for an Appointment**

Applying a custom price directly from the appointment helps ensure the correct amount is attached to the booking without requiring changes to your service configuration.

To set a custom service price:

1. Open a Services appointment while creating a new booking, editing an existing appointment, or duplicating an appointment.
2. Locate the service included in the appointment.
3. Click the **Edit** icon next to the service.
4. Enter the new price for the service.
5. Confirm the updated amount. The appointment total updates to reflect the new service price.
6. Verify that the **Custom** tag appears next to the edited price.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155081657950/original/BWN-S6BKX-WB5A-nqx4J86qRPm8xiSLCRg.png?1790166103)
7. Complete any other appointment details and click **Save** or the applicable booking action.

The custom price applies only to that appointment. The standard service price and any staff-specific pricing remain unchanged.

HighLevel’s existing Services appointment modal also supports managing and duplicating Service bookings from the calendar.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Will changing a service price on an appointment change the service’s standard price?**  
No. The manually entered price applies only to that appointment. The globally configured service price remains unchanged.

**Q: What happens if the selected staff member has a staff-specific service price?**  
The appointment-specific custom price overrides the staff-specific price for that booking. The staff member’s configured service price is not changed.

**Q: Can I enter $0 as the service price?**  
Yes. A price of $0 is valid and can be used for complimentary services or other no-charge scenarios.

**Q: Can I enter a negative service price?**  
No. Negative values are not supported. HighLevel displays a validation error and prevents the appointment from being saved until a valid price is entered.

**Q: How can I tell whether an appointment is using a custom price?**  
HighLevel displays a **Custom** tag beside a service price that has been manually changed for the appointment.

**Q: Can I use custom pricing when duplicating an appointment?**

Yes. Appointment-specific service pricing is available within the duplicate appointment workflow, allowing you to adjust the service price before saving the new booking.

**Q: Is appointment-specific service pricing available on mobile?**  
Yes. You can edit the service price for an individual Services appointment from the HighLevel mobile app.

**Q: Do I need to change the service configuration before offering a negotiated price?**  
No. You can enter the negotiated amount directly on the applicable appointment without changing the service’s global pricing.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Manage Service Appointments in the Appointment Modal](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000007328-manage-service-appointments-in-the-appointment-modal)
- [Configuring Staff in Services](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005331)
- [How to Book Service (v2) Appointments Using the Mobile App](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000007008-services-v2-on-mobile-app-complete-booking-flow)
- [Manage Service v2 Appointments in the Mobile App](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000007941-manage-service-v2-appointments-in-the-mobile-app)
- [How to Create Services](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005330-how-to-create-services-)
- [Services - Overview & How to Get Started](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000006240)

title_en: Websites Overview
source_md:
HighLevel Websites let you build, organize, optimize, and publish multi-page sites from your sub-account. You can start from a blank site or template, manage pages from the Pages area, customize layouts in the Website Builder, review mobile behavior, connect a domain, and publish when the site is ready. This overview focuses on the core website workflow and links to dedicated guides for advanced features.

[동영상](https://www.youtube.com/embed/XYWoix5swXM?&wmode=opaque&rel=0)

# What Are Websites in HighLevel?

Websites are multi-page web experiences you can build and publish from the Sites area of a HighLevel sub-account. They are designed for use cases such as business homepages, service pages, contact pages, content pages, and other visitor-facing experiences.

Websites use the same core page-building experience as Funnels, including sections, rows, columns, elements, responsive editing, preview, save, and publish controls.

## Key Benefits of HighLevel Websites

HighLevel Websites combine page creation, site organization, publishing, and performance tools in one place so you can manage the full website lifecycle from the same sub-account.

- **Centralized Page Management:** Create, preview, edit, organize, and reorder website pages from the Pages area.
- **Flexible Page Building:** Build layouts with sections, rows, columns, and elements, then adjust styling from the builder settings.
- **Responsive Design:** Review and customize the visitor experience for desktop and mobile layouts.
- **Controlled Publishing:** Save changes without immediately updating the live site, preview your work, then publish when it is ready.
- **Custom Domains:** Connect and assign a branded root domain or subdomain to the website.
- **Built-In Performance Data:** Review page views, opt-ins, sales, and other website performance data from HighLevel.

## Websites vs. Funnels

Websites and Funnels use similar building tools, but they are organized for different visitor journeys. Choosing the right structure at the beginning helps keep pages and reporting easier to manage.

| Use | Website | Funnel |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Structure** | Multi-page site visitors can navigate more freely | Ordered steps designed around a specific visitor journey |
| **Common Use** | Business websites, service pages, informational content | Lead capture, booking, sales, and campaign flows |
| **Split Testing** | Not available in Websites | Available for Funnel pages |

## Manage Website Pages

The Pages area keeps your website pages in one place so you can edit, preview, and organize them without searching through the builder.

- Open a page for editing in the Website Builder.
- Preview a page before publishing.
- Manage page-level settings and products where applicable.
- Reorder page cards directly from the Pages grid.

![Website Pages area showing the pages available for a site](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155037910569/original/HLnOKuZExHkLfR3mKave12kXfbe6wgwnrg.png?1733510605)

### Reorder Website Pages

Reordering pages helps you organize the Pages grid without opening the Page Builder. The new order saves automatically when you drop a page into position.

1. From the **Sub-Account** view, select **Sites**in the left hand menu.
2. Select **Websites**.
3. Open the website you want to manage.
4. Select the **Pages** tab.
5. Click and hold the page card you want to move.
6. Drag the page card to the desired position. A grabbing cursor and drop placeholder show where the page will be placed.
7. Release the page card. The new order saves automatically.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155081947681/original/q9r5seq2HGf0Utz3pHKL_AWk0lZZLjyFDg.gif?1790533351)

**If reordering fails:** HighLevel restores the previously saved page order and displays an error.

## Website Builder at a Glance

The Website Builder provides the main tools for arranging content, styling the page, reviewing responsive behavior, and preparing changes for publication.

![HighLevel Website Builder showing the main editing controls](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155037892421/original/kOQUF5bxpP2UpxrOWkP2KWui9UhXoHwlQg.png?1733492720)

| Builder Area | What It Helps You Do |
| --- | --- |
| **Sections, Rows, Columns, and Elements** | Build and arrange page content. Elements can be moved, duplicated, deleted, and customized from their settings. |
| **Layers and Pages** | Navigate nested page content and move between pages while editing. |
| **Typography and Background** | Control page-wide font, text, link, color, and background styling. |
| **Tracking Code and Custom CSS** | Add supported custom tracking or styling when needed. |
| **Mobile/Desktop Controls** | Review responsive layouts and adjust supported settings or visibility for different devices. |
| **Versions, Preview, Save, and Publish** | Review previous versions, test the page, save draft changes, and publish the current saved version. |

**Save vs. Publish:** Saving stores your latest changes without replacing the current live version. Publishing makes the saved version live for visitors.

## How To Set Up a Website in HighLevel

A simple create → customize → review → connect → publish workflow keeps website setup easier to manage and helps prevent unfinished changes from reaching visitors.

### Step 1: Create the Website

Starting with a blank site or template gives you the website workspace and page structure you will customize before launch.

1. From the **Sub-Account** view, go to **Sites → Websites**.
2. Click **+ New Website**.
3. Choose **From Blank** or **From Templates**.
4. Enter the website name.
5. Click **Create** and open the website.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155081947783/original/N5wWOiPVuv-SAnNyjSMXmoltOypeKV_90w.gif?1790533470)

### Step 2: Add and Organize Pages

Create the pages the site needs, set clear page names and paths, and use the Pages grid to keep the site organized. You can also create and switch between pages from inside the Page Builder.

### Step 3: Build and Customize Each Page

Building each page around its purpose keeps content, navigation, and calls to action easier for visitors to understand and use.

- Add and arrange the sections, rows, columns, and elements needed for the page.
- Update text, images, buttons, forms, navigation, and other content.
- Review typography, spacing, backgrounds, and any global sections used across pages.
- Use Preview to test links and page behavior before publishing.

### Step 4: Review Mobile and SEO Settings

Reviewing responsive layouts and page metadata before publishing helps make the site easier to use across devices and prepares each page for sharing and search visibility.

- Switch between desktop and mobile views to review responsive behavior.
- Adjust supported mobile-specific settings or element visibility when needed.
- Add the page title, meta description, and other applicable SEO settings before publishing.

### Step 5: Connect the Domain and Publish

Connecting the correct domain and testing the saved version before publishing helps prevent broken navigation, incomplete pages, and domain-routing issues.

1. Connect the root domain or subdomain you want to use for the website.
2. Confirm the website is assigned to the correct domain and default page.
3. Save your latest builder changes.
4. Preview the website and test navigation, forms, buttons, and mobile layouts.
5. Click **Publish** when the saved version is ready to go live.

![Website Builder controls for versions preview save and publish](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155037899745/original/JZ482zGgclCyyEaoc3HQdVUgJ0Q_WosZ-A.png?1733498076)

## Website Settings, Products, and Performance

title_en: Using Course Assessment Emails to Streamline Course Communication
source_md:
Boost learner engagement and keep instructors in the loop with automated Course Assessment Emails for quizzes, assignments, and course comments. This article explains what the emails do, why they matter, and how to customize or disable them for any course.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Course Assessment Emails?](#What-is-Course-Assessment-Emails?)
- [Key Benefits of Course Assessment Emails](#Key-Benefits-of-Course-Assessment-Emails)
- [Quiz Assessment Emails](#Quiz-Assessment-Emails)
- [Assignment Assessment Emails](#Assignment-Assessment-Emails)
- [Course Comments Emails](#Course-Comments-Emails)
- [How to Set Up and Customize Assessment Emails](#How-to-Set-Up-and-Customize-Assessment-Emails)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)

---

# **What is Course Assessment Emails?**

Course Assessment Emails are automated notifications that HighLevel sends when learners submit or receive feedback on quizzes, assignments, or course comments. These messages help keep learners and instructors aligned as progress happens and ensure no important updates are missed. The feature uses customizable email templates that include contextual information such as course name, assessment title, grading status, and more—to deliver timely communication. Course creators can edit or disable these emails at the course level to match their workflow and branding.

---

## **Key Benefits of Course Assessment Emails**

Course Assessment Emails provide timely updates that strengthen communication and reduce manual follow-up throughout the learning experience.

Understanding the benefits helps course creators leverage automated notifications to streamline grading workflows and support learner engagement. These advantages ensure both students and instructors maintain visibility into submissions, grading progress, and course activity.

- **Real-time learner feedback**: Students immediately receive confirmation of submissions and grades.

- **Instructor visibility**: Admins and graders are notified the moment new work is submitted or graded.

- **Brand-consistent messaging**: Emails are fully customizable inside Email Settings → Courses.

- **Improved workflow efficiency**: Automated updates reduce manual communication and delays.

- **Course-level control**: Each notification can be individually toggled on or off based on course needs.

---

## **Quiz Assessment Emails**

Quiz Assessment Emails notify both learners and instructors when quizzes are submitted, ensuring prompt visibility into quiz activity.

These notifications help learners confirm their quiz submission and allow instructors to stay informed without constant manual checking. This maintains transparency in the learning workflow and improves response time for evaluation.

- **Quiz Submitted (User):** Sent to learners as confirmation after submitting a quiz.

- **Quiz Submitted (Admin):** Sent to instructors or course admins when a quiz is submitted.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155060491318/original/G7h-mxM6Hk9upvEy3LKzGcBQN2JJkPir0w.png?1765541075)

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155060492028/original/hHDpcc-meckM_TSYxeLcRD7Zz3kyhdCTww.png?1765541385)**

---

## **Assignment Assessment Emails**

Assignment Assessment Emails notify learners and admins when assignments are submitted or graded, ensuring timely updates throughout the evaluation process.

These emails support accountability and clarity during assignment review cycles. Learners receive assurance their work was received, while instructors stay informed of what requires grading. Once graded, both parties receive updates that complete the feedback loop.

- **Assignment Submitted (User):** Confirms that the learner’s assignment upload was successful.

- **Assignment Submitted (Admin):** Alerts instructors that a new assignment is ready to review.

- **Assignment Graded (User):** Provides grading details, including scores or pass/fail results.

- **Assignment Graded (Admin):** Notifies admins that grading is complete.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155060493164/original/55VDxLrNKvJ-R2zYiO_dWKRSsur1vY2zsg.png?1765541891)**

---

## **Course Comments Emails**

Course Comments Emails notify instructors whenever learners leave comments on courses, encouraging timely responses and improved engagement.

Course comments are key to fostering communication and community within courses. By receiving instant notifications, instructors can quickly respond to learner questions or feedback and maintain meaningful interaction.

- **Course Comments (Admin):** Sent to instructors when a learner posts a comment on course content.

---

## **How to Set Up and Customize Assessment Emails**

Setting up Course Assessment Emails ensures the right notifications are enabled so learners and instructors receive timely updates when quizzes or assignments are submitted or graded. Proper configuration helps maintain smooth communication and reduces confusion, ensuring important course activity is always visible.

Customizing these email templates allows you to adjust subject lines, messaging, and branding to match your organization’s style and create a consistent learner experience. Personalizing templates improves clarity and reinforces your brand, ensuring each notification feels professional and aligned with your communication standards.

### **Open Client Portal Settings**

To begin customizing a Course Assessment Email, navigate to **Memberships → Client Portal → Settings** from the top menu. The Settings page displays all configuration options for your client portal, including branding, permissions, and email settings.

### **Access Email Settings**

From the Client Portal Settings page, select **Email Settings** to open all email notification options for your client portal. This area allows you to manage system-generated messages for courses, communities, certificates, and more.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155060495847/original/64KfOhuYLDoBo774Cf0rLgeqIhcxY0nznQ.png?1765543659)

### **Open the Courses Tab**

In the Email Settings section, click the **Courses** tab to view all course-related notification types. This includes sign-up emails, drip notifications, course comments, material unlocks, and the full set of Assessment Emails.

Scroll down to the **Assessment Email** section and locate the email you want to customize. Click the **Preview (eye icon)** next to the Default Template to view the current version of the email before editing.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155060495884/original/oFSbmNiHn9S7_j49niyR0BGXJCZfTq3fFA.png?1765543677)

### **Enable or Disable Assessment Emails**

Use the checkboxes in the Assessment Email section to toggle each notification on or off based on your course’s needs. Turning a notification on ensures that learners or admins receive updates for quiz submissions, assignment submissions, and grading events at the appropriate time.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155060497580/original/n0NhwCEU7elr4GQfOmRJ6Z_ivmJ3_dGHuQ.png?1765544684)

### **Preview the Email Template**

A preview window will appear showing the default message, layout, and merge fields used in the Assessment Email. This helps you confirm whether you want to modify the existing design or keep it as-is.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155060495963/original/VdwiD1-IaUPfdXhD76P1CxwzUkhMbWs2zw.png?1765543698)

### **Open Template Customization**

Click the **Default Template** button next to the selected assessment email and choose **Edit** from the customization menu. This prepares the system to create a customizable version of the default template.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155060495993/original/lWA_VV4R5SETf3zAUp8PnkxkhBXd86zK8w.png?1765543726)

### **Proceed to Edit Template**

A confirmation screen will appear, indicating that HighLevel will generate a new editable email template based on the default layout. Click **Proceed** to open the template in the Email Builder, where you can begin making your design and content changes.

Update text, colors, branding, and custom values as needed.

Click Save & Publish to apply changes to future emails.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155060496015/original/aEubc8DdjIWAblUeHvqWVITkYSDG0mlRXA.png?1765543742)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Can I disable Assessment Emails for a specific course without affecting others?**

Yes. Each course has independent email toggles, so changes apply only to that specific course.

**Q: Do Course Assessment Emails use email credits?**

Yes. They count as transactional emails and use standard email credits.

**Q: Who receives the admin versions of these emails?**

Any user assigned as an instructor or admin within **Course → Settings → Instructors**.

**Q: Can I add additional buttons or links to the admin email templates?**

Yes. Use the Email Builder to insert buttons and link them to course or grading URLs.

**Q: Can these templates be translated?**

Absolutely. Replace the default English text with your translated content; UTF-8 is fully supported.

**Q: Will learners receive duplicate emails if I also use workflows?**

No. However, it’s recommended to disable one of the triggers if you want to avoid overlapping notifications.

title_en: Pre and Post buffers
source_md:
Pre and post buffers give you extra time before or after appointments for preparation, travel, follow-up, or other transition activities. HighLevel automatically uses configured buffer times when calculating appointment availability. You can also display those buffers directly in Day and Week Calendar views, making it easier to understand your schedule at a glance. This article explains how to configure, view, and manage pre- and post-buffer time in HighLevel.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Pre and Post Buffer Time?](#What-is-Pre-and-Post-Buffer-Time?)
  - [Key Benefits of Pre and Post Buffer Time](#Key-Benefits-of-Pre-and-Post-Buffer-Time)
  - [How Buffer Time Affects Appointment Availability](#How-Buffer-Time-Affects-Appointment-Availability)
  - [Viewing Buffer Time in Day and Week Calendar Views](#Viewing-Buffer-Time-in-Day-and-Week-Calendar-Views)
  - [Buffer Time and External Calendar Events](#Buffer-Time-and-External-Calendar-Events)
  - [How To Setup Pre and Post Buffer Time](#How-To-Setup-Pre-and-Post-Buffer-Time)
  - [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
  - [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is Pre and Post Buffer Time?**

Pre- and post-buffer times reserve additional time immediately before or after an appointment. These periods help prevent appointments from being scheduled too close together while giving users dedicated transition time for activities such as preparation, travel, documentation, or follow-up.

A **pre-buffer** reserves time before an appointment, while a **post-buffer** reserves time after it. Buffer settings are configured at the calendar level and influence which appointment slots remain available for booking.

HighLevel can also display configured buffers as informational blocks in the **Day** and **Week** Calendar views. This visual representation makes it easier to distinguish appointment time from the transition time surrounding it.

---

## **Key Benefits of Pre and Post Buffer Time**

- **Better schedule visibility:** View configured pre- and post-buffer periods directly alongside appointments in Day and Week views.
- **More preparation time:** Reserve time before meetings for research, setup, travel, or other preparation.
- **More follow-up time:** Add space after appointments for notes, administrative work, cleanup, or travel.
- **Reduced back-to-back scheduling:** Prevent new appointments from being booked too close to existing appointments.
- **Easier schedule planning:** Visually identify the time occupied by buffers without confusing it with the appointment itself.
- **Flexible calendar management:** Show or hide buffer blocks in Calendar View without changing the underlying buffer configuration.

---

## **How Buffer Time Affects Appointment Availability**

Buffer time becomes part of the availability calculation around an appointment. Understanding this behavior helps explain why a time period that appears open may not always be available for another booking.

For example, if an appointment lasts 30 minutes and has a 15-minute pre-buffer and a 15-minute post-buffer, HighLevel reserves additional time on both sides of the appointment. A new appointment must satisfy the buffer requirements of both the existing appointment and the appointment being scheduled.

Using both pre- and post-buffers can create situations where apparently open periods cannot be booked because the required buffers overlap. If maximizing the number of bookable time slots is important, consider whether only a pre-buffer or only a post-buffer is necessary for the calendar.

Buffer settings associated with a user can also affect that user's availability on other calendars:

- On **Round Robin calendars**, buffer settings from a user's other calendars can affect availability and may contribute to uneven appointment distribution.
- On **Collective calendars**, a user's existing buffer time can prevent a slot from being available when that user is required for the appointment.

For additional information about calendar availability, see [Adjusting Availability Settings for Individual Calendars](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001155718-adjusting-availability-settings-for-individual-calendars).

---

## **Viewing Buffer Time in Day and Week Calendar Views**

Visible buffer blocks help users understand why time surrounding an appointment is unavailable without having to review the calendar's configuration. The display is informational and does not change the duration or scheduling behavior of the configured buffer.

1. Go to **Calendars**.
2. Open **Calendar view**.
3. Click **Manage view**.
4. Turn on **Show buffer time**.
5. Use the available Users, Calendars, Groups, or other supported filters to view the relevant schedule.
6. Pre- and post-buffer periods associated with appointments will appear as visually distinct blocks next to the appointment.

Turning **Show buffer time** off only hides the buffer blocks from Calendar View. It does not remove the configured buffer or make the reserved time available for booking.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155079484729/original/KJ2lXtk8sO0494rHy3o-FVrqf3rmvQUBJg.png?1787849837)

---

## **How To Setup Pre and Post Buffer Time**

Properly configuring buffer time ensures HighLevel reserves the intended amount of transition time when calculating appointment availability. Choose buffer durations based on the preparation or follow-up time realistically required for the type of appointment being scheduled.

1. Go to **Calendars**.
2. Open **Calendar settings**.
3. Select the calendar where you want to configure buffer time and click **Edit**.
4. Open the **Availability** settings.
5. Locate **Pre buffer time** and **Post buffer time**.
6. Set the desired duration for either or both buffer types.
7. Save your changes.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155079484904/original/mfM9iXPqgrr_jv9dQaOghAcNVi9nK0RRZw.png?1787849917)**

To remove buffer time from future availability calculations:

1. Return to the calendar's **Availability** settings.
2. Set the applicable **Pre buffer time** or **Post buffer time** value to **0**.
3. Save your changes.

Buffer behavior is based on the current calendar settings, so changing the configured duration can alter how availability is calculated around appointments.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Does turning off Show buffer time remove the actual buffer?**  
No. The **Show buffer time** toggle controls only whether buffer blocks are visible in Calendar View. The configured pre- or post-buffer continues to affect appointment availability.

**Q: Why can't I see buffer time in my current Calendar view?**  
Buffer visibility is supported in **Day** and **Week** views. Confirm that you are using one of those views and that **Manage view → Show buffer time** is enabled.

**Q: Does displaying buffer time change appointment availability?**

No. Displaying a buffer only makes the existing reserved period visible. Appointment availability is determined by the buffer duration configured in the calendar settings.

**Q: What is the difference between a buffer and a blocked calendar event?**  
A buffer is transition time reserved before or after an appointment. A blocked event or conflict-calendar event represents a separate period when a user is unavailable because of another calendar commitment.

**Q: Can I change a buffer after appointments have already been booked?**  
Yes. Buffer calculations use the latest applicable settings, so changing the configured buffer can affect availability around existing appointments.

**Q: Why does a time period look open but remain unavailable for booking?**  
The available period may not be long enough to satisfy the appointment duration and required buffers. Using both pre- and post-buffers can also create overlapping buffer requirements that remove otherwise visible time from the booking schedule.

**Q: Can buffer settings affect Round Robin appointment distribution?**  
Yes. A user's buffer time can affect their availability across calendars. If users have different buffer requirements, the number of available slots for each user can differ and may influence distribution.

**Q: Do third-party calendar events automatically receive visible buffers?**  
Not necessarily. Third-party events may be treated as appointments or as blocked availability depending on the calendar synchronization configuration. Buffer display should not be confused with external busy or conflict periods.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Calendar View Enhancements](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000006757-calendar-view-enhancements)
- [Adjusting Availability Settings for Individual Calendars](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001155718-adjusting-availability-settings-for-individual-calendars)
- [Getting Started - Setup A Booking Calendar](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005061/)
- [Round Robin Calendars: Setup, Distribution & Availability Explained](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000001485-how-to-create-round-robin-calendars)
- [Setting Up Linked Calendars & Conflict Calendars](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000002374-setting-up-linked-calendars-conflict-calendars)
- [Why Appointment Time Slots Are Missing on Your Calendar](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001181711-why-appointment-time-slots-are-missing-on-your-calendar)

title_en: Opportunities V2 Mobile App
source_md:
Opportunities

# Opportunities V2 Mobile App

Customize opportunity cards, execute quick actions, and manage your entire sales pipeline from a unified mobile interface.

What You'll Learn

This guide walks you through the redesigned Opportunities mobile experience, covering customizable card layouts, quick actions, and integrated detail views that streamline your lead management workflow.

You'll discover how to personalize your pipeline, take immediate actions on opportunities, and access all lead information in one unified screen—reducing clicks and accelerating deal closures.

## What is Opportunities V2 Mobile App?

Opportunities V2 is HighLevel's redesigned mobile lead management interface that provides personalized card layouts and integrated functionality for sales teams on the go. This update consolidates opportunity details, quick actions, and contextual information into a unified workspace, reducing the need to navigate through multiple screens or tabs.

The mobile experience allows you to customize which fields appear on opportunity cards, execute immediate actions like calling or messaging, and access comprehensive lead information—all from a single, intuitive interface designed to accelerate your sales process.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077935891/original/nKkwbsQOxv3mwyJA79EhbJm50clYBPBJSA.png?1786170368)

## Key Benefits

The redesigned mobile opportunity experience delivers measurable improvements to your sales workflow by eliminating unnecessary navigation and consolidating essential actions into a single interface.

**Save Time** — Access critical opportunity details with fewer clicks and faster navigation through your pipeline.

**Boost Revenue** — Execute quick follow-up actions directly from opportunity cards, accelerating your deal closure rate.

**Empower Teams** — Customize card views to display only the information your team needs for clarity and control.

**Delight Customers** — Respond faster with integrated notes, tasks, and appointments accessible from a single screen.

## Customizable Opportunity Cards

Opportunity cards can be tailored to display only the fields and quick actions that matter most to your workflow. Choose from over 40 available fields and configure up to 7 custom fields per card, ensuring your pipeline shows exactly what you need at a glance.

Default Fields

Standard Card Layout

Each opportunity card displays Name, Value, and Owner on the top line by default. You can select up to 4 additional custom fields from options including Source, Business, Lost Reason, and 37+ other available fields.

Quick Actions

Configure Card-Level Actions

Default quick actions include Message, Add Tag, Add Task, and Move Opportunity. You can customize which actions appear on your cards to match your team's most frequent workflows.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077935908/original/58C57d2YZJoke6A11nsyxru4kfmBpzUtPQ.png?1786170435)

Pro Tip

Customize your card layout to prioritize the fields your team checks most frequently, reducing the time spent opening detailed views for routine information.

## Redesigned Pipelines

The updated pipeline interface provides a modern, streamlined view of your opportunity stages with interactive cards that support direct actions. All critical lead management functions are accessible without leaving the pipeline view, eliminating context switching and reducing friction in your workflow.

Interactive Cards

Direct Actions from Pipeline View

Take immediate action on opportunities including calling, adding notes, creating tasks, applying tags, and changing stages—all directly from the card without opening detailed views.

Activity Badges

Visual Status Indicators

Active badges display counters for conversations, notes, tasks, and tags on each opportunity card, providing instant visibility into lead activity without opening the full record.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077935912/original/wI3RJV4GUGxuvTSN9OutdLwBelFonI4H3A.png?1786170447)

## All-in-One Opportunity View

The detailed opportunity view consolidates all lead information into a single screen with tabbed navigation for different information types. This unified interface eliminates the need to navigate between separate screens to view call logs, messages, tasks, appointments, or transaction history.

Quick Actions Bar

Immediate Engagement Options

Access top quick actions including call, message, and tag directly from the opportunity detail view for instant lead engagement without leaving the screen.

Integrated Tabs

Consolidated Information Access

Switch between Details, Tasks, Notes, Appointments, and Transactions tabs to view and manage every aspect of the opportunity in one unified interface. Edit information, add updates, and track activity seamlessly without changing screens.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077935914/original/0oPxIlJbj0gcwqLxs9UpKt96QoAGeta54A.png?1786170456)

Pro Tip

Watch for counters on conversations, notes, tasks, and tags in the tab bar—these indicators help you identify which areas need attention without opening each tab individually.

Ready to Get Started?

Set Up Your Custom Pipeline

Follow the setup steps below to configure your personalized opportunity cards and start closing deals faster.

## How to Set Up Opportunities V2

Setting up the enhanced mobile opportunity experience requires customizing your card layout and familiarizing yourself with the updated pipeline interface. Follow these steps to configure your workflow for maximum efficiency.

Customize Your Opportunity Cards

Step 1

Access Card Customization Settings

Open the mobile app and navigate to **Opportunities → Settings → Customize Cards**.

Step 2

Select Fields and Quick Actions

Choose from 40+ available fields and select the quick actions you want to appear on your opportunity cards.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077935916/original/SCHY9E06oFi8TyenOxOCP0wg9RSxH8JBUg.png?1786170469)

Step 3

Activate Your Configuration

Select up to 7 fields (including the 3 default fields: Name, Value, and Owner) and choose your preferred quick actions.

Step 4

Save and Apply Changes

Tap **Save**. Your personalized opportunity cards will refresh instantly in your pipeline view.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077935921/original/l2Zb6_tldj2M8lKHJ4f_F44RJpRRrxNifg.png?1786170479)

Navigate the Updated Pipelines

Step 1

Open Pipeline View

In the mobile app, navigate to **Opportunities → Pipelines** to view your updated stages.

Step 2

Interact with Customized Cards

Explore the updated stages and interact with customized cards. Execute quick actions such as calling, adding notes or tasks, tagging, and changing stages directly from each card.

Use the All-in-One Detail View

Step 1

Open Opportunity Details

Tap any opportunity card within your pipeline to open the detailed view.

Step 2

Execute Quick Actions

Use the top quick actions for immediate engagement, including call, message, and tag functions.

Step 3

Navigate Information Tabs

Switch between tabs—Details, Tasks, Notes, Appointments, and Transactions—to manage every aspect of the opportunity in one unified screen. Edit information, add updates, and track activity without leaving the detail view.

Note

This update will reset your current mobile card layout and fields to the default configuration. You will need to reconfigure your preferences using the customization settings after updating the app.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: When is this update available?

The Opportunities V2 mobile app update is live. Update your HighLevel mobile app to access the enhanced features.

Q: Will this update reset my current mobile card layout?

Yes, the update will reset your current mobile card layout and fields to the default configuration. You will need to reconfigure your custom fields and quick actions through the customization settings.

Q: What are the default fields on opportunity cards?

Default fields include Name, Value, Owner, Source, Business, and Lost Reason. Name, Value, and Owner always appear on the top line of each card when selected.

Q: How many custom fields can I display on each opportunity card?

You can display up to 4 custom fields on each card. Additionally, 3 bonus fields—Name, Value, and Owner—always appear on the top line by default when selected.

Q: What default quick actions are available on cards?

Default quick actions include Message, Add Tag, Add Task, and Move Opportunity. You can customize which actions appear on your cards through the settings.

Q: Will these customization changes affect how opportunities appear on desktop?

No, these customization changes are exclusive to the mobile app. The desktop view remains unchanged.

Q: Do changes to mobile customization affect the web layout?

No, changes made on the mobile app apply only to the mobile layout. The web layout continues to work according to your existing web configuration. Customizations are platform-specific.

Q: Is the Opportunities V2 experience available only on mobile?

Yes, the updated customization and layout enhancements described in this article apply exclusively to the mobile app. Similar functionality is already available on the web platform and continues to function according to your existing web configuration.

title_en: Conversation AI - Human Handover Action
source_md:
[동영상](https://www.youtube.com/embed/WhN\_VBxiMFQ?&wmode=opaque)

Deliver exceptional customer experiences by ensuring your AI bot knows when to step aside for a real person. The new Human Handover feature in HighLevel's Conversation AI enables smooth, intelligent transitions from automated chat to your team—boosting satisfaction and trust.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Human Handover in Conversation AI?](#What-is-Human-Handover-in-Conversation-AI?)
- [Key Benefits of Human Handover](#Key-Benefits-of-Human-Handover)
- [How To Setup Human Handover Action](#How-To-Setup-Human-Handover-Action)
- [Notification Management for Assigned user](#Notification-Management-for-Assigned-user)
- [Customizing Handover Actions](#Customizing-Handover-Actions)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is Human Handover in Conversation AI?**

Human Handover is an advanced feature within HighLevel’s Conversation AI that automatically transfers conversations from the AI bot to a human team member when certain conditions are met. This ensures that customers receive personalized support whenever the AI reaches its limitations, such as when facing complex queries, repeated misunderstandings, or direct requests to speak with a human.

By leveraging Human Handover, businesses can prevent customer frustration, resolve issues more efficiently, and maintain a seamless conversational flow between automation and live support.  
  
Human Handover is released via Labs, so it may need to be enabled before it appears in Conversation AI.

---

## **Key Benefits of Human Handover**

Unlocking Human Handover in your workflow delivers tangible improvements to both customer experience and operational efficiency:

 

- **Eliminates Dead Ends:** Customers are never left without support, even if the bot can’t resolve their issue.
- **Smart Escalation:** Automatically detects when the AI is stuck, fails repeatedly, or receives a direct human request.
- **Seamless Transition:** Assigns a team member, creates a follow-up task, sends a closing message, and pauses the bot—all in one flow.
- **Improved Customer Satisfaction:** Builds trust by ensuring real people are available when needed.
- **Efficient Team Notification:** Notifies staff instantly about handovers and new tasks, reducing response times.
- **Customizable Triggers & Actions:** Tailor when and how handovers happen to fit your business needs.

---

## **How To Setup Human Handover Action**

Setting up Human Handover ensures your customers always have access to the right support at the right time. Follow these steps to enable and configure this feature in HighLevel:

 

### **Step 1:**Navigate to Bot Goals

1. Click on **AI Agents** from your sub-account.
2. Click on the **Conversation AI** tab.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/v/GagVAP7gVSPaJBadjA8g+/Screen+Shot+2025-06-27+at+7.22.09+PM.png)
3. Click on the **Bot's****Name** or on the **Three Dots** beside last updated and click on **Edit**.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/v/BLk3LnWKYy80y8eibjSt+/Screen+Shot+2025-06-27+at+7.24.29+PM.png)
4. Click on the **Bot Goals** tab.
5. Scroll down to **Setup Your Actions** sections and click on **Human Handover** button.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/v/a9ykW3E9zMabwGvnj5hN+/Screen+Shot+2025-06-27+at+7.27.56+PM.png)

### **Step 2:**Select a Prebuilt Scenario

Choose from predefined conditions under which the bot will trigger a handover:

#### **1. Human Requested**

#### 

- Turn on the **Enable Scenario** toggle to use it.
- **Trigger:** User explicitly asks to speak with a human.
- Click on the **+ Add Example Phrase button** to add custom phrases.
- **Example Phrases:**I want to talk to a human | Can someone real help me? | Connect me to a person  
    
  ![](https://jumpshare.com/v/PoOQiLisH28GDqtTX7Lv+/Screen+Shot+2025-06-27+at+7.35.39+PM.png)

#### **2. Lack of Information**

- Turn on the **Enable Scenario** toggle to use it.
- **Trigger:** The AI cannot find the relevant information or lacks knowledge on the query.
- No custom examples needed.  
    
  ![](https://jumpshare.com/v/iFTap75ySewhRodwoV3M+/Screen+Shot+2025-06-27+at+7.44.06+PM.png)

#### **3. Failed to Resolve Issue**

#### 

- Turn on the **Enable Scenario** toggle to use it.
- **Trigger:** Multiple attempts to resolve the issue has failed.
- Max **2 retires**.
- No custom examples needed.  
    
  ![](https://jumpshare.com/v/hrU2e9VuNLLF5aOshLis+/Screen+Shot+2025-06-27+at+7.47.48+PM.png)

### **Step 3:**Configure Post-Handover Actions

Customise what happens once the bot hands over the conversation:

#### **1. Assign Conversation to a User**

- Choose a **specific user to assign the conversation**.
- **Optional:** Skip assignment if the contact already has an assigned user.  
    
  ![](https://jumpshare.com/v/rYFRvoUTRYobTSkt30p4+/Screen+Shot+2025-06-27+at+7.56.04+PM.png)

#### **2. Final Message**

- The final message that the **bot will send before handing over the conversation to a human**.
- **Example Message:** "Thank you! Someone from the team will get back to you."  
    
  ![](https://jumpshare.com/v/r127iNEyvhC3k0e8WILt+/Screen+Shot+2025-06-27+at+8.05.45+PM.png)

#### **3. Bot Pause Behaviour**

- Set a timer to **resume bot interactions at a later time**.
- You can set the duration in **Days, Hours and Minutes**.  
    
  ![](https://jumpshare.com/v/9wnBDaIIT1jIVTNsDIRf+/Screen+Shot+2025-06-27+at+8.09.28+PM.png)

#### **4. Create a Task**

#### 

- A task will be created within the contact when human handover is triggered.
- **Due time:** 24 hours from trigger.  
    
  ![](https://jumpshare.com/v/zZWAy3ZAfVU4BtjUQe5Q+/Screen+Shot+2025-06-27+at+8.11.25+PM.png)

#### **5. Create Tags**

- Add a tag to contact after human handover is completed.
- **Default tag:** human\_handover  
    
  ![](https://jumpshare.com/v/eifeAIQnGT7pnlJ5rXER+/Screen+Shot+2025-06-27+at+8.15.21+PM.png)

---

## **Notification Management for Assigned user**

#### 

Ensure that your staff receives timely alerts is crucial for prompt human intervention.

1. Go to **Settings** from your sub-account.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/v/vmz3iKoKFKDz1J0u7mIz+/Screen+Shot+2025-06-27+at+8.26.11+PM.png)
2. Click on the **My Staff** tab.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/v/IsaEmUB2SQXRhiBSPDwb+/Screen+Shot+2025-06-27+at+9.17.12+PM.png)
3. Click on the **Edit** action button for the particular staff you want to notify.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/v/P4BnEaMV15lvjdiUsMVe+/Screen+Shot+2025-06-27+at+9.21.14+PM.png)
4. Click on the **Notification Settings** tab.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/v/DJSmxApyDBhBaU5nFkaA+/Screen+Shot+2025-06-27+at+9.24.28+PM.png)
5. **Enable Notifications** for all channels:  
     
   - When a conversation gets assigned to me
   - When a task gets assigned to me
   - Click on **Save**.  
       
     ![](https://jumpshare.com/v/Aj5BMWUzPiQlVYwxSM2L+/Screen+Shot+2025-06-27+at+9.27.55+PM.png)

```
Note: You can configure a maximum of 6 handover actions per bot.
```

---

## **Customizing Handover Actions**

Tailor the handover process to match your team’s workflow and customer expectations.

 

- Assign conversations to specific staff based on expertise or availability.
- Automatically create actionable tasks with clear deadlines.
- Personalize closing messages to maintain a friendly, professional tone.
- Adjust bot pause duration to allow human follow-up before automation resumes.
- Use conversation tags for reporting and workflow automation.  
    
    
  ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155072661968/original/VJQDwQScN8CDXNTT6qmYsghT9hsfzhBTMQ.png?1780380309)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Can I customize the message sent to customers during a handover?**

Yes, you can personalize the closing message that’s sent when a handover is triggered.

**Q: What happens if no team member is assigned during a handover?**

The conversation will remain unassigned until a staff member claims it, so it’s best to set up default assignees for seamless support.

**Q: Can I set different triggers for different bots or workflows?**

Yes, triggers can be customized per bot or workflow within the Bot Goals section.

**Q: How does the bot know when to pause, and for how long?**

You can configure the cooldown period during which the bot will not respond, giving your team time to intervene.

**Q: Will my team get notified immediately after a handover?**

Yes, as long as notifications for assigned conversations and new tasks are enabled in staff settings.

**Q: Is there a way to track all conversations that have been handed over?**

Yes, conversations are tagged with human\_handover for easy filtering and reporting.

**Q: Can I disable Human Handover for certain workflows?**

Absolutely, simply toggle off the feature in the relevant Bot Goals configuration.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Conversation AI Bot - Explained](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000001335)
- [Setting Up Conversation AI](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000004401)
