- [How to Use Conversation AI to Book Appointments](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000000210)
- [Conversation AI - Transfer Bot Action](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005371)

title_en: Reputation Management - Video Testimonials
source_md:
[동영상](https://www.youtube.com/embed/VJj-cvYVlGs?&wmode=opaque)

Video Testimonials lets your business collect authentic customer video reviews and publish them on your website—directly from HighLevel. Create branded Video Collectors, send requests via Email, SMS, or WhatsApp, manage responses, and display them in Review Widgets. This guide covers setup, sending, management, and display best practices.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Video Testimonials in Reputation Management?](#What-is-Video-Testimonials-in-Reputation-Management?)
- [Key Benefits of Video Testimonials](#Key-Benefits-of-Video-Testimonials)
- [How To Create Video Collectors](#How-To-Create-Video-Collectors)
- [How to Share & Manage Video Testimonials](#How-to-Share-&-Manage-Video-Testimonials)
- [How to Manage and Download Responses](#How-to-Manage-and-Download-Responses)
- [How to Display Videos in the Review Widget](#How-to-Display-Videos-in-the-Review-Widget)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is Video Testimonials in Reputation Management?**

Video Testimonials is a Reputation feature that allows you to collect customer video reviews using shareable, branded “**Video** **Collectors**.” Contacts can record or upload a video from desktop or mobile (no app required). Collected videos can then be reviewed internally and showcased on your site using the Review Widget.

---

## **Key Benefits of Video Testimonials**

- **Authenticity:** Real faces and voices build trust far faster than text-only reviews.
- **Frictionless capture:** Contacts record or upload from any modern device—no app required.
- **Brand control:** Customize collector branding (logo, background, text, accent, button colors) to match your visual identity.
- **Centralized management:** Review Video Testimonial submissions and manage their widget visibility from the Responses tab.
- **Flexible showcasing:** Display Video Testimonials in Review Widgets, filter them by collector, and control which individual testimonials appear publicly.
- **Easy showcasing:** Add videos to your existing Review Widget, with layout options and per‑collector filtering.
- **Performance guardrails:** Each video is capped at 2 minutes 30 seconds to keep files lightweight and watchable.

---

## **How To Create Video Collectors**

Follow these steps to create a video collector.

### **Step 1:** Create a Video Collector

1. Login to your sub-account.
2. Go to **Reputation** → **Video Testimonials**.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/VqgfyloSbiBdNL11RcZz+/Screen+Shot+2025-11-27+at+7.32.45+PM.png)
3. Click **+ Create Collector or Create a Collector** button.  
     
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155059385390/original/a5Bwg2mIkgGRZqYNdJCy7NyAU9PY0NlKMQ.jpeg?1764252759)

### **Step 2:** Setup Welcome Page

1. Add **Public Collector Title**.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/fwLsUTx7DFKNM8vu61q5+/Screen+Shot+2025-11-27+at+7.50.19+PM.png)
2. **Enable** or **disable** **Spokesperson** **Image:**Make your collector personal with a friendly face from your company. This can be you or a colleague.
3. Add **Spokesperson** **details.**   
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/hX0EPT7tDzFcttU03uqA+/Screen+Shot+2025-11-27+at+7.51.26+PM.png)
4. Add **How it Works section:**A short description about how everything works.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/1Ch6ZE8LQPzaONtWHEbk+/Screen+Shot+2025-11-27+at+7.52.46+PM.png)
5. Add **Welcome Message:**A short message from your collector's spokesperson.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/fLTUjohlT2TIdYQTrNBG+/Screen+Shot+2025-11-27+at+7.53.47+PM.png)

### **Step 3:** Setup Questionnaire Page

1. Add up to **3** questions.
2. Order them for a **guided flow**.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/hnMRa0ybKAaOGKTR3hkM+/Screen+Shot+2025-11-27+at+8.05.48+PM.png)

### **Step 4:** Setup Attribution Page

After your questions, we ask respondents to **identify themselves,** or to confirm their info when it's been preloaded with a personalised link.

1. Add **Headline**.
2. Add **Message**.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/8W7duvySYxPLj8eVrKm8+/Screen+Shot+2025-11-27+at+8.09.19+PM.png)

### **Step 5:** Thank You Page

1. Add **Headline**.
2. Add **Message**.
3. Add **Spokesperson's Email**.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/z9pJtDx1qCqfEebwiBkR+/Screen+Shot+2025-11-27+at+8.14.31+PM.png)

### **Step 6:** Set Logo & Colors

1. **Enable** and **Add logo**.
2. **Enable** or **Disable** **White** **Background** **Behind** **Logo**.
3. Set **background**, **text**, **secondary** **text**, **accent**, and **button** **colors**.
4. Click **Save**.   
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/CXsWO5GWj4Qt9oEbecNf+/Screen+Shot+2025-11-27+at+8.25.04+PM.png)
5. Click **Preview** to see exactly what your client will see when they open the collector to record their video review.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/cSGrkW7hCcD6hnMiwCoT+/Screen+Shot+2025-11-27+at+9.00.42+PM.png)

---

## **How to Share & Manage Video Testimonials**

### **1. Via Link**

1. From **Video** **Testimonials** → **Collectors**, **locate** **your** **collector**.
2. Click **Copy** **Link** and share by **email, chat, social, or QR**.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/0XyIYWbhUeZvpNnjiIR4+/GIF+Recording+2025-11-27+at+9.41.51+PM.gif)

### **2. Send a Video Review Request (Email/SMS/WhatsApp)**

1. Click **Send** **Review** **Request**or the **share icon** of the collector.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/T9DURcaVubhhe1bwin4T+/Screen+Shot+2025-11-27+at+9.43.15+PM.png)
2. Select **Contact**.
3. Select **Email**, **SMS**, or **WhatsApp**.
4. Use **Override** **Video** **Link** to choose which collector to include.
5. Select Default Email/SMS/WhatsApp Template or pre-made custom templates.
6. Click on **Send Review Request**.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/lWRSNbGGsMwhqaikRmEv+/Screen+Shot+2025-11-27+at+9.51.38+PM.png)

---

## **How to Manage and Download Responses**

Go to **Reputation → Video Testimonials → Responses** to review and manage submitted Video Testimonials.

From the Responses page, you can:

- Identify newly received testimonials that have not yet been reviewed.
- See whether a testimonial is currently displayed on the Review Widget.
- Show or hide individual testimonials from the widget.
- Open a submission to view the video.
- Download the original video file.

### **Manage Testimonial Visibility**

Use the visibility controls on the Responses page to control whether an individual Video Testimonial appears on the   
Review Widget.

You can show or hide a testimonial without editing the widget configuration each time.  
  
![](https://jumpshare.com/share/5MaLuBcvjHZ4kGMdJ2n5+/GIF+Recording+2025-11-27+at+9.56.04+PM.gif)

---

## **How to Display Videos in the Review Widget**

1. Go to **Reputation** > **Widgets**.
2. **Create** or **Edit** a Review Widget.
3. Select **Review** **Type** as **Video** **Testimonials**.
4. Choose **Video** **Testimonial** **Source**as the collector you want to display.
5. Choose **widget** **type**, **number** **of** **reviews**, **override** **video** **link** and **enable** or **disable** **powered by**.
6. Click **Save**.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/MajrGgax40XeaxAopVog+/GIF+Recording+2025-11-27+at+9.58.58+PM.gif)

### **Choose How New Video Testimonials Are Published**

When configuring Video Testimonials in the Review Widget, choose how new submissions are handled.

- **Auto-publish new video testimonials:** New Video Testimonials automatically appear on the widget. This is the default behavior.
- **Require manual approval before publishing:** New Video Testimonials must be reviewed before they appear on the widget.

Use auto-publishing when new submissions can appear automatically. Use manual approval when your team needs to review each submission before making it visible.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Do customers need to install an app to record a video?**

No. They can record or upload directly from desktop or mobile using the collector link.

**Q: What’s the maximum video length?**

Up to **2** minutes **30** seconds per submission.

**Q: How many questions can I add to a collector?**

Up to three questions in the Questionnaire step.

**Q: Can I create more than one collector?**

Yes. You can create unlimited collectors per location, and you can clone existing ones.

**Q: Where do I find submitted videos?**

Go to Reputation → Video Testimonials → Responses to view and download them.

**Q: Can I show only certain videos on my site?**

Yes. Use the per-collector filter in the Review Widget to display testimonials from a specific Video Collector. You can also show or hide individual Video Testimonials from **Reputation → Video Testimonials → Responses**.

**Q: Which channels support sending the collector link?**

Email, SMS, and WhatsApp via Send Review Request.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Customizing Review Widgets in Reputation](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000000997)
- [How to Send Review Requests](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48001222668)
- [Reputation - Breaking Down the Reputation Overview Dashboard](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48001222767)
- [Attaching Images to Review Requests](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000006936)

title_en: How to Add Retail Products to Service Appointments
source_md:
HighLevel allows you to add retail products directly to service appointments, so customers can purchase services and products during the same visit. You can select products from your catalog, adjust quantities and prices, and view the combined appointment total. Inventory also updates automatically for products with stock tracking enabled. This article explains how to add retail products and manage their payment and inventory details.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What are Retail Products in Service Appointments?](#What-are-Retail-Products-in-Service-Appointments?)
- [Adding Retail Products to Appointments](#Adding-Retail-Products-to-Appointments)
- [Managing Product Quantities and Prices](#Managing-Product-Quantities-and-Prices)
- [Understanding Appointment Payments](#Understanding-Appointment-Payments)
- [How Retail Products Affect Inventory](#How-Retail-Products-Affect-Inventory)
- [Viewing Retail Products in Booking Details](#Viewing-Retail-Products-in-Booking-Details)
- [How to Add Retail Products to Service Appointments](#How-to-Add-Retail-Products-to-Service-Appointments)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What are Retail Products in Service Appointments?**

Retail Products in Service Appointments allow you to include catalog products in an eligible service booking.

For example, a salon can add two bottles of shampoo to a keratin treatment appointment. The service and products appear together in the appointment details and payment summary.

You can add products when creating or editing eligible appointments.

```
Important: Retail products are managed under Payments → Products, not Services. They cannot be added through the customer-facing booking page.
```

---

## **Adding Retail Products to Appointments**

Retail products can be selected from your HighLevel catalog while creating or editing an eligible service appointment.

Open the appointment modal and click **+ Add product** under **Product(s)**. Search for the product or variant you want to include.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083950551/original/rXf1GFtqQoZNAEobH3v3qu0uUSY_nGH_WA.png?1792664887)**

---

## **Managing Product Quantities and Prices**

After selecting a product, you can adjust its quantity and unit price before adding it to the appointment.

The **Add retail product** window includes:

- **Product:** Selected item or variant.
- **Quantity:** Number of units.
- **Unit price:** Price charged per unit.
- **Amount:** Total retail charge for the selected product.

For example, two products priced at $19 each add $38 to the appointment.

Changing the unit price affects only that appointment, not the catalog price.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083950655/original/vNvIw08qPEmv18oTN4wAz8w1WUZgjzWOeg.png?1792664946)**

---

## **Understanding Appointment Payments**

Retail charges appear alongside service charges in the appointment's payment summary.

| Item | Amount |
| --- | --- |
| Keratin treatment | $249 |
| Shampoo — 2 × $19 | $38 |
| Subtotal | $287 |

Applicable taxes or fees may affect the final total.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083950798/original/T9OJk1WrYjiaXC1T9fnaxXF0Md8rH3BKPw.png?1792665012)**

If you change retail products on an appointment with existing payments, the payment status reflects any additional balance or refund owed.

```
Important: Updating the balance does not automatically collect an additional payment or process a refund. Review the Payments tab to manage the transaction.
```

For details, see [Payments Tab in Calendars](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000006098).

---

## **How Retail Products Affect Inventory**

HighLevel automatically adjusts stock when inventory-tracked products are added to or removed from appointments.

- **Add a product:** Available stock decreases.
- **Remove a product:** Applicable stock is restored.
- **Reduce quantity:** The difference is returned to stock.
- **Insufficient stock:** An error appears unless the product allows continued selling when out of stock.

Products without inventory tracking are unaffected.

```
Note: Inventory behavior when an appointment is canceled requires confirmation before publication.
```

---

## **Viewing Retail Products in Booking Details**

Saved appointments display their associated retail products in **Booking details**.

The **Product details** area shows the product name and quantity, allowing staff to confirm what was included in the booking.

Appointment history retains the associated product information even if catalog details change later.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083951054/original/_6AOlrWcyoDGFEoUlJNKzwLLitKQPQbzfQ.png?1792665101)**

---

## **How to Add Retail Products to Service Appointments**

You can add retail products while creating or editing an eligible service appointment. Before starting, ensure the products exist under **Payments → Products**.

### 

### **Step 1: Open a Service Appointment**

1. Go to **Calendars → Calendar View → Services**.
2. Create a new service booking or open an eligible existing appointment.
3. If editing, click the **Edit** (pencil) icon.

### 

### **Step 2: Select a Retail Product**

1. Find **Product(s)** in the appointment modal.
2. Click **+ Add product**.
3. Search for the product or variant.
4. Select the product.

****![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083951399/original/h3rLuOmWODuNH8Do6y0nkoohR21nE79icQ.png?1792665241)****

### 

### **Step 3: Set Quantity and Price**

1. Enter the required **Quantity**.
2. Adjust the **Unit price**, if needed.
3. Review the calculated **Amount**.
4. Click **Add product**.

****![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083951833/original/_XWa4_CfpOsb4lF4ggbgxtmDuuVbavxHXw.png?1792665438)****

### 

### **Step 4: Review and Save the Appointment**

1. Review the service and retail product details.
2. Confirm quantities, prices, and the updated payment summary.
3. Click **Book appointment** for a new booking, or save the changes to an existing appointment.

******![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083951738/original/gXsAFkBk9Wzz5UbazkaUgfejZxJGZSsznQ.png?1792665382)******

```
Important: Retail products are supported through eligible in-app service booking flows, not the customer-facing booking page.
```

### **Step 5: Verify Booking and Payment Details**

1. Open the saved appointment.
2. Review **Product details** in Booking details.
3. Open the **Payments** tab to check the total, amount paid, and remaining balance.

****![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083951688/original/3dnl8_mI_ttxkt9ruA_mq0PPlnXcdVSPpg.png?1792665352)****

If the appointment already has payments, review any outstanding balance or refund owed before taking further payment action.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Can I add retail products to an existing appointment?**

A: Yes. You can add products when editing eligible service appointments without recreating the booking.

**Q: Can customers add retail products on the booking page?**

A: No. Retail products can only be added through supported in-app service booking flows.

**Q: Where do I create retail products?**

A: Go to **Payments → Products** to create and manage catalog products.

**Q: Can I add multiple units or change the product price?**

A: Yes. You can adjust the quantity and unit price for an appointment without changing the catalog price.

**Q: What happens if a product is out of stock?**

A: HighLevel displays an error unless **Continue selling when out of stock** is enabled for that product.

**Q: What happens if I remove a retail product?**

A: The product is removed from the appointment, and applicable tracked inventory is restored.

**Q: Are additional charges or refunds processed automatically?**

A: The payment status updates to reflect the amount due or refund owed. Payment collection and refunds must be handled through the appropriate payment process.

**Q: Can I add products to a fully paid appointment?**

A: The release supports changes to appointments with existing payments, but the exact editing rules for fully paid appointments require confirmation.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Manage Service Appointments in the Appointment Modal](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000007328-manage-service-appointments-in-the-appointment-modal)
- [Payments Tab in Calendars](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000006098)
- [Getting Started – Create & Sell Products](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005071-getting-started-create-sell-products)

title_en: Forbidden message categories for SMS and MMS in the US and Canada
source_md:
SMS Compliance

# Prohibited and Restricted SMS/MMS Message Categories in the US and Canada

Understand which business types and message categories are prohibited or restricted for SMS and MMS messaging to maintain compliance and avoid carrier penalties.

What You'll Learn

HighLevel restricts or prohibits certain business types and message categories across SMS and MMS. Some categories are completely prohibited, while others are restricted and may be permitted only under specific conditions such as age gating, proper consent documentation, or use with particular number types.

This article explains which categories are prohibited, which are restricted, carrier-specific enforcement mechanisms including T-Mobile Severity-0 fines, and compliant alternatives when available.

## Policy Overview

HighLevel restricts or prohibits certain business types and message categories across SMS and MMS communications. Messaging eligibility depends on content type, sender classification, destination country, carrier requirements, and whether additional safeguards such as age verification, consent documentation, or specific number types are required.

This article focuses on US and Canada messaging restrictions. These policies apply across long code (10DLC), toll-free, and short code number types unless otherwise specified. Carriers enforce these restrictions through filtering, suspension, or financial penalties.

Important

Selecting an A2P Campaign use case does not automatically make restricted content eligible. Campaign approval and content compliance are separate evaluations. Review prohibited and restricted categories before configuring campaigns.

## T-Mobile Severity-0 Fines

T-Mobile Severity-0 fines represent one carrier-specific enforcement mechanism within the broader messaging compliance framework. These fines apply when prohibited traffic is detected on T-Mobile networks. HighLevel policy may prohibit activity independently of whether a specific T-Mobile fine applies, and other carriers enforce their own rules.

T-Mobile categorizes violations into three tiers based on severity. Each tier carries a different fine amount per incident:

| Tier | Fine Amount | Example Violations |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Tier 1 | $2,000 | Illegal substances, phishing/smishing, S.H.A.F.T. content |
| Tier 2 | $1,000 | Deceptive marketing, non-compliant loan offers |
| Tier 3 | $500 | Debt collection, lead generation without proper consent |

Note

Fine amounts and tier classifications are subject to change by T-Mobile. These fines are in addition to potential number suspension, filtering, or account termination.

## Prohibited Message Categories

The following message categories are prohibited for SMS and MMS across all number types in the US and Canada. These restrictions apply regardless of consent status, campaign use case, or other factors.

Category

Phishing, Smishing, Fraud, and Social Engineering

Any attempt to deceive recipients into providing sensitive information, credentials, or financial details through impersonation, misleading links, or false pretenses. This includes fake delivery notifications, account verification scams, prize claims, and urgent-action requests designed to exploit trust.

Category

Controlled, Regulated, and Restricted Substances

Promotional messaging for cannabis, CBD, prescription drugs, or other controlled substances is prohibited across SMS and MMS channels. This applies even when products are legal in specific jurisdictions.

**Examples:** Cannabis dispensary promotions, CBD product sales, prescription medication offers, controlled substance advertising.

Category

Gambling

Gambling traffic is prohibited in the US and Canada on all number types. This includes sports betting, online casinos, sweepstakes requiring payment, lottery-related promotional content, and fantasy sports platforms.

**Examples:** Casino app promotions, sports betting offers, online poker invitations, paid sweepstakes entries, daily fantasy sports advertising.

Category

Sexual Content

Sexually explicit content, adult services, and age-restricted sexual material are prohibited across all SMS and MMS messaging.

**Examples:** Adult entertainment services, explicit imagery, dating services with sexual focus, escort services.

Category

Hate-Related Content

Content promoting hate, discrimination, violence, or harassment based on protected characteristics including race, ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, disability, or national origin.

Category

High-Risk Financial Services

Certain high-risk financial products and services are prohibited due to predatory lending concerns or regulatory restrictions.

**Examples:** Payday loan offers, short-term high-interest loan promotions, third-party auto loan solicitations, third-party mortgage loan marketing, student loan debt relief schemes, high-risk investment solicitations promising guaranteed or outsized returns, cryptocurrency investment promotions.

Category

Third-Party Debt Collection

Third-party debt collection agencies contacting consumers about purchased or assigned debt are prohibited from using SMS and MMS.

**Prohibited example:** A third-party debt collector messaging purchased or assigned debtors about outstanding balances.

**Potentially permitted example:** A business communicating directly with its own customer about an existing account balance through a first-party relationship, assuming valid consent and compliance with applicable debt communication regulations.

Category

Get-Rich-Quick Schemes

Schemes promising unrealistic earnings, guaranteed income, or high returns with minimal effort or investment are prohibited.

**Examples:** Guaranteed-income schemes, pyramid or multi-level marketing centered on unrealistic earnings claims, high-risk investment solicitations promising guaranteed returns, "make money fast" programs.

Category

Third-Party Lead Generation

Companies that buy, sell, or share consumer contact information for marketing purposes cannot use purchased or shared consent for SMS messaging. SMS consent generally cannot be transferred from one unrelated business to another simply because contact information was purchased or shared.

**Examples:** Purchasing consumer leads and messaging them about unrelated services, sharing opt-in lists between unrelated companies, selling consumer contact databases with claimed SMS permissions.

## Restricted Message Categories

The following categories are restricted and may be permitted only under specific conditions. Restrictions vary by content type, number type, and whether additional requirements such as age verification are met.

| Category | Long Code (10DLC) | Toll-Free | Short Code | Additional Requirements |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Alcohol | May be permitted | May be permitted | May be permitted | Age gating required where permitted |
| Tobacco | May be permitted | May be permitted | May be permitted | Age gating required where permitted |
| Vaping / E-Cigarettes | May be permitted | May be permitted | May be permitted | Age gating required where permitted |
| Firearms | May be permitted | May be permitted | May be permitted | Compliance with applicable regulations required |

Important

Restricted categories require case-by-case evaluation during campaign registration. Meeting technical requirements does not guarantee approval. Verify current eligibility with HighLevel support before configuring campaigns involving restricted content.

## Consent and Privacy Violations

Otherwise legal content can violate messaging policy when proper consent has not been obtained or privacy requirements are not met. The following consent and privacy violations are prohibited:

**Missing or Invalid Consent** — Messaging recipients who have not provided explicit opt-in consent for SMS communications from your business.

**Purchased Consent** — Using contact lists purchased from third-party lead providers without obtaining direct consent from recipients for your specific business.

**Shared Consent Between Unrelated Businesses** — Transferring opt-in permissions from one business to another unrelated business without recipient authorization.

**Ignoring Opt-Out Requests** — Continuing to message recipients after they have requested to stop receiving communications.

**Missing Required Disclosures** — Failing to clearly identify your business or provide opt-out instructions in compliance with applicable regulations.

Related Topic

For detailed guidance on obtaining and documenting valid SMS consent, review HighLevel's A2P opt-in compliance documentation and best practices for consent collection.

## Alternative Communication Channels

Depending on the business type, content, location, and applicable platform rules, another HighLevel communication channel may be available when SMS or MMS is restricted or prohibited.

HighLevel Email may be appropriate for some business types that are restricted on SMS channels. For example, cannabis or CBD businesses operating in jurisdictions where these products are legal may use email for promotional messaging, subject to age verification requirements and local regulations.

Important

Using a different communication channel does not remove legal, platform, consent, or industry-specific requirements. Confirm that the content is permitted on the alternative channel and that you meet all compliance obligations before sending.

# **What Are Messaging & Social Channels on Your Google Business Profile (GBP)?**

This feature enables businesses to seamlessly connect popular messaging apps (WhatsApp and Text/SMS) and social media profiles (Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok, X, Pinterest) to their Google Business Profile pages. By leveraging HighLevel-integrated numbers and social accounts, businesses can offer familiar outreach options, build higher customer trust, and foster increased engagement.

---

## **Key Benefits of Add Messaging & Social Channels to Your Google Business Profile (GBP)**

Offering a unified way to manage communication channels, this integration is designed to enhance user experience and streamline your business operations. Benefits include:

- Higher trust and responsiveness by displaying channels your customers already use.
- Increased engagement opportunities leading to more conversations and quality leads.
- Unified communications that keep all messaging in one place with HighLevel-connected channels.

---

## **Linking WhatsApp & Text to GBP**

Connecting WhatsApp and Text/SMS channels directly in the GBP flow gives you the flexibility to reach customers using their preferred methods. You are able to pick an existing HighLevel‑integrated number for WhatsApp/Text or Or enter a different number in E.164 format (example for US: +15551234567).

Only one of the messaging channel will be displayed on GBP results though both can be connected. When both WhatsApp and Text (SMS) numbers are added, Google displays Text by default on the public listing; WhatsApp appears only if Text is not provided.

```
Sync & automations require GHL-connected channels: Messages can be synced and automations set up only when the phone number or social profile is connected to HighLevel (CRM) and linked to your GBP. Non-GHL numbers can be shown on GBP but won’t sync or trigger automations.
```

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055019776/original/kydv1XI6QLwQpAmnEDLi0CihG1xm1lRSBg.png?1759330952)

---

## **Social Channels Integration**

Linking your social profiles on GBP strengthens brand presence and gives customers familiar touch points. If the social account is also connected to HighLevel, DMs for those platforms can be handled in HighLevel; the GBP link itself serves as the public path for visitors.

**Supported Platforms:** Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok, X (formerly Twitter), Pinterest.

All the social channels connected will be displayed on GBP page result under about section.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055021889/original/xGnXatdOPY13zz0dIjFqjEiSBcP7d8QTbQ.png?1759332510)

---

## **Supported URL Formats for Social Channels**

Social media links in Google Business Profile should respect the below formats.

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| Social Profile | Format |
| Facebook | https://www.facebook.com/{username}  [Learn more about Facebook URL guidelines](https://www.facebook.com/help/1740158369563165). |
| Instagram | https://www.instagram.com/{username}  [Learn more about Instagram URL guidelines](https://help.instagram.com/182492381886913). |
| LinkedIn | https://www.linkedin.com/in/{username} https://www.linkedin.com/company/{username}  [Learn more about LinkedIn URL guidelines](https://www.linkedin.com/help/linkedin/answer/a542685/manage-your-public-profile-url). |

| TikTok | https://www.tiktok.com/{username}  [Learn more about TikTok URL guidelines](https://support.tiktok.com/en/getting-started/setting-up-your-profile/changing-your-username). |
| X (formerly known as Twitter) | https://www.twitter.com/{username}  [Learn more about X URL guidelines](https://help.twitter.com/en/managing-your-account/twitter-username-rules#:~:text=Your%20username%20cannot%20be%20longer,of%20underscores%2C%20as%20noted%20above). |
| YouTube | https://www.youtube.com/channel/{username} https://www.youtube.com/user/{username} https://www.youtube.com/@{username}  [Learn more about YouTube guidelines](https://support.google.com/youtube/answer/11585688#tns). |

---

## **How To Add Messaging Channel and Social Profiles to Your Google Business Profile (GBP)**

#### **S****tep 1:** Go to GBP Module

- From sub-account dashboard page, click on **Settings**and go to**I****ntegrations**.
- From the Google Business Profile card, **Connect** GBP account & go to page selection modal.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055020584/original/CHHxP6Mhl5T4FwpzudTzA3l0fjvp8nbYOw.png?1759331557)

#### **Step 2:**Connect Channels

Click on WhatsApp & Message tabs to connect messaging channels or click on connect channels

[![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055020241/original/G2ev_ab8OdgExD9qcVhYUPHEFqdGixOD7w.png?1759331353)](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155050129495/original/YsK2Uq_wKJZOANXWPYHqg4p8bZj7gqwqAQ.png?1753074411)

#### **Step 3:**Select Channels

User can select CRM linked LC phone number and WhatsApp number from dropdown, or add numbers via free text typing. User can also add links to any social channel. After adding all channels, click the blue **Save** button to save changes.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055021153/original/TpKZuZ2m8Lcxj415dLSFkHWWjbJ5Mawzxw.png?1759331938)

#### **Step 4:**Connect

Click on the blue **Connect** button to connect the accounts.

---

## **Text/WhatsApp Message Option is Not Visible on GBP Results**

I have added text & WhatsApp channel but these are not visible in GBP results. This may primarily be due to Google's validation for each number being added. Please follow below steps:

1. Go to GBP page setup by either clicking on Update GBP over page selection module in CRM or by going to edit page on google console.
2. Check if edit was approved. Approval is handled by Google team with no influence from our side. In case edit is not approved you can raise a ticket to google directly.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055020173/original/ZVkNfk0fDT6TznFANIRK-N6Akcnhmo-5zg.png?1759331290)

**Q: What happens if I add a non-GHL number?**

A warning is shown because automations and syncing are available only for numbers integrated with HighLevel.

**Q: Which social channels can I connect to my GBP page?**

You can connect Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok, X, and Pinterest.

**Q: How does Google display WhatsApp versus Text numbers?**

Google prioritizes the Text (SMS) number by default when both are added; WhatsApp will only appear if a Text number isn’t provided.

**Q: Where can I manage or remove my connected channels?**

All channel settings can be updated or removed from the Google Business Profile integration card in your HighLevel settings.

**Q: Are the changes immediately visible on my GBP page?**

No, Google may take additional time to review and approve changes before they are reflected.

**Q: Can I trigger automations with these linked channels?**

Automations and sync are available only for channels that are connected to HighLevel.

# **What is****Bulk****Adding Contacts to a Workflow?**

The Add to Automation feature lets you select contacts from the Contacts page and enroll them into a workflow in bulk. Instead of waiting for contacts to enter a workflow through a trigger, you can manually push a batch of contacts into any published workflow – all at once, at a scheduled time, or in a drip pattern.

 

The most common use case is filtering your contact list by a specific attribute (such as a tag), selecting the filtered results, and adding them to a workflow for targeted outreach, re-engagement, or batch processing.

---

## **Key Benefits of Adding Contacts to a Workflow in Bulk**

- **Enroll contacts faster:** Add multiple contacts to a workflow in one bulk action instead of enrolling them individually.
- **Target the right audience:** Use Advanced Filters (like tags, fields, and opportunity data) to enroll only the contacts you need.
- **Control when contacts enter:** Choose to enroll contacts immediately, at a scheduled date/time, or in drip mode batches.
- **Reuse segments easily:** Save filtered views as Smart Lists so you can repeat the same bulk enrollment anytime.
- **Track progress and results:** Monitor status, timestamps, and statistics from the Bulk Actions page to confirm what was processed.

---

## **How to Add Contacts to a Workflow in Bulk**

### **Step 1:** Filter Your Contacts

```
Tip: You can also filter by any other contact field (email, city, contact source, opportunity stage, etc.) or add multiple filters and nested filters to narrow down exactly which contacts you want to enroll.
