title_en: Voice AI - META Form Consent Guide For Outbound
source_md:
Facebook Lead Forms used for Voice AI outbound calling must include the correct consent disclaimer so HighLevel can verify that a lead agreed to receive AI-powered calls. This guide explains how to add the Voice AI disclaimer to a Meta form, map the form in HighLevel, and confirm that the disclaimer is recognized. Completing this process helps prevent outbound Voice AI calls from being blocked due to missing consent.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Meta Form Consent for Outbound Voice](#What-is-Meta-Form-Consent-for-Outbound-Voice)
- [Key Benefits of Meta Form Consent for Outbound Voice AI](#Key-Benefits-of-Meta-Form-Consent-for-Outbound-Voice-AI)
- [How to Set Up Meta Form Consent for Outbound Voice AI](#How-to-Set-Up-Meta-Form-Consent-for-Outbound-Voice-AI)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is Meta Form Consent for Outbound Voice**

Meta Form Consent for Outbound Voice AI is the process of adding a Voice AI-approved consent disclaimer to a Facebook Lead Form in Meta Business Suite, then mapping that form in HighLevel so the disclaimer can be recognized. Since Facebook Lead Forms are managed by Meta, the disclaimer must be added inside Meta Business Suite rather than directly inside HighLevel.

Meta Form Consent ensures that leads submitting Facebook Lead Forms are presented with the required consent language before Voice AI outbound calling is enabled for those submissions. HighLevel checks the connected form after it is mapped and refreshed to confirm whether the disclaimer is present.

---

## **Key Benefits of Meta Form Consent for Outbound Voice AI**

- **Consent Recognition:** Allows HighLevel to detect the Voice AI disclaimer on connected Facebook Lead Forms.
- **Outbound Calling Readiness:** Helps prevent outbound Voice AI calls from being blocked because of missing form consent.
- **Meta Form Compatibility:** Provides a clear process for adding the disclaimer in Meta Business Suite, where Facebook Lead Forms are created and managed.
- **Cleaner Troubleshooting:** Makes it easier to confirm whether a form is still missing a disclaimer or has been successfully recognized.

---

## **How to Set Up Meta Form Consent for Outbound Voice AI**

The setup requires work in both HighLevel and Meta Business Suite. Start by verifying the disclaimer in Voice AI, then add it to the Facebook Lead Form, map the form in HighLevel, and refresh the consent status to confirm approval.

1. In HighLevel, go to **AI Agents > Voice AI**.
2. Click **Update Disclosure** in the top-right corner.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/FU1gQmsQYfiOxZMCE8dK+/Screen+Shot+2026-05-19+at+19.45.56.png)
3. Review the existing disclosure or enter the client’s desired consent language.
4. Use the **compatibility checker** to confirm the disclaimer follows the recommended structure for Voice AI outbound calling.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/OsM4dOB725mHjFQsMiYe+/Screen+Shot+2026-05-19+at+19.55.12.png)
5. Once the disclaimer is verified, copy the approved disclaimer text before leaving this page.
6. In the same Voice AI disclosure area, go to **Choose Applicable Products > Manual Consent Application**.
7. Locate the **Facebook Forms** section.
8. Click **Update Consent**.
9. Meta Business Suite will open in a new browser tab. (**Note:** Facebook Lead Forms cannot be modified inside HighLevel. Any changes to the form disclaimer must be completed in Meta Business Suite.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/igDyH2dXdf662ltsM88Q+/GIF+Recording+2026-05-19+at+20.21.14.gif)
10. In Meta Business Suite, **create a new Facebook Lead Form** or **edit** a **drafted** **form**. (**Note:** Existing published Facebook Lead Forms may not be editable. If the form cannot be edited, create a new form with the required disclaimer.)
11. Complete the form setup until you reach the **Privacy Policy** section.
12. In the **Privacy Policy** section, select **Add Custom Disclaimer**.
13. Add a title for the disclaimer.
14. **Paste** the Voice AI **disclaimer** text copied from HighLevel.
15. Confirm the disclaimer is placed specifically in the **Privacy Policy** section.
16. Click on**Create Form.**  
      
    ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/QnquYmNF2grCHAdTwPK2+/GIF+Recording+2026-05-19+at+20.50.04.gif)
17. Return to HighLevel and click on **Refresh** in the Update Disclosure module to load the form.  
      
    ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/UNgKZE6oyRI47DJMy0Fw+/Screen+Shot+2026-05-19+at+21.06.41.png)
18. The form might show "**No disclaimer found**"  
      
    ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/HofqZldMwFnbdm6AmSNy+/NADC+Inc.+-+6+March+2026+2026-05-19+at+21.08.39.png)
19. To fix it, go to **Settings.**  
      
    **![](https://jumpshare.com/share/LeDcECQcowAj8gJLxrkA+/Screen+Shot+2026-05-19+at+21.11.03.png)**
20. Then **Integrations → Facebook**.  
      
    ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/7yMVbNhbJHLlisWei4aQ+/Screen+Shot+2026-05-19+at+21.13.01.png)
21. Click the three-dot menu and select **Form Field Mapping**.
22. Select the newly created or updated Facebook Lead Form.
23. **Map all required fields.**  
      
    **![](https://jumpshare.com/share/WJlNfdFVCuevfQmcH6HE+/GIF+Recording+2026-05-19+at+21.15.02.gif)**
24. Go back to **AI Agents → Voice AI → Update Disclosure**.
25. Return to **Manual Consent Application**.
26. The form may initially still appear in the list of forms missing a disclaimer.
27. **Refresh** the page.
28. If the form disappears from the missing-disclaimer list, the disclaimer has been successfully recognized.  
      
    ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/HVry2pmyxkNuOyUzlh2v+/GIF+Recording+2026-05-19+at+21.18.05.gif)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Can I edit an existing Facebook Lead Form?**  
Some published Facebook Lead Forms may not be editable. If the form cannot be edited, create a new Facebook Lead Form in Meta Business Suite and add the Voice AI disclaimer before publishing.

**Q: Where should I add the Voice AI disclaimer in Meta Business Suite?**  
Add the disclaimer in the **Privacy Policy** section of the Facebook Lead Form using **Add Custom Disclaimer**.

**Q: Can I add the disclaimer directly in HighLevel?**  
No. Facebook Lead Forms must be edited in Meta Business Suite. HighLevel can help you access the correct Meta area through **Update Consent**, but the form changes must be made in Meta.

**Q: Do I need to map the Facebook Lead Form after publishing it?**  
Yes. After the form is published in Meta Business Suite, return to HighLevel and map the form fields under **Settings → Integrations → Facebook → Form Field Mapping**.

**Q: Why does the form still show as missing a disclaimer after I publish it?**  
The form may still appear until the page is refreshed. After mapping the form, return to **Manual Consent Application** and refresh the page.

**Q: How do I know the disclaimer was recognized?**  
If the Facebook Lead Form no longer appears in the missing-disclaimer list after refreshing, HighLevel has recognized the disclaimer.

**Q: Can the Facebook Lead Form have more than one disclaimer?**  
Yes, Meta forms can include multiple disclaimers, but the Voice AI disclaimer must be added in the **Privacy Policy** section so it can be recognized properly.

**Q: Does disclaimer recognition guarantee that outbound Voice AI calls will always go through?**  
No. The form disclaimer is one consent requirement. Outbound Voice AI calls must still meet all other applicable Voice AI outbound calling requirements.

---

### **Related Articles**

- [Enhanced Consent Checking for Voice AI Outbound Calling: Forms, Surveys & Calendars](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000007166-enhanced-consent-checking-for-voice-ai-outbound-calling-forms-surveys-calendars-)
- [Voice AI Outbound Calling Compliance Checks](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000006679-voice-ai-outbound-calling-compliance-checks)
- [Audit & Fix Consent Text Across All Your Assets](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000007385-audit-fix-consent-text-across-all-your-assets)
- [Step-by-Step Guide to Facebook Integration in HighLevel](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001157632-step-by-step-guide-to-facebook-integration-in-highlevel)
- [Facebook Multi-page Lead Ads Integration](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000004537-facebook-multi-page-lead-ads-integration)
- [Facebook Lead Ad Integration & Troubleshooting Guide](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48000987779-facebook-lead-ad-integration-troubleshooting-guide)

title_en: How to Use Ask AI Dispatch on WhatsApp
source_md:
Ask AI Dispatch on WhatsApp lets you interact with your HighLevel AI copilot directly through WhatsApp. You can manage CRM tasks, send voice messages, share files, generate audio and video, and receive rich artifacts without switching to the HighLevel web app.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Ask AI Dispatch on WhatsApp?](#What-is-Ask-AI-Dispatch-on-WhatsApp?)
- [Key Benefits of Ask AI Dispatch](#Key-Benefits-of-Ask-AI-Dispatch%E2%80%8B)
- [Prerequisites and Limitations](#Prerequisites-and-Limitations)
- [How to Set Up Ask AI Dispatch on WhatsApp](#How-to-Set-Up-Ask-AI-Dispatch-on-WhatsApp)
- [How to Use Ask AI on WhatsApp](#How-to-Use-Ask-AI-on-WhatsApp)
- [Review WhatsApp Conversations in Dispatch](#Review-WhatsApp-Conversations-in-Dispatch)
- [Move Your WhatsApp Number](#Move-Your-WhatsApp-Number)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is Ask AI Dispatch on WhatsApp?**

Ask AI Dispatch brings HighLevel's Ask AI capabilities into WhatsApp, allowing you to complete supported tasks through a familiar messaging experience. Once connected, you can ask questions, access CRM information, generate content, share documents, and receive multimedia responses within the same conversation.

---

## **Key Benefits of Ask AI Dispatch**

- **Text and voice requests:** Type or speak your requests to Ask AI.
- **File sharing:** Send images, documents, and other supported files for additional context.
- **CRM assistance:** Retrieve contact details, manage opportunities, and check appointments.
- **Content generation:** Create emails, blog drafts, images, and other supported content.
- **Audio and video generation:** Request and play generated media directly in WhatsApp.
- **Rich artifacts:** View generated results in useful formats beyond plain text.
- **Conversation history:** Review WhatsApp Dispatch conversations in HighLevel.

---

## **Prerequisites and Limitations**

Before connecting WhatsApp, keep the following in mind:

- You need an active WhatsApp account and access to its phone number.
- Each location supports one connected WhatsApp number for Ask AI Dispatch.
- The user who connects a number owns that connection.
- You can move your own connected number between locations, but you cannot take over another user's connection.
- WhatsApp verification codes expire after five minutes.

---

## **How to Set Up Ask AI Dispatch on WhatsApp**

**Step 1: Connect WhatsApp**

1. In HighLevel, navigate to **Ask AI → Customize → Dispatch**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084037550/original/N_n0mu5pkoUCpeq1ovjJww-RHICMA9c7fA.png?1792746932)
2. Click **Connect WhatsApp**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084037549/original/XzNbWB1LfDYfCwG16OYHlbLtjZnCgLcaCg.png?1792746932)
3. Select your country and enter your WhatsApp number without the country code.
4. Click **Continue**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084037648/original/fbHRc0FmyS4OiEKqQrfw5PmGPt-aA-43Ww.png?1792746968)

**Step 2: Verify Your Number**

1. Scan the displayed QR code.
2. Open the WhatsApp conversation and request a verification code.
3. Enter the code in HighLevel.
4. Click **Verify**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084037726/original/Ct_rlZF2eTPAJT1VvMZKSgWlaQ3-K3b7-g.png?1792747009)

Once verified, you can start interacting with Ask AI through WhatsApp.

---

## **How to Use Ask AI on WhatsApp**

Ask AI supports text, voice messages, file attachments, and multimedia responses within your connected WhatsApp conversation.

**Send Text and Voice Messages**

You can type a request or record a voice message to communicate with Ask AI.

1. Open your connected Ask AI conversation in WhatsApp.
2. Type your request or record a voice message.
3. Send the message and review Ask AI's response.

For example, you can ask:

"Summarize my latest notes and draft a client follow-up email."

Ask AI processes your request and responds within the conversation.

**Share Images and Files**

Share images, documents, and other supported files to give Ask AI additional context.

1. Open your Ask AI conversation in WhatsApp.
2. Attach a supported file.
3. Include a request explaining what you need.
4. Send the message and review the response.

For example, share a client document and ask Ask AI to summarize its key details or identify action items.

**Generate Audio and Video**

Ask AI can generate audio and video based on your requests and return them directly in WhatsApp.

1. Open your Ask AI conversation.
2. Describe the audio or video you want to create.
3. Send your request.
4. Play the generated audio or video directly in WhatsApp.

Generated videos can be viewed using WhatsApp's playable video player. For more information, see [Ask AI - Audio & Video Generation](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000008513-ask-ai-audio-video-generation).

**View Rich Artifacts**

Ask AI can present responses as rich artifacts instead of plain text, making generated content easier to review. For example, you can request a client follow-up email, review the generated content in WhatsApp, and ask Ask AI to refine it. You can continue the conversation to request changes or additional content.

**Manage CRM Tasks and Other Actions**

Ask AI Dispatch also supports existing Ask AI capabilities, including:

- Looking up contacts and managing supported CRM records
- Reviewing opportunities and appointments
- Generating blog drafts, emails, and images
- Creating supported recurring tasks
- Running configured Ask AI Skills
- Asking product and support questions

Ask AI may request confirmation before performing actions that modify CRM data.

---

## **Review WhatsApp Conversations in Dispatch**

You can access previous WhatsApp conversations through HighLevel.

1. Navigate to **Ask AI → Customize → Dispatch**.
2. Click **View Dispatch Sessions**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084038017/original/lHxBraOMoQ5DNE4Zdak_zCR2qlFgkNBkZA.png?1792747149)
3. Use **Search conversations** to find a session.
4. Select **WhatsApp** from the **Dispatch type** filter.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084038080/original/p1mw82jsfZhA_I3mcrMvpjQNt4R2NLv4iA.png?1792747190)
5. Use **Sort** to organize conversations.

---

## **Move Your WhatsApp Number**

If your WhatsApp number is connected to another location under your user, you can move it during setup.

1. Navigate to **Ask AI → Customize → Dispatch**.
2. Start the WhatsApp connection process.
3. Enter your existing connected WhatsApp number.
4. When prompted, click **Yes, move it here**.
5. Complete any remaining verification steps.

The number is disconnected from the previous location and connected to the current one.

**Note:** You cannot move a WhatsApp number connected by another user.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Can I send voice messages to Ask AI on WhatsApp?**

Yes. You can send voice messages instead of typing, and Ask AI will process your spoken request.

**Q: Can I share documents and images with Ask AI?**

Yes. You can attach images, documents, and other supported files to provide context for your requests.

**Q: Can I play AI-generated audio and video directly in WhatsApp?**

Yes. Ask AI can return generated audio and video that you can play within the conversation.

**Q: Does Ask AI support rich artifacts in WhatsApp?**

Yes. Ask AI can present generated results in formats beyond plain text.

**Q: Can I connect multiple WhatsApp numbers to one location?**

No. Each location supports one connected WhatsApp number for Ask AI Dispatch.

**Q: Where can I find my previous conversations?**

Go to **Ask AI → Customize → Dispatch → View Dispatch Sessions**.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Ask AI Assistant](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005327)
- [Ask AI - Audio & Video Generation](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000008513-ask-ai-audio-video-generation)
- [How to Use Ask AI Voice Mode](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000008022-how-to-use-ask-ai-voice-mode)
- [Using Ask AI Artifacts and Mermaid Diagrams in HighLevel](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000007812-using-ask-ai-artifacts-and-mermaid-diagrams-in-highlevel)

title_en: How to Use V3 Public APIs for Countdown Timers
source_md:
HighLevel's V3 Public APIs for Countdown Timers allow developers to create, retrieve, update, and delete timers programmatically. These APIs support fixed, dynamic, and recurring timers, along with advanced styling, template browsing, and filtering options. This article explains the available API operations and how to manage countdown timers through integrations.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What Are the V3 Countdown Timer APIs?](#What-Are-the-V3-Countdown-Timer-APIs?)
- [Key Benefits of V3 Countdown Timer APIs](#Key-Benefits-of-V3-Countdown-Timer-APIs)
- [Supported Countdown Timer Types](#Supported-Countdown-Timer-Types)
- [Available Countdown Timer API Operations](#Available-Countdown-Timer-API-Operations)
- [Timer Templates and Design Customization](#Timer-Templates-and-Design-Customization)
- [Filtering, Pagination, and API Responses](#Filtering,-Pagination,-and-API-Responses)
- [How to Use the V3 Countdown Timer APIs](#How-to-Use-the-V3-Countdown-Timer-APIs)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What Are the V3 Countdown Timer APIs?**

The V3 Countdown Timer APIs provide programmatic access to countdown timer management in HighLevel. Developers can manage the entire timer lifecycle without manually configuring each timer through the interface.

The APIs use token-resolved authentication, eliminating the need to include `locationId` in the endpoint URL. Responses also provide richer information, including design metadata, preview and tracking links, and thumbnails.

---

## **Key Benefits of V3 Countdown Timer APIs**

The V3 APIs simplify countdown timer management and give developers greater control over timer configurations and integrations.

- **Full Lifecycle Management:** Create, retrieve, update, and soft-delete timers programmatically.
- **Multiple Timer Types:** Manage fixed, dynamic, and recurring countdown timers.
- **Template Access:** Browse shared timer templates for faster setup.
- **Advanced Customization:** Configure timer appearance using `designMeta`.
- **Flexible Filtering:** Search and filter timers with pagination.
- **Simplified API Access:** Use token-resolved endpoints without `locationId` in the URL.
- **Enhanced Responses:** Access design metadata, preview and tracking links, and thumbnails.

---

## **Supported Countdown Timer Types**

The V3 APIs support three countdown timer types, allowing developers to configure timers for different campaign requirements.

| Timer Type | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Fixed | Counts down to a specific date and time. |
| Dynamic | Starts based on an individual contact's activity or trigger. |
| Recurring | Repeats according to a configured countdown schedule. |

Dynamic timers support the following API triggers:

- `sent` — Email sent.
- `opened` — Email opened.
- `whatsapp_sent` — WhatsApp message sent.
- `whatsapp_opened` — WhatsApp opened trigger.

For more information, see [Guide: Dynamic Countdown Timer](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000004385).

---

## **Available Countdown Timer API Operations**

The V3 APIs provide six operations for managing countdown timers and accessing the shared template catalog.

| API Operation | Function |
| --- | --- |
| [List Countdown Timers](https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/countdown-timer/list-countdown-timers) | Retrieve timers with filtering and pagination. |
| [Create Countdown Timer](https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/countdown-timer/create-countdown-timer) | Create fixed, dynamic, or recurring timers. |
| [Get Countdown Timer](https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/countdown-timer/get-countdown-timer) | Retrieve an existing timer by ID. |
| [Update Countdown Timer](https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/countdown-timer/update-countdown-timer) | Modify timer configurations using PATCH. |
| [Delete Countdown Timer](https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/countdown-timer/delete-countdown-timer) | Soft-delete an existing timer. |
| [List Timer Templates](https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/countdown-timer/list-countdown-timer-templates) | Browse available countdown timer templates. |

**Note:** Deletion uses a soft-delete operation. Restoration capabilities are not established by this release.

---

## **Timer Templates and Design Customization**

The V3 APIs allow developers to browse shared countdown timer templates and configure timer appearance programmatically. This helps maintain consistent branding across campaigns and integrations.

The `designMeta` configuration supports settings such as:

- Fonts and text styling
- Colors and labels
- Countdown unit visibility
- Borders and padding
- Additional timer design properties

Developers can retrieve available templates and use the applicable configuration options when creating or updating timers.

---

## **Filtering, Pagination, and API Responses**

The List Countdown Timers API supports filtering and pagination, making it easier to retrieve and manage timers across larger collections.

Available filtering capabilities include:

- Timer type
- Timer status
- Search term
- Expiry
- Pagination

API responses also provide additional timer information, including design metadata, preview and tracking links, and thumbnails.

---

## **How to Use the V3 Countdown Timer APIs**

Developers can use the V3 APIs to manage countdown timers through authenticated integrations. The correct API permissions and request parameters are essential for successful operations.

1. **Configure API Access:** Set up authentication and the required permissions for your application.
2. **Browse Templates:** Use the [List Timer Templates API](https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/countdown-timer/list-countdown-timer-templates) to explore available designs.
3. **Create a Timer:** Use the [Create Countdown Timer API](https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/countdown-timer/create-countdown-timer) and select the appropriate timer type.
4. **Customize the Timer:** Configure supported styling properties using `designMeta`.
5. **Retrieve Timers:** Use the List or Get API to access existing timer information.
6. **Update Timers:** Use the PATCH endpoint to modify supported settings.
7. **Delete Timers:** Use the Delete API when a timer is no longer needed.

The API resolves the relevant sub-account from the authorized token rather than requiring `locationId` in the endpoint URL.

For authentication guidance, refer to [How to Get Started with the Developer's Marketplace](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000000136-how-to-get-started-with-the-developer-s-marketplace).

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Which countdown timer types are supported?**

The V3 APIs support fixed, dynamic, and recurring countdown timers.

**Q: Can I manage timers without using the HighLevel interface?**

Yes. Developers can create, retrieve, update, and delete countdown timers programmatically.

**Q: Is locationId required in the API URL?**

No. The new APIs resolve sub-account context through the authentication token.

**Q: Can I customize timer appearance through the API?**

Yes. The `designMeta` configuration supports fonts, colors, labels, unit visibility, borders, padding, and other styling properties.

**Q: Can I retrieve available timer templates?**

Yes. The List Timer Templates API provides access to the shared timer template catalog.

**Q: Do the APIs support filtering and pagination?**

Yes. The List Countdown Timers API supports filtering by type, status, search term, and expiry, along with pagination.

**Q: What happens when I delete a timer through the API?**

The API performs a soft-delete operation. The release does not specify whether deleted timers can be restored.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Getting Started with Countdown Timer](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000003100)
- [Create and Customize a Fixed Countdown Timer](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000003113)
- [Guide: Dynamic Countdown Timer](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000004385)
- [How to Create a Recurring Countdown Timer](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000003114)
- [How to Edit Countdown Timers](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000003500-editing-a-countdown-timer)
- [How to Get Started with the Developer's Marketplace](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000000136-how-to-get-started-with-the-developer-s-marketplace)

title_en: Editing a Published or In-Review Meta Ad Campaigns
source_md:
HighLevel lets you edit supported settings in Meta campaigns that are already **Published** or **In Review**. Available edits depend on the campaign setting, campaign configuration, and current status.

After you make an eligible change, HighLevel keeps the update unpublished until you submit it. Meta then reviews the updated campaign before the changes are approved.

This guide explains how to open a campaign for editing, identify editable and locked fields, discard unwanted changes, publish updates, and handle review or failure states.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Editing a Published or In-Review Meta Campaign?](#What-is-Editing-a-Published-or-In-Review-Meta-Campaign?)
- [Key Benefits of Editing a Meta Campaign](#Key-Benefits-of-Editing-a-Meta-Campaign)
- [Why to edit a Published campaign?](#Why-to-edit-a-Published-campaign?)
- [How to Edit a Published or In-Review campaign?](#How-to-Edit-a-Published-or-In-Review-campaign?)
- [What fields of a published campaign can be edited?](#What-fields-of-a-published-campaign-can-be-edited?)
- [What fields of a published/In-review campaign cannot be altered?](#What-fields-of-a-published/In-review-campaign-cannot-be-altered?)
- [How to discard the changes made to the published campaign?](#How-to-discard-the-changes-made-to-the-published-campaign?)
- [How to Publish the ad campaign after making changes?](#How-to-Publish-the-ad-campaign-after-making-changes?)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
  - [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is Editing a Published or In-Review Meta Campaign?**

Editing lets you reopen an existing Meta campaign in HighLevel and change fields that remain eligible after the campaign has been submitted or published.

Current Meta campaigns use the following structure:

**Campaign → Ad Set → Ad**

Editable and locked settings can appear at different levels of this structure. Not every field remains available after publication.

## 

## **Key Benefits of Editing a Meta Campaign**

Editing an existing campaign helps you update supported settings without rebuilding the campaign from scratch.

- **Correct Eligible Settings:** Fix supported campaign, targeting, or creative details.

- **Update Creative:** Change eligible Ad Text and Media fields.

- **Adjust Eligible Targeting:** Modify supported geographic or audience settings.

- **Reuse Existing Setup:** Keep the existing campaign structure while updating permitted fields.

- **Discard Unwanted Changes:** Leave the editor without publishing changes you do not want to keep.

---

## 

## 

## **Why to edit a Published campaign?**

Editing a live campaign allows users to adapt to real-time performance data, market conditions, and business needs. It ensures the campaign remains effective and relevant throughout its duration. With this functionality, users can:

- Correct errors made during the initial campaign setup.
- Optimise campaign performance based on insights from key performance indicators (KPIs).
- Respond dynamically to feedback, improving ad content or audience targeting.
- Save time by avoiding the need to pause a campaign and create a new one for minor adjustments.

This feature empowers users to refine their campaigns for better results without disrupting their ongoing advertising efforts.

---

## **How to Edit a Published or In-Review campaign?**

Users can now edit details of live campaigns or those in the 'In Review' state, which was previously limited to budget adjustments only. To make changes:

- Navigate to the Ad Manager home page where all campaigns are listed.
- Locate the live or in-review campaign you want to edit.
- Click on the Edit option available in the inline ellipsis menu for the campaign.  
    
    
  ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155039431792/original/qQB1R5rBe9SxFEEcWh3IzGOXEtGYIZUWhQ.png?1736283412)
- The campaign builder screen will open, allowing the user to make changes to permitted fields (listed in Section 3).

**Note: Once any changes are made, an "Unpublished Changes" tag will appear at the top right of the screen.**

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155039431801/original/hHKGQmeoMtoMmxNjtepoEMbElLyInbvqZg.png?1736283469)

---

## **What fields of a published campaign can be edited?**

The following fields can be modified for published campaigns:

- Campaign Name
- CTA Button: Change or update the call-to-action button.
- Lead Generation Form: If the objective is Lead Generation, you can switch to another form or create a new one.
- Website: Alter the website URL if the objective is Website Traffic.
- Special Ad Category: Add or change the category if needed.
- Placements: Update where your ads are displayed.  
    
  > Note: Instagram Explore Feed is no longer available as an ad placement. Campaigns that were already published with this placement remain live and do not require any action. Delivery continues through other eligible placements.
- Ad Text and Media: Revise the content and visuals of your ad.
- Budget: Adjust the amount allocated for the campaign.
- Geographic Location: Modify the targeted locations.
- Target Audience: Change interests, lookalike, or retargeting parameters.
- End Date: Update the end date if a lifetime budget is selected.

---

## **What fields of a published/In-review campaign cannot be altered?**

Certain fields remain locked for editing after a campaign is published:

- Campaign Objective
- Facebook Page: The page used to publish the campaign.
- Start Date
- Budget Type: Switching from Daily to Lifetime budget or vice versa is not permitted.

---

## **How to discard the changes made to the published campaign?**

If a user wants to revert the campaign back to its original state without applying the changes:

1. Click on the Back button at the top left of the campaign builder screen.
2. A prompt will appear -  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155039431990/original/FZtbwa4_vmJR8J9OuK3_ezxtgUUx2OsYIw.png?1736284093)
3. Select Discard to keep the original campaign intact and ignore the changes made to the campaign.

---

## **How to Publish the ad campaign after making changes?**

To apply the changes to the campaign:

1. After making the desired edits, click on Publish Ad Now button on the review page.
2. A confirmation dialog will appear.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155039432140/original/QKKSLFTmloq6pJzCcUdKcaaKREjUF16HMA.png?1736284369)
3. Upon confirmation, the campaign will move to the "In Review" state.
4. Facebook will review the changes. Once approved, the updated campaign will go live.
5. If the edits result in errors, the campaign status will change to Failed, with the reason displayed next to the failed status in the tooltip.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Can I edit a Meta campaign after it is published?**  
Yes. HighLevel currently supports editing eligible fields in Published Meta campaigns.

**Q: Can I edit a Meta campaign while it is In Review?**  
Yes. The current editing workflow supports campaigns in the In Review state.

**Q: Which fields remain locked after publication?**  
The current article lists Campaign Objective, Facebook Page, Start Date, and Budget Type as locked.

**Q: Can I switch from a Daily budget to a Lifetime budget after publishing?**  
No. The budget type cannot be switched between Daily and Lifetime after publication.

**Q: What happens after I publish my changes?**  
The campaign moves to **In Review**, and Meta reviews the updated campaign before the changes are approved.

**Q: Can I discard changes before publishing them?**  
Yes. Use the campaign builder's exit flow and choose **Discard** when prompted.

---

### **Related Articles**

- [Ad Manager - Create New Facebook Ad Campaigns](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000002435-create-new-ad-campaign-in-ad-manager?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- [Ad Manager - Audience Controls](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000003052-ad-manager-audience-controls?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- [Getting Started - Setup Facebook and Instagram Lead Ads](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005064-getting-started-setup-facebook-and-instagram-lead-ads?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- [Instagram Ads: Overview](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000004550-instagram-ads-overview?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

title_en: How to Use and Customize the Add Opportunity Side Panel
source_md:
The Add Opportunity side panel in HighLevel makes it easier to create opportunities without requiring a contact first. Users can create deals, add contact details, and link related records in one place. Administrators can customize the form by selecting fields, setting requirements, and managing associations.

```
Note: This feature is currently part of the Opportunity-First private beta. Locations must be enrolled through the beta access form.
```

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is the Add Opportunity Side Panel?](#What-is-the-Add-Opportunity-Side-Panel?)
- [Key Benefits of the Add Opportunity Side Panel](#Key-Benefits-of-the-Add-Opportunity-Side-Panel)
- [Opportunity-First Creation](#Opportunity-First-Creation)
- [Contact Selection and Inline Contact Creation](#Contact-Selection-and-Inline-Contact-Creation)
- [Customizable Opportunity Fields](#Customizable-Opportunity-Fields)
- [Opportunity Associations](#Opportunity-Associations)
- [Save Options and Unsaved Changes Protection](#Save-Options-and-Unsaved-Changes-Protection)
- [How to Create an Opportunity Using the Side Panel](#How-to-Create-an-Opportunity-Using-the-Side-Panel)
- [How to Customize the Add Opportunity Form](#How-to-Customize-the-Add-Opportunity-Form)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is the Add Opportunity Side Panel?**

The Add Opportunity side panel is a configurable form that allows users to create opportunities with just three required fields: **Opportunity Name, Pipeline, and Stage**. Contacts are optional, so users can capture deals before contact information is available. The panel also supports inline contact creation, custom fields, record associations, and multiple save options.

---

## **Key Benefits of the Add Opportunity Side Panel**

The new panel simplifies opportunity creation while allowing administrators to control what information is collected.

- **Faster Deal Creation:** Create opportunities using only essential information.
- **Optional Contacts:** Save opportunities without selecting a contact.
- **Inline Contact Management:** Select or create contacts without leaving the panel.
- **Customizable Fields:** Add, remove, reorder, and require fields.
- **Flexible Associations:** Link contacts, companies, and custom objects during creation.
- **Multiple Opportunity Entry:** Use Save and add another to create deals consecutively.
- **Unsaved Changes Protection:** Receive a confirmation before closing the panel with unsaved changes.

---

## **Opportunity-First Creation**

Opportunity-first creation allows users to capture deals even when contact details are unavailable. This is useful for early-stage opportunities, inbound inquiries, and company-level deals. Only three fields are required by default:

- **Opportunity Name:** Identifies the deal.
- **Pipeline:** Determines where the opportunity belongs.
- **Stage:** Defines the opportunity's current position.

Administrators can make additional fields required, but these three fields are locked and cannot be removed.

---

## **Contact Selection and Inline Contact Creation**

Contacts can be selected or created directly from the Add Opportunity panel, reducing the need to navigate between screens.

- **Select Existing Contact:** Search for and select an existing contact.
- **Create Contact:** Enter a name and select Create Contact.
- **Contact Details:** Once selected, Primary Email, Primary Phone, Business Name, and Tags become available.
- **Opportunity Name:** Automatically prefills when a contact is selected.

**Important:** Selecting Create Contact immediately creates the contact, even if the opportunity is not saved.

---

## **Customizable Opportunity Fields**

Administrators can tailor the Add Opportunity form to match their business processes and collect consistent information.

Navigate to **Settings > Objects > Opportunities > Customize fields for add Opportunity**.

Available customization options include:

- **Reorder Fields:** Drag fields into the preferred order.
- **Required Fields:** Mark additional fields as required.
- **Remove Fields:** Hide unnecessary fields from the form.
- **Manage Fields:** Add standard opportunity fields, custom fields, and primary contact fields organized by folder.

Opportunity Name, Pipeline, and Stage cannot be removed. For more information, see [How to Use Custom Fields for Opportunities](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000000521).

---

## **Opportunity Associations**

Associations connect opportunities to related CRM records. Administrators can use **Add associations** to choose which relationships users can establish during opportunity creation.

Supported associations include:

- Primary Contact and Additional Contacts
- Custom contact labels
- Companies and Primary Company
- Custom objects

For more information, see [Associations Between Opportunities, Companies & Custom Objects](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000004033-associations-between-opportunities-and-custom-objects).

---

## **Save Options and Unsaved Changes Protection**

The side panel provides flexible save options to support individual and consecutive opportunity creation.

- **Save:** Creates the current opportunity.
- **Save and add another:** Saves the opportunity and allows you to create another.
- **Unsaved Changes:** Closing the panel with unsaved information displays options to Discard, Keep Editing, or Save.

---

## **How to Create an Opportunity Using the Side Panel**

Creating an opportunity takes only a few steps. Contacts and additional fields can be included when needed.

1. Navigate to **Opportunities** and click **Add opportunity**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084021347/original/MLtA1-BJPmdCnN9S45ENYKHdLwv9yflyaA.png?1792737336)
2. Enter the **Opportunity Name**.
3. Select the **Pipeline** and **Stage**.
4. Optionally select an existing Primary Contact or choose **Create Contact**.
5. Complete any contact details, additional required fields, or associations.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084021405/original/hGQKF_TumQE-gFiwRbeGP27tk2TApLgjqw.png?1792737394)
6. Click **Save** or **Save and add another**.

---

## **How to Customize the Add Opportunity Form**

Administrators can customize the form to ensure users collect relevant opportunity information without unnecessary fields.

1. Open **Settings > Objects > Opportunities > Customize fields for add Opportunity**.
2. Drag fields to reorder them.
3. Mark fields as **Required** or remove unnecessary fields.
4. Select **Manage fields** to add opportunity, custom, or primary contact fields.
5. Click **Add associations** to include contact, company, or custom object relationships.
6. Click **Preview** to review the form.
7. Click **Save** to apply the configuration.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Can I create an opportunity without a contact?**

Yes. Only Opportunity Name, Pipeline, and Stage are required by default.

**Q: What happens if I create a contact but don't save the opportunity?**

The contact is created immediately when you select Create Contact, independently of saving the opportunity.

**Q: Can I remove the default required fields?**

No. Opportunity Name, Pipeline, and Stage are locked.

**Q: Can I add custom fields to the form?**

Yes. Administrators can use Manage fields to add opportunity custom fields.

**Q: Does customizing the form change opportunity cards or List View?**

The new settings configure the Add Opportunity form. Opportunity cards and List View have separate customization options.

**Q: Why can't I see the new side panel?**

The feature is currently part of the Opportunity-First private beta. Your location must have beta access.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Step-by-Step Guide to Creating Opportunities](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000001999)
- [How to Use Custom Fields for Opportunities](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000000521)
- [Associations Between Opportunities, Companies & Custom Objects](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000004033-associations-between-opportunities-and-custom-objects)
- [Getting Started - Setup Pipelines and Opportunities](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005062-getting-started-setup-pipelines-and-opportunities)

title_en: Pause / Resume Sub-Accounts
source_md:
Agencies can now "pause" and "resume" SAAS sub-accounts. If you have a SAAS (Software as a Service) client who fails to make payments, their Account can be Paused (disabled).

This means that they won't be able to access the services or features of the software until the payment is made. The way for SAAS customers to resume their paused accounts is by paying their bills. For Regular clients, you need to resume their accounts manually.

#### **Covered in this Article:**

#### [**How to Pause SAAS/Regular Sub-Account(s)**](#How-to-Pause-SAAS/Regular-Sub-Account(s))

#### [Automatically (Works for SAAS Sub-Accounts only)](#Automatically-(Works-for-SAAS-Sub-Accounts-only))

#### [What is meant by a Subscription failure?](#What-is-meant-by-a-Subscription-failure?)

#### [Manually (works for both SAAS and Regular Sub-Accounts)](#Manually-(works-for-both-SAAS-and-Regular-Sub-Accounts))

#### [**What do my Client's admins & users see when their sub-account is paused?**](#What-do-my-client's-admins-&-users-see-when-their-sub-account-is-paused?)

#### [If you have a SaaS client with a failed subscription](#If-you-have-a-SaaS-client-with-a-failed-subscription)

#### [If you have a regular (non-SaaS) client or if your SaaS client doesn't have a failed subscription](#If-you-have-a-regular-(non-SaaS)-client-or-if-your-SaaS-client-doesn't-have-a-failed-subscription)

#### [**Resuming Sub-Accounts**](#Resuming-Sub-Accounts)

#### [**FAQ**](#FAQ)

#### [What happens to a 'Paused' sub-account's automation, calendars, messaging, etc.? Is everything paused?](#What-happens-to-a-'Paused'-sub-account's-automation,-calendars,-messaging,-etc?-Is-everything-paused?)

---

## **How to Pause SAAS/Regular Sub-Account(s)**

**Please Note**

```
This feature is only available for Agency Admins.
```

### **Automatically (Works for SAAS Sub-Accounts only)**

Agencies can pause a sub-account automatically when a SaaS subscription is not paid up.

When a SaaS client's subscription fails, the agency can choose to

1. Pause their sub-account
2. Leave it operational

This setting can be controlled in the **Agency Sidebar> SAAS Configurator> Suspend Sub-Accounts when their SAAS subscription fails.**

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48279495262/original/bn9yS0-FSwItHURYBLLu8i6ZNaUA73K8vg.png?1675418944)

This setting will pause client sub-accounts when their SaaS subscription fails.

#### **What is meant by a Subscription failure?**

A subscription is considered failed when your Client has not paid up, and the subscription status has been changed to **canceled, past\_due, or incomplete\_expired or incomplete** status in Stripe. To learn how Stripe subscription statuses work, please refer to this [Stripe help article](https://stripe.com/docs/billing/subscriptions/overview).

### **Manually (works for both SAAS and Regular Sub-Accounts)**

You would need to head to the **Sub-Accounts** tab in the Agency Sidebar. Scroll to the sub-account that you want to pause.

Either click on their name or go to the far right and click the **three dots > Manage Client.**

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48276497543/original/ff3bifD55IwfokW2doROhVdNqRdIXcem6A.png?1674141558)  
  
Head to the **Actions** dropdown to the right > **Pause Sub-Account**

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48276513268/original/8pwu5w0kSGoJg-T4l38kVdXTMOdT8Rsd3g.png?1674143962)**

It will then ask you for confirmation. Mark the given Checkbox and Click on**Pause Sub Account** to proceed.  
  
![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48276513790/original/VLSuzvGuzH7P0xLe_uG1jRrSi2N3WaZdfw.png?1674144047)

Within a few seconds, the sub-account will be paused. A banner will be added in this window indicating that it has been paused:

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48276514041/original/sgg75asyWZnxZQ9ni6CQdE_u2P3rgFV11A.png?1674144112)

Being an Agency Admin, you would still be able to log in to that Account as usual, the banner would still be displayed there, but you would have no issues using the Account being the Agency Admin.  
  
![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48276514288/original/eM02iMNC7vO9bPNcplkpKrOAp1QuhVS5SQ.png?1674144188)  
When the Client tries to access the sub-account, they will see one of two possible messages on their screen depending on whether they are a SAAS client (see below for more details).

---

## **What do my Client's admins & users see when their sub-account is paused?**

When a Subaccount is paused, the Client Portal tied to that subaccount **does not open**.

After you resume the subaccount, Client Portal access returns without extra setup.

### **If you have a SaaS client with a failed subscription**

Your Client will see a screen to reactivate their SaaS subscription.

1. Sub-account **users** cannot add or manage payment methods. They must contact a sub-account **admin** (or the agency) to complete billing updates.  
  
![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155064708290/original/A69ZaVfOTFcxxpBz22ghIGYe0aESe9tOKA.png?1770824679)

2. Sub-account **admins** can update the payment method if a payment method is required to continue.

Once they have reactivated their SaaS subscription, **their sub-account will be resumed automatically**.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48276515744/original/T5dI3-7fqGDbDc0Es_c1RTmFDufc9dmAdw.png?1674144478)

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48276518659/original/__75gO2Ql-vBJqfS8DZsGeul04QzMl5IhA.png?1674145008)

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48276517935/original/wEXEwiSr14NPPdyGdJKOadGCjRxCllvjzQ.png?1674144867)

### **If you have a regular (non-SaaS) client or if your SaaS client doesn't have a failed subscription**

Your Client will see a screen to contact you (the agency) to resolve the situation. We will use your phone number & email from your **agency> settings > Company** page.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48276522592/original/wCL7YdwDAZlIqZE-pRXmBnxeL6BESB-cQg.png?1674145778)

---

## **Resuming Sub-Accounts**

As an agency admin, you may resume a sub-account at any given time by heading to Agency Sidebar> Sub-Accounts> Navigating**to the Paused Account.**

Then either click its name or the **3 Dots**to the far right and then click on **Manage Client:**  
  
**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48276524523/original/VL9IfVISchwMDUoPuiU0ZYMRjPtOXwCYYA.png?1674146167)**

**Then go to the Actions dropdown and click on Resume Sub-account:  
![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48276525747/original/mpu5hvMPCSZKd0UBuQrtHzlwrEPy_ojTFw.png?1674146407)**

**It will then ask you for Confirmation. Check the required box and then click on Resume Sub Account:  
![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48276526043/original/b3Gbt1hyxteCr8eBinkjFDEwixZ9T6Kx2A.png?1674146461)**

---

# **FAQ**

### **What happens to a 'Paused' sub-accounts automation, calendars, messaging, etc.? Is everything paused?**

- All the workflows in the sub-account will be drafted when a sub-account is paused. The clients might need to re-publish them after the account is resumed.
- Rest everything in the sub-account will continue working as usual. The onlything that changes is customers will now be prompted to update their subscription or contact the agency on file.

title_en: Notifications inside Client Portal
source_md:
The Client Portal Notifications feature consolidates notifications from the Client Portal and its associated child apps into one central location: the Notifications tab. This allows users to conveniently access and manage their notifications within the application.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [How to Access Notifications](#access-notifications)
- [What Notifications You Will Receive](#notification-types)
- [Managing Notification Preferences](#managing-preferences)
- [Notification Options for Individual Users](#individual-users)
- [Notification Controls for Portal Owners](#portal-owners)
- [How to Manage Your Notification Preferences](#manage-preferences)
- [Benefits of Notification Customization](#benefits)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#faq)
- [Related Articles](#related-articles)

---

## **How to Access Notifications**

The Notifications tab brings Client Portal and child-app notifications together so users can review activity from one place.

- Navigate to the **Bell icon** within the application.
- Notifications, including those from child apps such as Courses and Communities, are listed in the same place.
- Click a notification to view its details or take the relevant action.

Community activity can generate in-app and email notifications based on the member's notification preferences.

```
Note: All notifications sent through the Client Portal, including Communities, are charged. When a notification links to a Community post, the post may open in a dedicated full-page view on the web for easier reading.
```

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155082894526/original/IwOgUmmgCVXDNwWFJCwjKE6mRg11bBRxcg.png?1791492319)

---

## **What Notifications You Will Receive**

```
Note: The table describes available notification types. Granular unsubscribe availability can vary by supported Community email notification type.
```

---

## **Managing Notification Preferences**

The Client Portal includes notification controls that allow individual users and portal owners to manage how and when alerts are delivered. These settings help users stay informed while minimizing unnecessary notifications.

Notifications can be delivered by email or push for mobile app users, and preferences can be customized by event type.

For eligible Community emails, members can also unsubscribe from a specific notification type for a specific community without disabling other Community or platform emails.

---

## **Notification Options for Individual Users**

Users can control whether they receive email or push notifications for specific types of events. This helps create a more personalized notification experience while keeping important updates available.

Users can independently enable or disable email and push notifications for the following event types:

- Community updates
- Course certificates
- Likes on posts
- Likes on comments

Notification preferences can be accessed through the **Manage Your Account** section of the Client Portal.  
  
![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155082895462/original/daqZxxapNmHt_DQGjgftM2TYnK6reteebw.png?1791493697)

### **Unsubscribe from a Specific Community Email**

Granular unsubscribe controls let members stop an eligible Community email notification without disabling unrelated Community or platform emails. The preference applies only to the community that generated the email and the specific notification type shown on the unsubscribe page.

When you click **Unsubscribe** in an eligible Community email:

1. Review the community name and notification type shown on the confirmation page.
2. Confirm the unsubscribe preference.
3. Future emails matching that community and notification type stop.
4. Other notification types from that community continue as normal.
5. The same notification type from other communities continues as normal.
6. Unrelated platform emails remain enabled.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155082895145/original/39vSP_1T9TfvpB-pq360dSvzJPFy64kZkA.png?1791493000)

```
Note: If the unsubscribe link is invalid, has already been used, or has expired, no notification preferences are changed.
```

---

## **Notification Controls for Portal Owners**

Portal owners can configure certain notification defaults, specifically around engagement signals such as likes. These settings apply across the portal and may override individual preferences in some cases.

Owner-controlled settings include:

- Enabling or disabling email notifications for post likes
- Enabling or disabling email notifications for comment likes

When a notification setting is locked by the portal owner, the user will see a tooltip explaining that the option is managed by the administrator.

---

## **How to Manage Your Notification Preferences**

Users can manage their notification preferences directly from their account settings.

1. Navigate to the **Client Portal**, **Communities**, or **Courses** area.
2. Click your **profile icon** in the upper-right corner.
3. Select **Manage Your Account** from the dropdown menu.
4. Choose **Notifications** from the left-hand menu.
5. Use the toggle switches to turn **email** or **push** notifications on or off for each event type.

A Community email notification disabled through an unsubscribe link can be re-enabled from your notification settings at any time.  
  
![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155082894739/original/owZB2WWVPVFWca6u5By6VMN-AfXTCDLfJA.png?1791492532)

---

## **Benefits of Notification Customization**

Notification controls help users stay informed while allowing them to choose which alerts are most relevant to them.

### **Greater Personalization**

Users can tailor their notification preferences to reduce inbox clutter and avoid unnecessary alerts.

### **Push Notification Support**

Push notifications can be independently managed in addition to email, giving mobile users more flexibility.

### **Engagement Awareness**

Users can receive alerts when their content receives likes, helping them stay connected to the community.

### **Simplified User Experience**

Clear tooltips indicate when a notification setting is controlled by the portal owner, reducing confusion and support issues.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Can I unsubscribe from one Community email without disabling all Community emails?**

Yes. For eligible Community emails, you can unsubscribe from a specific notification type for the specific community that generated the email. Other Community and platform emails remain enabled.

**Q: Will unsubscribing stop other notification types from the same community?**

No. Other notification types from that community continue according to your existing notification preferences.

**Q: Will the same notification type be disabled for my other communities?**

No. The unsubscribe preference applies only to the community identified on the unsubscribe confirmation page.

**Q: What happens if the unsubscribe link is invalid, expired, or has already been used?**

No notification preferences are changed. Use your notification settings to review or update your preferences instead.

**Q: Can I turn a Community email notification back on after unsubscribing?**

Yes. Go to the **Client Portal**, **Communities**, or **Courses** area, click your **profile icon**, select **Manage Your Account**, then open **Notifications** and re-enable the applicable notification.

**Q: Why can't I change one of my notification settings?**

Some notification settings can be controlled by the portal owner. When a setting is locked, a tooltip explains that the option is managed by the administrator.

---

### **Related Articles**

- [How to Setup, Customize, and Manage Your Communities](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000000280-how-to-setup-customize-and-manage-your-communities)
- [Notification Preferences for Courses in the Client Portal](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000004655-notification-preferences-for-courses-in-the-client-portal)
- [Client Portal - File Share Notifications for Contacts](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000008265-client-portal-file-share-notifications-for-contacts)
- [Client Portal App - Custom Mobile App Notifications](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000004592)

title_en: How to Use Voice Notes in Community Posts and Comments
source_md:
Communities

# How to Use Voice Notes in Community Posts and Comments

Record voice notes or upload audio files directly in Community posts and comments for a faster and more expressive way to communicate with members.

What You'll Learn

HighLevel Community members can record and send voice notes directly from post and comment composers. Members can also upload existing audio files alongside other post attachments.

This article explains how to record a voice note, upload an audio file, use playback controls, understand the difference between recorded and uploaded audio, and add voice notes to Community comments.

## What Are Voice Notes in Communities?

Voice Notes give Community members a quick way to communicate without typing a long message. Instead of writing everything into a post or comment, you can record your message using the microphone control and publish the recording as part of the conversation.

This can be useful for quick updates, explanations, feedback, instructions, or any situation where speaking is easier than typing. Members can listen to the recording directly from the Community post or comment.

HighLevel also supports uploaded audio files. This means a single Community post can include a voice note that you record in the composer, an existing audio file that you upload, or both.

Voice communication without leaving the discussion

Members can add voice directly to Community posts and comments instead of switching to a separate conversation just to share a quick spoken update.

## Record a Voice Note in a Community Post

You can record a new voice note while creating a Community post. The recording control is available directly from the post composer, alongside the other attachment options.

Step 1

Open the post composer

Open the Community channel where you want to publish and start creating a new post. Enter the title and description required for your post.

Step 2

Select the microphone

Select the **microphone** button in the composer to begin creating a Voice Note.

Step 3

Record your message

Speak your message. While recording, the composer displays an audio waveform and recording duration so you can see that your voice is being captured.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155080953098/original/5IUJ9WM8rup1zUbgvrXn39L9cT1el7NupA.png?1789467569)

## Manage Your Recording Before Posting

You do not have to publish a recording immediately after you start speaking. The Voice Note controls give you time to manage the recording before the post is published.

**Pause** — Temporarily stop recording without ending the Voice Note.

**Resume** — Continue recording after you have paused.

**Cancel** — Discard the current recording when you do not want to keep it.

After finishing the recording, the Voice Note is added to the post as an audio attachment. You can then continue preparing the rest of your post before publishing it.

Review before you publish

Use the available playback control to review your recorded audio before publishing the post when needed.

## Upload an Existing Audio File

You can also attach an existing audio file instead of recording a new Voice Note. This is useful when you already have an audio update, recording, lesson, or other audio content saved as a file.

Step 1

Open the attachment options

While creating the post, use the attachment controls in the composer.

Step 2

Choose your audio file

Select the audio file you want to include. Audio can be added alongside other supported Community post attachments.

Step 3

Review the attachment

The uploaded audio appears with the other attachments in your post composer. A recorded Voice Note and an uploaded audio file can appear together in the same post.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155080956863/original/DgSAOEmUbRKd3tBpnH-3swLcZPMakFgTvQ.png?1789469103)

More Ways to Participate

Speak, Upload, and Listen Without Leaving the Community

Voice Notes make Community discussions more flexible by letting members contribute spoken updates directly inside posts and comments.

## Play Voice Notes and Audio Files

After a post is published, members can play its Voice Notes and uploaded audio directly from the post. Each audio item includes its own playback controls so members can listen without leaving the Community discussion.

Recorded Voice Notes are displayed with a waveform. Uploaded audio files use a timeline-style player that allows members to follow playback progress through the file.

Audio stays connected to the conversation

Members can listen to the audio while viewing the post and its discussion, making it easier to keep spoken information in the same place as the rest of the Community content.

## Add a Voice Note to a Comment

Voice Notes are not limited to the main post. When the comment composer is available, members can record a spoken response and publish it directly as a comment.

Step 1

Open the comment composer

Go to the Community post where you want to respond and select the comment field.

Step 2

Select the microphone

Use the microphone control in the comment composer to begin recording your response.

Step 3

Send the Voice Note

Finish your recording and send the comment. The Voice Note appears inside the comment thread with its audio playback controls.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155080957088/original/kUbvbZruCHx0S5rDnJ6rsqD87AWtHwBCmg.png?1789469196)

## Recorded Voice Notes vs. Uploaded Audio

Both recorded Voice Notes and uploaded audio allow members to listen to spoken or audio content directly inside a Community. They are displayed differently so members can easily recognize how the audio was added.

Recorded Voice Note

Created directly in the composer

A Voice Note is recorded using the microphone control while creating a post or comment. After publishing, the recording is displayed with a waveform-style player.

Uploaded Audio

Added from an existing file

Uploaded audio already exists as a file before you add it to the Community. After publishing, it uses a timeline-style player rather than the Voice Note waveform display.

You can use both in the same post

A Community post can contain a newly recorded Voice Note together with uploaded audio, allowing you to combine a quick introduction with longer prepared audio content.

## Playback Speed and Continuous Listening

Members can control how quickly audio plays. This is useful when listening to longer updates or when someone prefers to review spoken information more quickly.

**1x** — Plays the recording at its normal speed.

**1.5x** — Plays the recording faster while keeping it easy to follow.

**2x** — Plays the recording at twice its normal speed.

Select the speed control on the audio player to move between **1x, 1.5x, and 2x**.

HighLevel also supports continuous listening by automatically moving to the next audio item or Voice Note after the current audio finishes. This helps members listen through multiple audio items without manually starting each one.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Can I record a Voice Note directly in a Community post?

Yes. Use the microphone control in the post composer to record a Voice Note before publishing the post.

Q: Can I pause a recording and continue later?

Yes. While recording, you can pause the Voice Note and resume recording before you finish it.

Q: Can I cancel a Voice Note before publishing it?

Yes. You can cancel the recording if you do not want to keep it and then start again if needed.

Q: Can I upload an audio file instead of recording a Voice Note?

Yes. Existing audio files can be uploaded to a Community post alongside other supported attachments.

Q: Can a post contain both a Voice Note and uploaded audio?

Yes. Recorded Voice Notes and uploaded audio files can appear together in the same Community post.

Q: Can Voice Notes be added to comments?

Yes. When the comment composer is available, members can use its microphone control to record and send a Voice Note as a comment.

Q: What playback speeds are available?

Listeners can cycle through **1x, 1.5x, and 2x** playback speeds.

Q: Why do some audio items show a waveform while others show a timeline?

Voice Notes recorded directly in the composer use a waveform display. Existing audio files uploaded to the post use a timeline-style audio player.

title_en: Communities - How to Manage Members Inside Groups
source_md:
Efficient member management keeps your Community organized, safe, and engaging. This guide covers roles and permissions, inviting and approving members, and privacy so you can scale confidently while maintaining control. Learn best practices and avoid common pitfalls with clear, step‑by‑step instructions.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Managing Members Inside Groups](#What-is-Managing-Members-Inside-Groups)
- [Key Benefits of Managing Members Inside Groups](#Key-Benefits-of-Managing-Members-Inside-Groups)
- [Understanding Member Roles & Permissions](#Understanding-Member-Roles-&-Permissions)
- [How to Invite Members to the Group](#How-to-Invite-Members-to-the-Group)
- [Privacy & Join Flow (Public vs Private)](#Privacy-&-Join-Flow-(Public-vs-Private))
- [How to Modify Member Roles](#How-to-Modify-Member-Roles)
- [How to Remove or Ban Members](#How-to-Remove-or-Ban-Members)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is Managing Members Inside Groups**

Groups foster interactive discussions, connect individuals with shared interests, and serve as knowledge-sharing hubs. Managing members inside Groups refers to the ongoing workflows admins use to add, approve, organize, and remove people from a Group in HighLevel Communities. Understanding roles, privacy, and access controls ensures the right people can join and participate while admins maintain safety, compliance, and a great member experience.

---

## **Key Benefits of Managing Members Inside Groups**

- **Clarity of control:** Assign roles and permissions so owners/admins moderate effectively.
- **Faster onboarding:** Invite by link or email to reduce friction and increase conversions.
- **Stronger safety:** Use private Groups and approvals to keep discussions high‑quality.
- **Time savings via automation:** Grant or revoke access automatically based on actions (e.g., purchases, refunds, cancellations).
- **Better targeting:** Filter contacts by Group for messaging, analytics, and follow‑ups.
- **Revenue alignment:** Combine Paid Groups with access rules to reduce churn and protect premium content.

---

## **Understanding Member Roles & Permissions**

Roles determine who can manage people and content. Picking the right role up front prevents rework and protects your community’s health.

```
Note: A group can only be Deactivated and cannot be Deleted.
```

**Default roles and typical abilities**

A well-structured community group has a hierarchy of roles, each with distinct responsibilities and capabilities. 

- **Owner:** Full control, including deactivating the Group, editing settings, and assigning any role.
- **Admin:** Manage members and content; invite, approve, remove, and adjust roles.
- **Channel Manager (specific channel):** Moderate channel and members for a specific channel.
- **Contributors:** Participate in discussions based on Group privacy and channel access.

| Role | Create Posts | Moderate Posts | Manage Members | Delete Group |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Owner | ✔️ | ✔️ | ✔️ | ✔️ |
| Admin | ✔️ | ✔️ | ✔️ | ❌ |
| Channel Manager (specific channel) | ✔️ | ✔️ | ✔️ | ❌ |
| Contributor | ✔️ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ |

#### 

**Here's a breakdown of the table:**

**Create Posts:** This is the ability to create and publish new posts in the group. All roles except for 'Owner' and 'Admin' may or may not have this ability, depending on the settings established by the 'Owner.'

**Moderate Posts:** This is the ability to moderate, or delete posts made by other group members. This ability is typically reserved for 'Owners,' 'Admins"

**Manage Members:** This includes adding new members, changing members' roles, and removing members from the group. Typically, this ability is reserved for 'Owners' and 'Admins.'

**Deactivate Group:**This is the ability to pause/deactivate the group entirely. This ability is typically reserved only for the 'Owner' to prevent accidental or unauthorized deactivation of the group.

---

## **How to Invite Members to the Group**

Choose the invite method that best fits your needs.

### **Invite via Link**

1. Go to **Memberships** > **Communities**>**Groups.**
2. **Login**to your group.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/oWksATMpugNObgsbTAyg+/GIF+Recording+2025-12-19+at+5.14.14+PM.gif)
3. Click on **Invite Members**.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/dHWA0uD4sNAUI2k0V18N+/Screen+Shot+2025-12-19+at+5.17.24+PM.png)
4. **Copy the Invite Link** and send via email, SMS, WhatsApp, etc.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/gOYZ28ELEtuSU7uHAaKt+/Screen+Shot+2025-12-19+at+5.19.04+PM.png)

### **Invite via Email**

1. Go to **Memberships** > **Communities**>**Groups.**
2. **Login**to your group.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/oWksATMpugNObgsbTAyg+/GIF+Recording+2025-12-19+at+5.14.14+PM.gif)
3. Click on **Invite Members**.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/dHWA0uD4sNAUI2k0V18N+/Screen+Shot+2025-12-19+at+5.17.24+PM.png)
4. Under **Email Invite**, enter name and email id of the recipient.
5. Turn **Administrative** **Privileges** **ON**/**OFF**.
6. Click on **Send Invite**, recipients receive an email with the join action.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/4P79IYkBlKbwkjmH4I7W+/Screen+Shot+2025-12-19+at+5.37.49+PM.png)

---

## **Privacy & Join Flow (Public vs Private)**

Privacy settings control who can discover and join your Group and whether manual approval is required. Choose the mode that balances growth and safety for your audience.

- **Public Groups:** Anyone can see the group posts and other members of the group. Anyone can join immediately, no manual approval required.
- **Private Groups:** Only members can see the group posts and other members of the group. All join attempts require manual review **even when the person uses an invite link**.  
    
  Approve or decline via **Members → Requested → ⋯ (Three Dots) → Request → Approve** or **Decline**.  
    
  ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155061005649/original/c0pcZmG8EM4SLmrLPjAHoHiFf08WCofhOg.png?1766147508)

---

## **How to Modify Member Roles**

As members contribute or take on responsibilities, adjust roles to reflect trust and duties.

1. Go to **Members > Contributors >**locate the member **>**  click **… (three dots)**.
2. Select *Admin,* or *Contributor* (available options depend on your group configuration and your own permissions).  
     
   **![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155061008125/original/LpOTHmBNVtyDkdylsGKNEJEYRwkiVb1xMA.png?1766148796)**

---

## **How to Remove or Ban Members**

Banning a member permanently prevents them from rejoining the group. Removing a member only takes them out of the group for now — they can request to join again in the future.

- **To remove/ban:** go to **Members** > locate member > **… (three dots)** > click on **Ban** or **Remove from Group**.  
    
  ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/flevGp36nXneQ8F9J8yp+/Screen+Shot+2025-12-19+at+6.17.07+PM.png)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: I have a large list of potential members. Is there a way to invite them all at once?**

You can invite multiple members at once by sending out a mass email or SMS campaign with the group URL included. This makes it easy for them to access and join the community.

**Q: Can members invite others to the group, or is this feature exclusive to admins and owners?**

Go to group **Settings** > turn the **Allow members to invite new members** option ON/OFF.

Hides the invite button for members when turned off. Members can only invite others if this is enabled.

**Q: I sent an invitation, but the member hasn't joined yet. Can I resend the invitation?**

Absolutely. It's possible the invitation was missed, or they haven't had a chance to join yet. Simply resend the group URL or joining email again.

---

### **Related Articles**

- [How to Make Groups Private in Communities](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000000735)
- [How to Setup, Customize, and Manage Your Communities](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000000280)
- [Paid Groups](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000001233)
