title_en: Individual Category Result Personalization for Personality Quizzes
source_md:
Personalize quiz outcomes by creating unique result content for each category in your personality-style quizzes. Individual Category result sections allow you to tailor text, images, videos, calls to action, and links based on a quiz taker's highest-scoring or lowest-scoring category. This helps create more engaging result experiences while reducing setup time through reusable category templates.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Individual Category Result Personalization?](#What-is-Individual-Category-Result-Personalization?)
- [Key Benefits of Individual Category Result Personalization](#Key-Benefits-of-Individual-Category-Result-Personalization)
- [How Individual Category Results Work](#How-Individual-Category-Results-Work)
- [Supported Content Types](#Supported-Content-Types)
- [Using the Default Category Template](#Using-the-Default-Category-Template)
- [Individual Category](#Individual-Category)
- [How To Setup Individual Category Result Personalization](#How-To-Setup-Individual-Category-Result-Personalization)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is Individual Category Result Personalization?**

Individual Category Result Personalization allows you to customize the content displayed for specific quiz categories on a quiz results page. Instead of showing the same result content to every quiz taker, you can create unique experiences based on the category that best matches their responses.

This feature is especially useful for personality assessments, readiness evaluations, recommendation quizzes, and other category-based quizzes where personalized results can improve engagement and conversion rates.

---

## **Key Benefits of Individual Category Result Personalization**

Personalized result content helps quiz takers receive more relevant outcomes while giving you greater control over how results are presented and optimized.

- **Personalized Experiences:**Display unique content tailored to a quiz taker's highest-scoring or lowest-scoring category.
- **Improved Engagement:**Deliver category-specific messaging that feels more relevant and meaningful.
- **Flexible Content Options:** Add customized text, images, videos, CTA buttons, and links for each category.
- **Faster Setup:** Use the first category as a starting template to reduce repetitive configuration.
- **Better Conversions:** Guide quiz takers toward category-specific offers, resources, or next steps.

---

## **How Individual Category Results Work**

Individual Category result sections dynamically display content based on category scoring outcomes. When a quiz is submitted, HighLevel identifies the applicable category and displays the content assigned to that category.

You can configure content to display for either the highest-scoring category or the lowest-scoring category, depending on the goals of your quiz.

### **Using the Default Category Template**

To help streamline setup, the first category can serve as a starting template when configuring Individual Category result sections. This approach reduces repetitive work by allowing you to establish a baseline layout and content structure before customizing each category individually.

```
Important Considerations:

The first category can be used as a content starting point.

Additional categories can then be customized independently.

Category-specific messaging, media, and CTAs can be adjusted to match each outcome.
```

---

## **How To Setup Individual Category Result Personalization**

Proper setup ensures quiz takers receive the correct personalized content based on their scoring outcome. Following the configuration process carefully helps maintain consistency across all category result experiences.

1. Open the Quiz Builder.  
     
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155072629432/original/ST-VDZFZhD0d0kc85LbtJxn9YZeos1peQw.png?1780327282)  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155072629562/original/Xs1z62yUd1yO10NX-Z9d4nNPXEkkG-B31g.png?1780327348)
2. In the left panel, click + Add Section.   
     
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155072629892/original/Z1j4CgaTV3yCueiZv_uQI8E9wCAtSDfsVA.png?1780327494)
3. From the section picker, select Individual Category.  
     
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155072629967/original/kKgBLFV5yQiihVOHuZlOS9GKzewTU7hoGg.png?1780327548)
4. Click the newly added Individual Category section in the left panel to expand it.  
     
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155072630122/original/iKLStgDFk-W0k9V5COS1RAa0R22cv2e8yQ.png?1780327618)
5. Select the category you want to customize.  
     
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155072630160/original/DbKMKaC1vPiM4910L0-Q8Z1cMv0Wr2P3tQ.png?1780327664)
6. In the right panel, locate Display Category. Choose whether the content should apply to Highest Score and Lowest Score.  
     
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155072630289/original/AConX-n4TJ-I89GPe1b-P1wD4wnZ7sw5Qw.png?1780327731)
7. Customize the content for the selected category:  
     
   - Text
   - Images
   - Videos
   - CTA text
   - CTA links
8. Repeat the process for each category you want to personalize.
9. Preview the result page to verify the experience.
10. Save and publish your quiz.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Can I customize every category differently?**

A: Yes. Each category can have its own unique content, media, CTA text, and links.

**Q: Can I use images and videos within category-specific results?**

A: Yes. Individual Category result sections support both images and videos.

**Q: Can I create different CTA buttons for different categories?**

A: Yes. CTA text and destination links can be customized for each category.

**Q: Can I display content based on the lowest-scoring category?**

A: Yes. The Display Category setting allows you to choose either Highest Score or Lowest Score.

**Q: Do I need a personality-style quiz to use this feature?**

A: This feature is designed for category-based quiz experiences where scoring determines result categories.

**Q: What types of quizzes benefit most from this feature?**

A: Personality quizzes, readiness assessments, recommendation quizzes, coaching evaluations, and category-based scoring quizzes typically benefit the most.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Quiz Builder Guide](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000004126)
- [Setting Up Personality-Style Quizzes (Highest/Lowest Category)](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000006492)
- [How to Assign Categories and Scoring in Quizzes With Dynamic Result Messages - A Complete Guide!](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000004750)
- [Customizing Quiz Result Pages](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000006615)
- [Map Quiz Results Directly to CRM Custom Fields](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000006913)
- [Workflow Trigger - Quiz Submitted](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000004437)

title_en: Step-by-Step: Build the Perfect Google Business Profile for Your Chiropractic Clinic
source_md:
### **Why This Matters More Than You Think**

Imagine someone in your area searches “chiropractor near me” because they’ve just pulled their back or are struggling with neck pain. You could be the perfect provider. But if your Google listing isn’t optimized — or worse, doesn’t exist — that patient is going to call your competitor instead.

Your **Google Business Profile (GBP)** is your clinic’s digital front door. It’s often the *first impression* you make — before a patient ever visits your website, books online, or picks up the phone.

This guide walks you through exactly how to set up a high-converting, trust-building, appointment-generating GBP — tailored for chiropractors.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [Why This Matters More Than You Think](#Why-This-Matters-More-Than-You-Think)
- [Claim or Create Your Google Business Profile](#1.-Claim-or-Create-Your-Google-Business-Profile)
- [Choose the Right Business Categories](#2.-Choose-the-Right-Business-Categories)
- [Get Your Business Info Right (NAP Consistency)](#3.-Get-Your-Business-Info-Right-(NAP-Consistency))
- [Write a Compelling Chiropractic Clinic Description](#4.-Write-a-Compelling-Chiropractic-Clinic-Description)
- [Upload Photos That Build Trust](#5.-Upload-Photos-That-Build-Trust)
- [List Out Your Services and Pricing (if applicable)](#6.-List-Out-Your-Services-and-Pricing-(if-applicable))
- [Enable Messaging](#7.-Enable-Messaging)
- [Collect & Respond to Reviews](#8.-Collect-&-Respond-to-Reviews)
- [3 Quick Wins to Boost Local Visibility](#3-Quick-Wins-to-Boost-Local-Visibility)
- [Final Word](#Final-Word)

---

### **1. Claim or Create Your Google Business Profile**

Head to [Google Business Profile Manager](https://business.google.com/in/business-profile/?ppsrc=GPDA2).

- Log in using a professional email (ideally tied to your clinic’s domain).
- Search your clinic’s name.

  - If it exists: **Claim it immediately**.
  - If it doesn’t: **Create a new one** using your official clinic name.

> Keep your clinic name clean and consistent. No added keywords like "Best Chiropractor in [City]."

Think of this step as claiming your piece of digital real estate — one that patients are actively searching.

Claim or create a Google Business Profile

---

### **2. Choose the Right Business Categories**

Your **Primary Category** defines your core service:

- **Chiropractor** *(Select only one primary category)*

Add **Secondary Categories** to help Google better understand your services:

- Sports Injury Clinic
- Wellness Center
- Pain Control Clinic
- Massage Therapist *(only if offered onsite)*
- Physical Therapy Clinic

> Don’t guess — be strategic. Adding irrelevant categories can confuse the algorithm and hurt your ranking.

Understand how local search works

Improve your local ranking on Google

---

### **3. Get Your Business Info Right (NAP Consistency)**

Google values **consistency** across all your listings. Your name, address, and phone number (NAP) should match *exactly* on your website, Facebook, directories, and here.

Checklist:

- **Name**: Exactly as seen on your signage and site
- **Address**: Pinned correctly on Google Maps
- **Phone**: Use your business line, not a personal number
- **Website**: Ideally links to your GHL booking page
- **Hours**: Double check — out-of-date hours kill trust

> Matching your NAP across all platforms builds authority and trust with Google — which boosts your local ranking.

Edit your business description

---

### **4. Write a Compelling Chiropractic Clinic Description**

This is where your story meets search.

Use this simple format:

- Who you help
- What you specialize in
- What makes you different
- Where you’re located

**Example:** "At Axis Spine & Wellness, we help busy professionals, athletes, and families relieve pain and restore balance through tailored chiropractic care. From spinal adjustments to injury rehab, our Plano clinic delivers expert, patient-centered treatments."

Your description isn’t just for patients — Google reads it too. Add relevant keywords naturally (like your city name, your specialties, or pain relief terms).

---

### **5. Upload Photos That Build Trust**

You wouldn’t walk into a clinic that looks dark, cluttered, or impersonal — and neither would your patients. Your photos need to reflect the *real*, welcoming energy of your practice.

Post high-quality images of:

- **Exterior**: So patients recognize your clinic from the street
- **Interior**: Clean, bright treatment and waiting areas
- **Team**: Friendly, confident faces of your staff
- **Action**: Adjustments, consults, or therapy (with permission)
- **Tools & Equipment**: Modern tech = credibility

> Listings with photos get 42% more direction requests and 35% more clicks. First impressions matter — online and off.

Add photos to your Business Profile

Business Profile photo guidelines

---

### **6. List Out Your Services and Pricing (if applicable)**

Your prospective patients want clarity: What do you do, and what does it cost?

Examples:

- New Patient Exam – $49
- Spinal Adjustment – $60
- Sports Injury Rehab – $75
- Prenatal Chiropractic – $70

Adding your services not only helps people choose you — it also gives Google more data to rank you higher in relevant searches.

---

### **7. Enable Messaging**

People don’t always want to call. Sometimes, they just want to ask a quick question first.

Enable “Chat with Customers” from your GBP dashboard. Then set a warm, friendly auto-response:

"Thanks for contacting [Clinic Name]! We'll respond within 1 business hour. For urgent bookings, please call us directly."

> Google rewards responsiveness — fast replies can help you rank better.

[Learn how to integrate your GMB profile with GHL CRM](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001222899-how-to-integrate-your-google-business-profile-formerly-gmb-into-the-crm)

---

### **8. Collect & Respond to Reviews**

Chiropractic care is personal. Prospective patients want proof that others trust you — and that you care.

How to get more 5-star reviews:

- Ask right after a great visit
- Share your review link via text or email
- Post a QR code at checkout

When replying:

- Use the patient’s name
- Mention the service they received
- Keep it warm, grateful, and human

**Example:** "Thanks, Sarah! We’re so happy your tension headaches have improved. Looking forward to your next visit!"

> Pro Tip: Patients trust reviews with thoughtful responses more than ones with no replies at all.

---

### **3 Quick Wins to Boost Local Visibility**

| Hack | Why It Works |
| --- | --- |
| Post weekly wellness tips or clinic promos | Google favors active, updated profiles |
| Add a "Book Appointment" button linked to GHL | Less friction = more patients booked |
| Rotate photos seasonally | Shows your clinic is alive and engaged |

---

### **Final Word**

Your **Google Business Profile** isn’t just a listing — it’s your best-performing, free lead generation tool.

If you set it up intentionally, maintain it regularly, and let GHL handle the bookings and reviews in the background — you’re going to see results.

✅ Claim your profile.  
? Optimize it monthly.  
? Watch your schedule fill up — week after week.

---

Ready to grow? **[Sign up with HighLevel](https://www.gohighlevel.com/?utm_source=seo&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=chiropractor&utm_term=chiropractor&utm_content=playbook)**

title_en: Introducing Chats: Start Conversations On GoKollab
source_md:
Chats in HighLevel’s GoKollab enable direct, member-to-member messaging inside your communities. By keeping conversations in-platform, you can collaborate faster, follow up efficiently, and keep discussion history in one place. Use Chats to connect with peers you share a community with—without switching tools.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is GoKollab Chats?](#What-is-GoKollab-Chats?)
- [Key Benefits of using GoKollab Chats](#Key-Benefits-of-using-GoKollab-Chats)
- [How To Use GoKollab Chats](#How-To-Use-GoKollab-Chats)
- [In-Platform Messaging](#In-Platform-Messaging)
- [Privacy & Safety](#Privacy-&-Safety)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is GoKollab Chats?**

Chats is GoKollab’s built-in direct messaging experience for members who share a community. It keeps collaboration close to where discussion and learning happen so you can move from a public thread to a focused conversation when needed.

Chats allows you to start a private conversation with another member directly from your community discussion page. Messages live inside GoKollab, helping you keep context, continuity, and momentum across your work.

---

## **Key Benefits of using GoKollab Chats**

These benefits focus on speed, context, and simplicity—helping members stay engaged and organized while reducing the need for external messaging tools.

- **Direct messaging:** Start one-to-one conversations with members who share your community.
- **Centralized inbox:** View and manage all conversations in a single place.
- **Searchable history:** Find past conversations quickly when you need to reference decisions or details.
- **In-app notifications:** Get notified inside GoKollab when a new message arrives so you can respond promptly.
- **Context preserved:** Begin a chat from the community discussion page to keep conversations tied to where collaboration started.
- **Simple and intuitive:** Lightweight, approachable design that’s easy for any member to use.

---

## **How To Use GoKollab Chats**

A quick setup process ensures members can start collaborating immediately while admins keep expectations clear.

1. **Sign in** to HighLevel and open **GoKollab**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155053380847/original/SEfIDc-766-4hXm3p8XFSUesHaMiiLpqUA.png?1757420041)

     
   **OR** Login directly from GoKollab website  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155053381166/original/LPeswmYaWW_cg6YVzRPANc4zXbS1gc8uBw.png?1757420155)
2. Go to your **community discussion page**.
3. Click the **Chat**button on the top right and start a conversation with any community member.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155053671061/original/lJCOFkgIOdq3xloMSTvr_0-nzRUKDgnyQA.png?1757685471)
4. Open your **Chats inbox** to view, search, and continue conversations.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155053671100/original/Wd9GhVD3Iz37fNJx-t_HJ4D4aXeFqKCQIA.png?1757685512)
5. Confirm that **in-app notifications** are enabled so you don’t miss new messages.

---

## **In-Platform Messaging**

Starting conversations from within the community keeps work in context and encourages timely, focused collaboration.

- Chats is available to members **who share a community** in GoKollab.
- Access Chats from your **community discussion page** and from your **conversations list** (your Chats inbox).

- Move from a public post to a private exchange without leaving GoKollab.
- See all your ongoing chats **in one place**.
- Use **search** to quickly locate prior conversations and details.
- For broader community concepts, roles, and member management, see **[How to Setup, Customize, and Manage Your Communities](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000000280-how-to-setup-customize-and-manage-your-communities?utm_source=chatgpt.com)** and **[How to Manage Members Inside Groups](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000000289-how-to-manage-members-inside-groups?utm_source=chatgpt.com)**

---

## **Privacy & Safety**

Clear boundaries between product areas help members choose the right messaging tool and avoid confusion.

- **GoKollab Chats vs. Internal Chat:** GoKollab Chats are **member-to-member** messages in communities. Internal Chat is **team communication** inside your HighLevel account. See **[Internal Chat: Private Team Communication](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000004686-internal-chat-private-team-communication)**
- **GoKollab Chats vs. Chat Widget:** The Chat Widget is a website widget for lead/customer messaging—not member DMs. See **[Chat Widget Integration with the Client Portal](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005913-chat-widget-integration-with-the-client-portal)**
- Direct messages are designed for participant-to-participant communication within your shared community. For workspace policies or compliance needs, check with your workspace admin.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Who can I message using Chats?**  
You can start direct messages with members who **share a community** with you in GoKollab.

**Q: Where do I find all my chats?**  
Open your **Chats**inbox to view and manage all ongoing conversations in one place.

**Q: Can I create a group chat?**  
The current documentation focuses on **direct (one-to-one) messaging** between members who share a community.

**Q: How are notifications delivered for Chats?**  
You’ll receive **in-app notifications** for new messages. For general notification preferences, see **[Set Up Custom Notifications](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001224427-how-to-set-up-custom-notifications-as-a-user-in-a-sub-account?utm_source=chatgpt.com)**

**Q: Is Chats the same as Internal Chat or the Chat Widget?**  
No. **Internal Chat** is for **your team** inside HighLevel, and the **Chat Widget** is a website tool for **lead/customer**messaging. GoKollab Chats is for **member-to-member** messaging inside communities.

**Q: Is Chats available on mobile?**  
GoKollab experiences surface chat and notifications in the community header on mobile; availability and interface can vary by app version. Use in-app notifications to stay informed.

title_en: Taxes and Processing Fees for Services (v2)
source_md:
[동영상](https://www.youtube.com/embed/ujInVuDmkZU?&wmode=opaque)

Manage calendar-based bookings in HighLevel with transparent manual taxes and custom processing (miscellaneous) fees in **Services (v2)**. This guide explains what the feature is, who it’s for, how to configure it, and how totals appear across the booking form, appointment modal, receipts, and reports. You’ll also find provider compatibility notes, calculation rules, FAQs, and links to related setup articles.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Taxes and Processing Fees for Services (v2)?](#%E2%80%8B%E2%80%8BWhat-is-Taxes-and-Processing-Fees-for-Services-(v2)?)
- [Key Benefits of Taxes and Processing Fees](#Key-Benefits-of-Taxes-and-Processing-Fees%C2%A0)
- [Processing Fees / Miscellaneous Charges](#Processing-Fees-/-Miscellaneous-Charges)
- [Manual Taxes in Services (v2)](#Manual-Taxes-in-Services-(v2))
- [Visibility in Bookings & Receipts](#Visibility-in-Bookings-&-Receipts)
- [How To Set Up Taxes & Processing Fees](#How-To-Set-Up-Taxes-&-Processing-Fees)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is Taxes and Processing Fees for Services (v2)?**

Taxes and processing fees in **Services (v2)** let you present a clean, itemized checkout to customers while keeping internal reporting accurate. Each Service automatically creates a **linked Product**. You attach **manual tax rate(s)** to that Product, and optionally add a **processing/miscellaneous fee** to the Service so both appear automatically when the Service is booked.

---

## **Key Benefits of Taxes and Processing Fees**

These benefits focus on transparency, compliance, and consistency across payments. Use them to reduce billing disputes and simplify reconciliation.

- **Cost recovery:** pass through card/convenience costs with a labeled fee.
- **Compliance:** meet local rules using accurate manual sales/VAT/GST rates.
- **Consistency:** align totals across booking pages, appointment records, receipts, and exports.
- **Trust:** show an **itemized** total before payment to reduce confusion and chargebacks.

---

## **Processing Fees / Miscellaneous Charges**

A **Miscellaneous Charge** (processing fee) is an extra percentage-based line you add per **Service (v2)** to cover processing or convenience costs. The label and percentage are fully customizable and display as a separate line at checkout and on receipts.

**What it does**

- Percentage-based fee (e.g., **5%**) with a custom label (e.g., **“Service Charge”**).
- Displays as its own line on the **public booking form** and on **payment receipts**.
- Appears in the **appointment record** so staff can see the subtotal, fee, tax, and total.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155056277687/original/CeohL25mWr6kUOr8WFZe4nbPGusDvjNX1w.png?1760719633)

---

## **Manual Taxes in Services (v2)**

Manual taxes are attached to a **Product**, not directly to the Service. Because each Service has a **linked Product**, assigning tax rate(s) to that Product ensures the correct taxes are added to the booking total every time the Service is purchased.

**How it works**

- Each Service (v2) **auto-creates** a linked Product.
- Add one or more **tax rate(s)** to that Product in **Payments → Settings → Taxes**.
- When the Service is booked, those tax rate(s) are applied automatically.

---

## **Visibility in Bookings & Receipts**

Knowing where fees and taxes appear helps teams verify totals and answer customer questions. The same totals carry into the appointment record for internal clarity and reporting.

You’ll see taxes and fees:

- On the **public booking form** (itemized just above the total).
- Inside the **appointment modal** for staff, including payment details.
- On **sales receipts** emailed to the customer (when receipts are enabled).

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155056279159/original/5IzibjI_zEqifwFFE01gpVJOmAOrTP6oqg.png?1760721164)**

---

## **How To Set Up Taxes & Processing Fees**

Proper setup ensures every booking reflects accurate totals, reduces customer confusion, and speeds up reconciliation. Follow these steps to configure both taxes and fees.

1. **In your Sub-Account, Click on Settings → Calendars → Services** → select the Service to edit.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155056278875/original/yxJAj75bsGQ_vMSQUctK1k9EyYbdXzELgA.png?1760720733)
2. **Payments** section → click **Configure Taxes for This Service**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155056278902/original/Bm3jNyvhnfCa0LV_os3x5yRwGXiKmshqEg.png?1760720770)
3. In the **linked Product** window, choose **Add Tax Rate** or select an existing rate → **Save**.  
   **(Optional) Add a Processing/Miscellaneous Fee** on the Service → enter a **percentage** and a **custom label**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155056279039/original/u377K1S3iRyCkkQTmxfAj1DqGTBCB9kIEA.png?1760720984)
4. **Save** the Service. Future bookings will itemize the **fee** and **tax** lines automatically on the booking page, appointment record, and receipt.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155056279063/original/bKySYIg6nt9LmXNNTl0--OeaEI9uhyDD7g.png?1760721033)

   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155056279050/original/kSmY5JHsWDhGgR_NpC5GiEAc7IP1C02YNQ.png?1760721013)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Can I use different fees for different Services?**  
Yes. Fees are configured **per Service** in Services (v2), so each Service can have its own percentage and label.

**Q: Do tax or fee changes affect past bookings?**  
No. Edits affect **new** bookings going forward; previously completed bookings and receipts remain unchanged.

**Q: Where can I export a report of collected fees and taxes?**  
Go to **Payments → Transactions → Export CSV** (and **Orders CSV** if used). Exports include columns for fee amounts/labels and taxes to support reconciliation.

**Q: How do discounts and deposits affect the total?**  
Discounts reduce the taxable base on the **linked Product** and may affect the fee if the fee is calculated as a percentage of the service price. For deposits, the appointment modal and receipts show what was collected vs. remaining.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [How‑to Add Taxes – Overview](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001224104-how-to-add-taxes-overview)
- [Collecting Payments in Calendars](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000000875-collecting-payments-in-calendars)
- [PayPal in Calendars](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000006712-paypal-in-calendars)
- [How to enable Sales Receipts for Order Form, Calendar and Invoice payments](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000000261-how-to-enable-sales-receipts-for-order-form-calendar-and-invoice-payments)
- [Workflow Trigger – Service Booking (Services v2)](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000006140-workflow-trigger-service-booking-services-v2-)

title_en: How to Create and Use Call Scripts in Web & App Dialers
source_md:
Call Scripts provide reusable talking points and conversation guidance that agents can view directly during live calls in supported HighLevel dialers. This article explains how to create and manage Call Scripts at the sub-account level and how agents can open and follow a script from the Web Dialer, HighLevel Mobile App, or LeadConnector Mobile App.

```
Note: This feature is available in HighLevel Web Dialer, HighLevel App Dialer and Lead Connector App.
```

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What are Call Scripts?](#What-are-Call-Scripts?)
- [Key Benefits of Call Scripts](#Key-Benefits-of-Call-Scripts)
- [How to Create and Use Call Scripts in Web & App Dialers](#How-to-Create-and-Use-Call-Scripts-in-Web-&-App-Dialers)
- [What You Can Add to a Call Script](#What-You-Can-Add-to-a-Call-Script)
- [How to Use Call Scripts in the Web & App Dialers](#How-to-Use-Call-Scripts-in-the-Web-&-App-Dialers)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

## **What are Call Scripts?**

Call Scripts provide on-demand conversation guidance that agents can view while speaking with a contact. Scripts can contain approved talk tracks, discovery questions, qualification criteria, objection-handling guidance, or compliance language so agents can stay consistent without switching tabs or searching for external notes.

---

## **Key Benefits of Call Scripts**

Call Scripts enhance your team’s performance by providing clear, repeatable talk tracks that support effective communication and faster ramp-up times.

- **Keep messaging consistent:** Give agents repeatable talk tracks for common conversations.
- **Support faster onboarding:** Help new team members follow approved discovery and qualification processes.
- **Reduce context switching:** Keep guidance visible inside the dialer instead of requiring external notes or documents.
- **Improve call structure:** Help agents cover important questions, objections, and next steps consistently.
- **Support compliance:** Provide approved language agents can reference during relevant calls.

---

## **How to Create and Use Call Scripts in Web & App Dialers**

Creating Call Scripts is a straightforward process designed to integrate guided call support into your existing workflow. Follow these steps to ensure your agents can access the right script at the right time:

1. Login to your sub-account and click on **Settings**.  
  
![](https://jumpshare.com/share/rCL4O7JdW3kUkHJbD0QY+/Screen+Shot+2025-07-31+at+9.06.14+PM.png)

2. Navigate to **Phone Systems**and click on **Voice**.   
  
![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155062377171/original/S3hbiAE9QBep9UgxIogosdpjCvCVVzl7XQ.png?1768060143)

3. Click on **Call Scripts**and then on**Add Scripts**button.  
  
![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155062377191/original/WGeW8B1xLQEkKvgN2S4VtmujknPdjIEUoA.png?1768060204)

4. Create a new call script by inputting your preferred content and click on **Save**.  
  
![](https://jumpshare.com/share/fyR4YRDPZWX2vnVHGsKZ+/Screen+Shot+2025-07-31+at+9.18.54+PM.png)

---

## **What You Can Add to a Call Script**

Call Scripts currently support **plain text**. Use them for content such as:

- Opening statements
- Discovery questions
- Qualification criteria
- Objection-handling responses
- Required disclosures
- Closing or next-step prompts

> **Note:** Rich-text formatting and clickable hyperlinks are not currently supported.

---

## **How to Use Call Scripts in the Web & App Dialers**

Agents can access Call Scripts during live calls from directly within the Dialers, keeping the entire workflow in one place. This ensures conversations remain focused and consistent, without the need to open new tabs or refer to external documents.

Once a Call Script is available to you, you can open it directly from a supported dialer during an active call.

Steps to Use Call Scripts:

1. Start or answer a call using the HighLevel Web Dialer, HighLevel Mobile App, or LeadConnector Mobile App.
2. During the active call, click or tap **Scripts**.  
     
   - **Web Dialer**  
     ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155050750989/original/Y-4kiVD1s3tbvZo69MMCtcjnSXIDR_UARg.png?1753978033)
   - **App Dialer**  
       
     ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155050751309/original/LWVWBftq9wTgpvDA9LYTk3JZTdHrW9Pn7A.png?1753978347)
3. **Select the Call Script you want to use.**  
     
   - **Web Dialer**  
     ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155050751852/original/KcpJGp9RhBv0hsziIcrHgshJAC3XSshefg.png?1753978847)
   - **App Dialer**  
     ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155050752044/original/anfTPl5z6ivt7eZpeZZWjji6m7nGhBGJTA.png?1753978998)
4. Review and follow the script while speaking with the contact. Switch scripts if another available script is more appropriate for the conversation.

**Note:** Opening or switching a Call Script does not affect the active call.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

******Q. Why don't I see Call Scripts in the mobile app?****** Make sure you're using the latest available version of the HighLevel or LeadConnector mobile app. If the option still isn't available, verify that a script has been created and is available to your user.

**Q: Can call scripts be edited after they are created?**

Yes, call scripts can be updated at any time from the web interface to refine your conversation guidance.

**Q: Is the call script feature available for white labelled apps?**

Yes, although updates for white labelled apps must be requested separately.

****Q. Who can access a Call Script?**** Call Scripts can be configured at the sub-account level and, where supported, assigned to specific users or teams. Users only see scripts available to them during supported calls.

**Q: Can I format text or add links in call scripts?**

At this time, Call Scripts support plain text only. Rich formatting and hyperlinks are not supported.

**Q. When do edits to a Call Script become available?**

Saved updates are reflected when users next open or reload the script in a supported dialer.

**Q. Are Call Scripts the same as Manual Call actions?**

No. A Call Script provides guidance during a live call. A Manual Call workflow action creates a call task for a user under **Conversations → Manual Actions**. You can use both together—for example, a workflow can create the call task and the agent can reference a Call Script while completing it.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [The Phone Dialer Overview](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005807)
- [Outbound Calling Using the HighLevel Mobile App](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005543)
- [Outbound Calls with Dialer in Web App (Softphone)](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48000981431)
- [What is LC (Lead Connector) Phone System?](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48001223546)
- [Getting Started - Setup Email, Phone, and SMS](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005058)

title_en: How to Schedule Community Posts from Social Planner
source_md:
Schedule your posts in advance for your community groups and channels directly from the social planner.

[동영상](https://www.youtube.com/embed/c7U9uDXDLjQ?&wmode=opaque)

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [Scheduling Community Posts from Social Planner](#Scheduling-Community-Posts-from-Social-Planner)
- [Key Benefits of Scheduling Community Posts from Social Planner](#Key-Benefits-of-Scheduling-Community-Posts-from-Social-Planner)
- [How to Connect Community Groups in Social Planner](#How-to-Connect-Community-Groups-in-Social-Planner)
- [How to Create and Schedule Community Posts](#How-to-Create-and-Schedule-Community-Posts)
- [Schedule Community Posts Using the Public API](#Schedule-Community-Posts-Using-the-Public-API)
- [Manage Comments from Social Planner](#Manage-Comments-from-Social-Planner)
- [Important Points to Note](#Important-Points-to-Note%C2%A0)

---

## **Scheduling Community Posts from Social Planner**

Scheduling Community posts from Social Planner allows you to create content in advance and publish it to selected Community channels at the right time. Instead of manually posting inside each Community channel, you can use Social Planner to prepare posts, attach supported media, select the posting user, and schedule content from one centralized workflow.

Community scheduling is useful for announcements, weekly engagement prompts, course updates, event reminders, and other planned content that should appear inside your Community without requiring manual publishing at the exact time.

---

## **Key Benefits of Scheduling Community Posts from Social Planner**

- **Centralized Planning:** Schedule Community content from Social Planner alongside your other planned posts.
- **Scheduled Posting:** Plan and schedule your content in advance, ensuring posts go live at the optimal time for each community. This helps maintain engagement and ensures your message reaches members at the best times.
- **Unified****Content****Management**: Track and manage all posts (past and future) from a single interface. View post history, upcoming scheduled posts, and current statuses across all communities for quick adjustments and oversight.

---

## **How to Connect Community Groups in Social Planner**

To connect Community groups and channels in Social Planner:

1. Navigate to **Marketing**> **Social Planner** > **Settings**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084528847/original/vkdqD6VYE3vvOQ0r9haVLDH2bWkUJa2ryQ.png?1793288734)
2. Select **Communities** then click **Connect Community**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084844136/original/BvnNJG3c5XguT5Ike4RIlWVhdByN25guiQ.png?1793711588)  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084844159/original/JJ09sD4mi4PzIQhI9RZoBN-Dtm6NJKkDSw.png?1793711611)
3. Choose the Community groups you want to make available in Social Planner.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155071931511/original/KsKTaRddOpuQbVPJ9_KabzSTHP9OCy5dvg.png?1779378493)

```
Note: Community will only be connected from the respective sub-account inside the Social Planner.
```

---

## **How to Create and Schedule Community Posts**

1. Click **+****New Post** from within the Social Planner.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084844224/original/25EJscAe8wyWKUCpwTulmvhO7QcN5rqQXA.png?1793711667)
2. In the channel or account selector, choose the connected **Community** channels where the post should be published. Select one or multiple Community channels as needed.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084844319/original/jxnZKk7t2fbuMlBKyXnWVc0hvfTVnRCNUQ.png?1793711723)
3. Add your content with rich text media:  
     
   **Both****Fo****rmat -** Image and Video are allowed, 10 Image(s) or Video(s) are allowed.  
     
   **Images -**The maximum size of the image is 10 MB  
     
   **Video -**Maximum size for video is 1 GB and duration minimum of 4 seconds.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155071932491/original/Ztuzl56rHv1A0rR54p2Y--qYpD9O65Teyw.jpeg?1779378992)
4. Fill the mandatory fields such as **Title** and select the **User** you want to post as.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155035587541/original/TDUPwcTXnQV-9z15t6a70tcmegJ_JJT60Q.png?1730148455)
5. Once the post has all information added, click **Post** then select the option **Schedule Post**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155071933674/original/JzU8vmBRv-_q_wnC4uoYdWxVGj0EV8gwzg.png?1779379530)
6. Choose the desired date and time then click **Schedule Post**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155071933471/original/l8f97xK2EAa0ivYT7LXwmXBi-CreMWe7Qg.png?1779379474)

```
Note: Community posting is allowed for CSV and other types of post.
```

---

## **Schedule Community Posts Using the Public API**

Community posts can also be created and scheduled through the Social Planner public API. This allows Marketplace apps and private integrations to automate Community publishing without requiring users to create each post manually.

Developers can use the API to:

- Retrieve eligible members of a connected Community channel.
- Select the Community member who will publish the post.
- Validate whether a selected member can still publish in the Community group.
- Create and schedule Community posts.
- Receive validation errors when required publishing-member information is missing or invalid.

HighLevel also verifies the selected member's eligibility before publishing. If the member no longer has permission to publish, the post fails instead of publishing under an incorrect identity.

For implementation details, refer to the official API documentation:

- [Get Community Members](https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/social-planner/get-community-users/)
- [Validate Community Member](https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/social-planner/validate-community-user-membership/)

---

## **Manage Comments from Social Planner**

You can view and reply to comments on Communities posts from within Social Planner. For more information, see [Manage Comments in Social Planner.](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000006433)  
  
![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155071932921/original/a63m1zCLRNG8hflrwRr0XNDZbMv-C2dCzg.png?1779379170)

---

## **Important Points to Note**

- If there are new Channels or changes to Group/Channel details, it will not auto-populate in Social Planner. The user will have to go to **Social Planner Settings > Communities** to re-sync the groups and channels.
- In Post Composer area, there is option to add user on whose name the post will be published. In Social Planner **Settings** > there will be option to go to **Communities** > you can select default users who will be used when you create new social post.

title_en: Social Planner - Bluesky Integration
source_md:
[동영상](https://www.youtube.com/embed/HtvgYE15M08?&wmode=opaque)

Bluesky is a decentralized social network for sharing text, images, and videos. With HighLevel’s Social Planner, you can connect your Bluesky account and publish without switching apps. This guide shows how to connect and start composing, scheduling, and publishing in one place.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Bluesky Integration?](#What-is-Bluesky-Integration?)
- [Key Benefits of Bluesky Integration](#Key-Benefits-of-Bluesky-Integration)
- [Bluesky Publishing Specifications](#Bluesky-Publishing-Specifications)
- [Bluesky Posting Guidelines](#Bluesky-Posting-Guidelines)
- [How to Create App Password in Bluesky](#How-to-Create-App-Password-in-Bluesky)
- [How To Connect Bluesky with Social Planner](#How-To-Connect-Bluesky-with-Social-Planner)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is Bluesky Integration?**

Bluesky Integration adds the fast-growing Bluesky network to Social Planner’s supported platforms. Authenticate your Bluesky handle using an app password, then create, schedule, and track Bluesky posts from the same calendar that already manages Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, Google Business Profile, TikTok, and more.

---

## **Key Benefits of Bluesky Integration**

- **Zero context-switching:** Plan, draft, and publish Bluesky posts alongside your other channels in Social Planner.
- **Faster client approvals:** Route Bluesky posts through the same review/approval flow your team already uses, so nothing goes live without sign-off.
- **Fail-safe publishing:** Compose within Bluesky’s limits (300 characters, up to 4 images or one video) to avoid last-minute errors and failed posts.
- **Keep a steady cadence:** Batch and schedule posts for the week in minutes so Bluesky stays active even when your team is busy.
- **Fewer tools, lower cost:** Skip separate Bluesky schedulers—manage everything in HighLevel to save money and reduce admin overhead.

---

## **Bluesky Publishing Specifications**

| Category | Images | Video |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **File Types** | JPEG, PNG | MP4, MOV |
| **Max File Size** | 1 MB | 50 MB |
| **Max Uploads per Post** | Up to 4 images | 1 video (cannot mix with images) |
| **Dimensions / Resolution** | Standard web resolution | Recommended 480p–720p) |
| **Aspect Ratio** | – | 16:9 or 1:1 |
| **Duration** | – | Up to 3 minutes |
| **Frame Rate** | – | 30–60 FPS |
| **Codecs** | – | H.264 (video), AAC (audio) |
| **Other Notes** | - | No custom thumbnails |

---

## **Bluesky Posting Guidelines**

- **Tagging/Mentions:** Tag users with their full handle (e.g., @name.bsky.social). No autocomplete available, type carefully or copy/paste.
- **Hashtags:** Use #hashtag to make posts discoverable. Can include letters, numbers + underscores, but not numbers alone.
- **Character Limit:** 300 characters per post.
- **Emojis:** Supported.
- **Links:**  
  - Must start with http:// or <https://>.
  - Count as 23 characters, regardless of length.
  - Link shorteners are discouraged.
- **Daily Posting Limit:** 100 posts per 24 hours.

---

## **How to Create App Password in Bluesky**

```
Important: The app password is displayed only once. If you miss it, you’ll need to delete it and create a new one.
```

1. Login to your Bluesky account in a new tab.
2. Go to **Settings** > **Privacy** **&** **security** > **App** **Passwords**.
3. Click **+** **Add** **App** **Password**.
4. In the pop-up modal, **name your app password**, then click **Next**.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/cxIyMvPNAfVEkNLs0Ftl+/GIF+Recording+2025-10-07+at+9.41.50+PM.gif)
5. **Copy the App Password** as you will need it while connecting Bluesky with social planner.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/zX0FcCl6gvM5BtpzDQ4h+/Screen+Shot+2025-10-07+at+9.43.54+PM.png)

---

## **How To Connect Bluesky with Social Planner**

1. Click on the **Marketing** tab from your sub-account.
2. Click on **Social****Planner**.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/D2dWJYvAFh71XjD4OSt4+/Screen+Shot+2025-10-07+at+6.39.14+PM.png)
3. Click on the **+ Socials** button.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/07mefuMdgHokroabJTpQ+/Screen+Shot+2025-10-07+at+6.43.09+PM.png)
4. Click on the **Connect****Bluesky** option.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/1XiFShZrjExdwKVZwVx3+/Screen+Shot+2025-10-07+at+8.58.27+PM.png)
5. Enter your **Bluesky Username**, without the @. (e.g., username.bsky.social).
6. Enter/paste the **copied** **app** **password**. (Not your main account password)  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/5tdnij8BKnmbaRxZSEAM+/Screen+Shot+2025-10-07+at+9.31.22+PM.png)
7. Click on the **Connect** button.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/kGYgMBjmPhBS1Dfyq2Ng+/Screen+Shot+2025-10-07+at+9.56.36+PM.png)
8. Click on the **Add** button next to your profile to add it to social planner.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/JcEUENcTtIpR5uHebyx3+/Screen+Shot+2025-10-07+at+9.58.50+PM.png)
9. Once connected, your Bluesky account will appear under **All Accounts** drop-down in Social Planner.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/NdLMYK5jJVIBnJeGFAvi+/Screen+Shot+2025-10-07+at+10.21.34+PM.png)

---

## **Manage Bluesky Comments**

You can view comments on Bluesky posts from within Social Planner, reply using text and emojis, and keep conversation context with threaded replies (up to 3 levels visible).

For more information, see [Manage Comments in Social Planner.](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000006433)

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155071844721/original/2pjr0b4WNffeNZ38CNLujqXPUiZzBPwb9g.png?1779315392)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Why do I need an app password instead of my Bluesky login?**For security. Bluesky requires third-party tools to use app passwords so your main credentials stay protected.

**Q: What if I lose the app password?**

Go to Bluesky, delete the old app password and create a new one, then reconnect in Social Planner.

**Q: What happens if my app password expires?**

Generate a new app password in Bluesky and reconnect the account in Social Planner.

**Q: Can I connect multiple Bluesky accounts/handles?**

Yes. Connect each account separately, each needs its own app password.

**Q: Do I need to reconnect after logging out of Bluesky?**

No. Once connected with an app password, your Bluesky account will stay connected until you remove it or reset the password. 

**Q: Which analytics can you track for Bluesky in the Social Planner?**  
 You can track Posts, Likes, Comments, Impressions and Engagement Rate.

title_en: Understanding Courses Dashboard
source_md:
[동영상](https://www.youtube.com/embed/bNbn2sWGdNQ?&wmode=opaque)

The New Courses Dashboard in HighLevel gives creators a lightning-fast, data-rich snapshot of course performance. Discover how to read the dashboard, drill into insights, and start making smarter product decisions today. This dashboard provides key metrics for the past 30 days, helping you monitor the performance of your courses and identify opportunities for improvement.

```
Note: Data is updated every 6 hours.
```

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is the New Courses Dashboard?](#What-is-the-New-Courses-Dashboard?)
- [Key Benefits of the New Courses Dashboard](#Key-Benefits-of-the-New-Courses-Dashboard)
- [Top & Least Performing Courses](#Top-&-Least-Performing-Courses)
- [Revenue Generated](#Revenue-Generated)
- [Average Order Value (AOV)](#Average-Order-Value-(AOV))
- [Course Progress Funnel](#Course-Progress-Funnel)
- [Tips for Using the Dashboard](#Tips-for-Using-the-Dashboard)
- [How To Set Up the New Courses Dashboard](#How-To-Set-Up-the-New-Courses-Dashboard)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)

---

## **What is the New Courses Dashboard?**

The New Courses Dashboard is the default “welcome page” for every course creator in HighLevel. It replaces the legacy SQL-powered view to surface enrolment, revenue, and engagement metrics in near real-time. Built with the Highrise UI design system, the dashboard is fully responsive and refreshes its data every six hours to keep insights current.

---

## **Key Benefits of the New Courses Dashboard**

- Instant 30-day snapshot of your top and bottom-performing courses.
- **Unified revenue analytics**—Total Revenue, Checkouts, AOV, and more.
- Visual funnel to spot where learners drop off (sign-up → start → completion).
- Personalized empty-state and “Getting Started” cards for new creators.
- Click-through cards that open deeper member or revenue analytics in one click.

---

## **Top & Least Performing Courses**

These cards highlight which courses are performing best and which need attention based on enrollment and completion data.

1. **Top Performing Course**: Displays the course with the highest engagement in the past 30 days.
2. **Least Performing Course**: Displays the course with the lowest engagement or completion rate.
3. **Metrics shown**:  
     
   - **Completion Rate** – percentage of enrolled learners who completed the course.
   - **Enrollments** – total number of learners who enrolled.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155056151085/original/Y8GjKLdMacSO-HewJIPcUuQCv84xDm4xtg.png?1760620587)

Clicking on the course name will take you to the Course Details Page, where you can analyze engagement, content, and completion performance in depth.

---

## **Revenue Generated**

This section gives you a quick snapshot of total earnings from your courses.

- **Revenue Generated ($)** – total amount earned in the last 30 days.
- **vs Last Month** – percentage change compared to the previous month.
- **Total Checkouts**– total number of completed purchases.
- **Upsell Conversions**– number of successful upsells made through course offers.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155056150641/original/emEH0jvpZFmaG65zLDFU8I3nXzItbjhueg.png?1760620430)

**Navigation**: Click “**Go to Revenue**” to access detailed revenue analytics, transaction breakdowns, and learner purchase history.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155056150822/original/1YyaSTJ4z3O15Qh0VxU1tIlYDLzx_2fPPA.jpeg?1760620472)

---

## **Average Order Value (AOV)**

This card shows how much revenue you earn on average per learner.

- **AOV per User**– average order value calculated as total revenue divided by total learners.
- **Highest Order Value** – the largest single transaction recorded in the past 30 days.
- **vs Last Month** – change percentage compared to the previous period.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155056150992/original/vlzOEs2RubxcIq7L2wQtqiT9RjoeTbYCCA.png?1760620520)

---

## **Course Progress Funnel**

This visualization helps you track how learners move through your course journey — from signing up to completing the course.

- **Signed Up** – number of learners who registered for your courses.
- **Started** – learners who began engaging with lessons or modules.
- **Completed** – learners who finished the course.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155056150332/original/BX6Rwm-mlX4Vjz_uazL89WQgyB-QOjR1gQ.png?1760620347)

The Cumulative % on the right side shows the proportion of learners who progressed to each stage.

**Navigation**: Click “**Go to Funnel**” to view detailed course progress analytics, learner-level data, and export reports.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155056150262/original/qciu9_k3jNmLBjJ8LV9xgrSMRvlfhDKykw.png?1760620312)

---

## **Tips for Using the Dashboard**

- Use the Top vs. Least Performing Course data to decide where to invest your optimization efforts.
- Monitor Revenue and AOV trends monthly to measure the impact of pricing or promotional changes.
- Review the Course Progress Funnel frequently to identify where learners drop off and improve completion rates.

---

## **How To Set Up the New Courses Dashboard**

A dedicated setup isn’t required—the dashboard is enabled automatically for every account that uses HighLevel Courses. Use the steps below to find it and customise your view:

Log in to your HighLevel account and navigate to Memberships → Courses. Click Dashboard (it opens by default for creators).

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155056151808/original/HqiYuzYEXyoPlk1TiPX4yrrqXnbdjO3KBA.png?1760620783)

```
Tip: 

1. Pin the dashboard to your sidebar for one-click access.

2. [Optional] Hide sample data by clicking ••• → Remove Sample Data.

3. Use the Revenue or Funnel cards to jump into detailed analytics pages.

4. Repeat daily or weekly—data refreshes every six hours.
```

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Do I need to migrate anything to use the new dashboard?**

No. All existing course data is automatically updated; the dashboard appears the next time you open Courses.

**Q: Why don’t I see any revenue data?**

Revenue cards only populate once at least one paid checkout is processed through HighLevel Payments or Stripe.

**Q: Can I export the dashboard data?**

Yes. Click Export → CSV in the upper-right corner to download 30-day aggregates.

**Q: How do I change which metrics appear?**

Metric tiles are fixed for now, but deeper custom reports are coming soon as part of Advanced Analytics.

**Q: Will this impact my monthly API limits?**

No. Dashboard queries run server-side; they don’t count toward API allotments.

**Q: Is the dashboard available on mobile?**

Absolutely. Highrise UI ensures full responsiveness on tablets and phones.

**Q: Where can I manage multiple courses at once?**

Use Kollab Studio for bulk course management tasks such as publish/unpublish or price edits.

---

## **Getting Started with Affiliate Marketing**

#### **Affiliate**

An **affiliate** is an individual or business that promotes a product or service and earns a commission for any sales or leads they generate. Affiliates use unique links and tools to track their promotions and are sometimes called "publishers/promoter" or "affiliate marketers."

#### **Affiliate Campaign Source**

The **source** is where the products or services are listed for affiliate promotion. These could be funnels, websites, ecommerce stores, calendars, surveys, or forms. The source helps track sales accurately and assigns them to the correct affiliate.

#### **Affiliate Link**

An **affiliate link** is a unique URL that tracks any clicks and conversions that result from an affiliate’s promotion. When someone clicks on this link and makes a purchase or submits a lead, the affiliate is credited with the sale.

#### **Affiliate ID**

Each affiliate is assigned an **Affiliate ID**, a unique code used by the system to track their performance, such as how many sales or leads they generate.

---

## **Understanding Affiliate Campaigns**

#### **Campaign**

A **campaign** is a specific marketing effort to promote products or services to a targeted audience. Affiliates join these campaigns to promote the products or services to their own audience.

#### **Default Commissions**

Every campaign has **default commissions**, which are a percentage of the sale price or a flat fee given to the affiliate for each sale or lead they generate. These apply across all products in the campaign unless overridden by product-specific commissions.

#### **Product-Based Commissions**

You can also set **product-based commissions** for specific items in a campaign. For example, if the default commission is 20%, but you want to offer 30% on a particular product, the affiliate will earn 30% for that product and 20% for the others.

#### **Setup Fees**

If you charge a **setup fee** for your product or service, you can decide whether to include this fee in the commission calculation for your affiliates.

---

## **Affiliate Performance and Rewards**

#### **Attribution**

**Attribution** is the process of crediting an affiliate for a sale or lead. This means tracking and ensuring that the affiliate who promoted the product gets the reward for their efforts.

#### **Commission**

A **commission** is the amount paid to an affiliate for each sale or lead they generate. This can be a flat fee or a percentage of the sale and are sometimes called "rewards".

#### **Recurring Commission**

Some products or services offer **recurring commissions**, meaning affiliates continue to earn commissions for ongoing subscriptions or repeat sales from a single referral.

#### **Payout**

A **payout** is the total amount of money earned by an affiliate. This is paid based on the sales or leads generated from their affiliate link.

---

## **Affiliate Program Structures**

#### **Two-Tier Affiliate Program**

In a **two-tier affiliate program**, affiliates can not only earn commissions for their own sales but also for sales made by affiliates they recruit.

#### **Multi-Tier Affiliate Program**

A **multi-tier affiliate program** takes it a step further by allowing commissions to be earned across multiple levels of affiliates. For instance, GHL supports up to 7 tiers, meaning affiliates can earn a percentage of sales made by sub-affiliates at various levels.

#### **Sub-Affiliate**

A **sub-affiliate** works under a primary affiliate and promotes the product or service through their own network. The primary affiliate earns a commission from the sales made by their sub-affiliates.

---

## **Tracking and Reporting**

#### **Cookie**

A **cookie** is a small file stored on a user’s device to track their actions, such as visiting a website through an affiliate link. This ensures accurate tracking for attribution and commissions.

#### **Cookie Length**

**Cookie length** refers to how long the cookie remains active. For example, if the cookie length is 30 days, the affiliate can earn a commission if the customer makes a purchase within 30 days of clicking the affiliate’s link.

#### **Clicks**

You can track the number of **clicks** an affiliate link receives to see how effective a campaign is at generating interest.

---

## **Managing Affiliates**

#### **Affiliate Portal**

The **Affiliate Portal** is a personalized dashboard where affiliates can track their performance, including sales, commissions, and leads. Each affiliate has a unique login to access their data.

#### **Magic Link**

A **Magic Link** is a quick login option for affiliates to access their portal without needing to remember a password. This link can be shared with affiliates when they first join a campaign.

---

## **Leads and Customers**

#### **Leads**

A **lead** is someone who shows interest in a product or service, such as filling out a form or booking a calendar appointment. Leads can be generated through various actions or even added manually.

#### **Customers**

Once a **lead** makes a purchase, they are considered a **customer**. Affiliates typically earn a commission when a lead converts into a paying customer.

---

## **What's Next:**

- [Affiliate Manager Walkthrough Videos](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000003636-affiliate-manager-walkthrough-videos)
- [How does the Affiliate Manager work?](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000003637-how-does-the-affiliate-manager-work-)
- [Managing Multiple Campaigns in Affiliate Marketing](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000003638-managing-multiple-campaigns-in-affiliate-marketing)

---

title_en: Forms - How to Setup and Use Order Bumps
source_md:
This article shows how to use Order Bumps in HighLevel’s Forms. By adding engaging bump offers, you can increase revenue and provide upsell opportunities directly in Forms without interrupting the user experience. This update empowers you to boost revenue with customizable add-ons featuring modern visuals, multiple templates, and flexible activation that is designed to drive conversions.

---

  - [Step 1: Create a Form](#Step-1%3A%C2%A0Create-a-Form)

  - [Step 3: Add Your Bump Product](#Step-3%3A-Add-Your-Bump-Product)
  - [Step 4: Customize the Bump Product Content & Visuals](#Step-4%3A-Customize-the-Bump-Product-Content-&-Visuals)
  - [Step 5: Save Your Form](#Step-5%3A-Save-Your-Form)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is Order Bumps in Forms?**

Modern Order Bumps in Forms is a revenue-enhancing feature that embeds upsell options directly within your forms. By integrating bump products alongside your main offerings, HighLevel enables you to capture additional value through an engaging, customizable experience.

---

## **Key Benefits of Order Bumps**

With the expanded Order Bump functionality in Forms, you gain several user-focused advantages that enhance both appearance and performance:

- Enhanced visibility with options for both Classic and Modern bump styles.
- Multiple template selections designed to attract attention and drive higher conversions.
- Complete customization of visuals like colors, icons, highlight text, and price displays.
- Support for multiple bump products, expanding your upsell strategy.
- Smart recurring rules that ensure only one recurring product is configured per form.
- Flexible activation allowing you to easily toggle and rearrange bump products.

---

## **How To Setup and Use Order Bumps in Forms**

Setting up Modern Order Bumps is straightforward when using HighLevel’s intuitive Form builder. Follow these step-by-step instructions to integrate bump products into your forms:

### **Step 1:**Create a Form

1. Login to your sub-account.
2. Click **Sites** in the left sidebar → select **Forms** → click **Builder**.
3. Click **+ Add Form**.
4. Choose **Start from Scratch** or select a **Template** → click **Create**.
5. In the Element bar, drag **Sell Products**element onto the form canvas.

![](https://jumpshare.com/v/p3QQH1HSXYd8jFSfBw4H+/GIF+Recording+2025-07-24+at+10.25.22+PM.gif)

### **Step 2:** Add Your Main Product

1. Click on the Sell Products element.
2. In the right-side panel, click **Add Product**.
3. If you **haven’t created** a product yet: click **Click here** (link) to open the Product creation page and set one up.
4. If you **already have** products: use the **Please select the product** dropdown.
5. **Choose Product Type:** Select **Main Product**.
6. **Show Options:** Toggle **Description**, **Image**, **Quantity** to show/hide.
7. Click **Add Product** to insert it.

![](https://jumpshare.com/v/Dq1tFE8ET6fvWzx6RprA+/GIF+Recording+2025-07-24+at+10.46.57+PM.gif)

### **Step 3:** Add Your Bump Product

1. Click **Add Product** again.
2. **Create new** or **select existing** product from dropdown.
3. **Choose Product Type:** Select **Bump Product**.
4. Add a compelling **headline**.
5. **Enable/disable** image.
6. Upload a new Image or let the system fetch from the product record.

![](https://jumpshare.com/v/Zqg3P8WpfnP19UvrbYtg+/GIF+Recording+2025-07-24+at+10.48.45+PM.gif)

### **Step 4:** Customize the Bump Product Content & Visuals

1. Under **Order Bump Style**, pick **Modern** or **Classic**.
2. Use the **Select Template** dropdown to choose **Template 1, 2, or 3**.
3. In **Highlight Text**, enter an attention-grabbing snippet (e.g., “Grab the deal with one click”).
4. **Icon:** Select an icon to display next to the highlight text.
5. Toggle **Show Price / Hide Price** for the bump.
6. Customize **background color**, **highlight text color**, **headline color**, **OTO headline**, and **OTO text** colors.
7. Under **Layout Settings**, choose Single, Two, or Three column layout.
8. **Product Selection:** Allow **single** or **multiple** selections.
9. Toggle **Footer Info** (e.g., “100% secure and safe payments”).
10. Choose to **hide** or keep the **placeholder** text.

![](https://jumpshare.com/v/WYvxIjCdOMOF3jO3rPJQ+/GIF+Recording+2025-07-24+at+10.52.34+PM.gif)

### **Step 5:** Save Your Form

1. Click **Save** (top-right corner) to store your changes.

![](https://jumpshare.com/v/Kj2PPwK44XvmCGlYjQaA+/Screen+Shot+2025-07-24+at+10.55.27+PM.png)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Can I add more than one bump product to a single form?**Yes, you can include multiple bump products in the same form. This allows for multiple upsell opportunities without disrupting the main product flow.

**Q: Can both the main product and a bump product be recurring?**

No. Only one product per form can be recurring—either the main product or a single bump product, but not both. This ensures payment logic remains consistent.

**Q: What happens if I don't include a main product?**

Bump products will not appear unless a main product is also present. Always add a main product first to activate bump product visibility.

**Q: Are bump products compatible with all payment processors?**Yes. Order bumps work seamlessly with Stripe, PayPal, and any other supported HighLevel payment processors.

**Q: Can I rearrange or temporarily disable bump products without affecting the rest of the form?**Absolutely. You can toggle bumps on/off or reorder them at any time without disrupting your main product setup or form logic.

**Q: What types of forms can support Order Bumps?**

Any form that includes the Sell Product element can now leverage the Order Bumps feature.

**Q: Can I personalize the design for each bump product?**

Yes, the feature offers full customization, allowing you to adjust colors, icons, highlight text, and pricing for each bump product individually.

**Q: How many bump products can be added in a single form?**

You can add multiple bump products, providing flexibility to expand your upsell strategy as needed.

**Q: How can I switch between Classic and Modern bump styles?**

The style can be toggled within the bump product settings when enabling the bump feature on your form.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Payment in Forms (Including Donations)](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000001884)
