title_en: Error: Business account is restricted from messaging users in this country
source_md:
You may encounter the following WhatsApp error when attempting to send messages:

**“Business account is restricted from messaging users in this country.”**

This restriction is related to recent changes in WhatsApp’s cross-country messaging policies and is not caused by an issue with your account setup or platform configuration.  
  
![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155062921159/original/WjI9kgO0LXe1uNvh0NH6EEJH0_NOzFI3OA.png?1768800286)

## **Why This Error Occurs**

Effective **September 15**, WhatsApp implemented a **temporary restriction on cross-country messaging** involving **Brazil (BR)** and **Indonesia (ID)**.

Due to this policy update:

- **Businesses located outside Brazil or Indonesia**

  - Cannot send WhatsApp messages to users located in **Brazil or Indonesia**.
- **Businesses located within Brazil or Indonesia**

  - Can only message users **within the same country**.
  - Cannot send messages to users in other regions.

This restriction applies to all WhatsApp Business accounts and is enforced directly by WhatsApp (Meta).

## **What Is Not Affected**

- Messaging **within the same country** (Brazil → Brazil, Indonesia → Indonesia) continues to work as expected.
- Receiving messages from users is not impacted by this restriction.
- Your WhatsApp account status, templates, quality rating, and balance remain unchanged.

## **Can This Restriction Be Removed?**

At this time, this is a **WhatsApp-imposed limitation**, and there is no workaround or override available from our side. We recommend monitoring official WhatsApp (Meta) announcements for any updates or changes to this policy.

## **What You Can Do Next**

- Ensure your messaging use cases align with the country-based restrictions.
- If your business operates globally, consider:

  - Using separate WhatsApp Business accounts per region, where applicable.
  - Leveraging alternative communication channels for cross-country outreach.

title_en: What happens when you delete a contact linked to a community group
source_md:
**When a contact is a group member**

- When a contact is deleted from a community, the individual will be permanently removed from the community, losing all access to its content and features.
- This means the person will no longer be able to view any posts, updates, or discussions within the community, nor will they be able to participate by posting or interacting in any way.
- **The deletion is irreversible**, effectively cutting off the individual from all community activities and communications.

**When a contact is a group owner**

- It’s important to note that if the person in question is the owner of any group or location within the community, they cannot be deleted.
- The ownership status of a group or location grants them a level of authority and control that prevents their removal, ensuring the continuity and management of those specific areas within the community.
- As a result, any attempt to delete such a person would be blocked, preserving their access and responsibilities related to the groups or locations they oversee.

title_en: How to Setup SFTP for your WordPress Site
source_md:
SFTP is a way for you to access the files and folders on a website via a client program on your local computer. SFTP stands for Secure File Transfer Protocol (or SSH File Transfer Protocol). It was designed as an extension of the SSH (Secure SHell) protocol. We only support SFTP connections within the CRM to ensure your data remains safe and encrypted.

#### **Covered in this Article:**

#### [How to use SFTP to connect to your WordPress site?](#How-to-use-SFTP-to-connect-to-your-WordPress-site?)

---

## **How to use SFTP to connect to your WordPress site?**

1. Go to **Sites -> WordPress -> Advanced Settings -> FTP Access**

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155041177708/original/iJrg6pXwzAbgxbW4ags-0dDrePz_311PHg.png?1738914168)

3. The Host URL, Port number, Username, and Password can be used to log in to a client program and access the WordPress files. Make sure to keep these credentials safe. The UserName and Password are unique for each user and you can even reset these credentials.

## **What is happening?**

[Google is sunsetting its Google Business Profile - Chat](https://support.google.com/business/answer/14919062?visit_id=638527408143815861-3060349225&p=chat_sunset&rd=1) starting from Jul 15, 2024. We understand that this is a frustrating situation, and we are here to help you through this change.

- **Beginning July 15, 2024, your contacts won't be able to start new chat conversations with your business from Google. Contacts in existing chat conversations will see a notification from Google about the feature phaseout.**
- **On July 31, 2024, the chat feature will be removed from Google Business Profile. You won’t receive new chat messages.**

## **Will my contacts be notified about this change?**

**Beginning July 15, 2024, contacts in existing chat conversations will be notified about the feature phaseout. These notifications will be shown in existing chat conversations until July 31, 2024, when GBP chat will no longer be supported.**

**If your profile currently does not have a phone number or if the number is hidden, we recommend adding one to your Business Profile by July 31 so customers can continue to contact you directly. [Learn more about how to edit your business phone number](https://support.google.com/business/answer/3039617#phone).**
